column4: [INFO:000E2D05] ('Hrongar won't give us a straight answer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1ADE])

[INFO:000E1AF8] ('He's a true Nord. He'll come around.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1ADD])

[INFO:000E1B27] ('So we're ready to start this war in earnest then?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1AD4])

[INFO:000E1B00] ('Things hinge on Whiterun. If we can take the city without bloodshed all the better. But if not...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1ACF])
[INFO:000E1AE6] ('The people are behind you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1ACE])
[INFO:000E1B09] ('Many I fear still need convincing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1ACD])

[INFO:000E1B26] ('We've been soldiers a long time. We know the price of freedom. The people are still weighing things in their hearts.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1ACB])

[INFO:000E1ADF] ('Well put, friend. Tell me, Galmar, why do you fight for me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1AC7])

[INFO:000E1B01] ('I'll die before elves dictate the fates of men. Are we not one in this?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E1AC4])

MGLPolicyEye01 [INFO:000E31D4] ('Projects are underway to discern the origin and nature of the College's recent find in Saarthal.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

column4: MGLPolicy08 [INFO:000E31C4] ('We've had yet another sprained ankle due to soul gems being left on the floor. Let's please try and keep injuries to a minimum.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLPolicy07 [INFO:000E31C3] ('Once again, I must ask that everyone please clean up any materials used in the common areas.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLPolicy06 [INFO:000E31C2] ('Failure to do so will result in paying, in Urag's words, "a blood price." I did not ask him to elaborate on that point.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLPolicy05 [INFO:000E31BA] ('If this is impossible due to misuse or accident, Urag recommends finding a replacement copy to deliver to the Arcanaeum.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLPolicy04 [INFO:000E31B6] ('Urag has asked me to remind everyone to please return materials borrowed from the Arcanaeum in the same condition as you received them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLPolicy03 [INFO:000E31B2] ('Atronachs have a tendency to frighten the locals. Undead.... well, I don't even think it needs to be said.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLPolicy02 [INFO:000E31B1] ('Please refrain from practicing Conjuration spells in view of the town of Winterhold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLPolicy01 [INFO:000E31B0] ('At this time, I would like to make a few statements regarding policy here at the College.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLShalidor12 [INFO:000E31A1] ('The College is always searching for more of Shalidor's writings in an attempt to understand both our knowledge of the man, and of magic in general.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor11 [INFO:000E31A0] ('Increased his intelligence and knowledge in ways unfathomable to us? We may never know for certain.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLShalidor10 [INFO:000E319F] ('Is it possible that it somehow contributed to his work? Perhaps allowed him to life multiple lifetimes in a short span of time?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor09 [INFO:000E3192] ('What, then, of this Glamoril? It means "secret of life" in elvish. Could this be an explanation for Shalidor's works?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor08 [INFO:000E3190] ('An array so great, in fact, that it remains a source of curiosity.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor07 [INFO:000E318B] ('What is interesting is that it appears he was also incredibly prolific, writing on a diverse array of subjects.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLShalidor06 [INFO:000E318A] ('The few works of his that have been recovered suggest that he had an understanding of magic and the world that few have ever achieved.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor05 [INFO:000E3189] ('We know that Shalidor had an understanding of magic that surpassed almost any of either his age or ours.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor04 [INFO:000E3187] ('The College has developed some theories, however.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLShalidor03 [INFO:000E3186] ('While stories have persisted since the First Era, none have ever confirmed the existence of this "Glamoril" or its purpose or function.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor02 [INFO:000E3183] ('He is most remembered for his great maze of Labyrinthian, said to hold "Glamoril", or the secret of life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLShalidor01 [INFO:000E3181] ('As many know, there is an ongoing effort to research the work of the Archmagus Shalidor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLResto11 [INFO:000E0C64] ('I truly hope that these points actually sink in, and that more care and thought is given to this subject in the future. Thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto10 [INFO:000E0C63] ('Every mage in this College regularly uses wards for practice, so as to avoid physical harm.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto09 [INFO:000E0C62] ('But more importantly, wards have saved lives. This is a simple fact.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto08 [INFO:000E0C61] ('They are counted upon every bit as much as Candlelight, or Invisibility.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto07 [INFO:000E0C60] ('Secondly, how can anyone forget wards? They have become essential to any mage working in dangerous situations.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLResto06 [INFO:000E0C5F] ('I submit that everyone in this College has, at one time or another, relied on one of the Restoration spells that can keep them at bay.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto05 [INFO:000E0C5E] ('Skyrim is well known to be full of these... Draugr, ancient Nord warriors who cannot find peace.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto04 [INFO:000E0C5D] ('Firstly, the ability to repel the undead cannot be ignored.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto03 [INFO:000E0C5C] ('Anyone suggesting that Restoration is better left to the priests of the Temples, I think, is forgetting a few things.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLResto02 [INFO:000E0C5B] ('It is absolutely worthy of research, despite many of the notes I've had left in my bed. And my desk. And on occasion, my meals.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLResto01 [INFO:000E0C5A] ('I would just like to remind everyone, once again, that Restoration is indeed a valid school of magic.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod18 [INFO:000E0C59] ('Say as little as possible so as to avoid compromising our neutral position.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLSynod17 [INFO:000E0C58] ('If either group goes through less official channels and attempt to contact you directly, please refer them to the College's Master Wizard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod16 [INFO:000E0C57] ('Falling in with either would threaten to draw much unwanted attention to our College.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod15A [INFO:000E0C56] ('Arch-Mage Aren believed that their conflict poses a significant threat to the autonomy of our College, and I concur.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod15 [INFO:000E0C55] ('Arch-Mage Aren believes that their conflict poses a significant threat to the autonomy of our College, and I concur.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod14 [INFO:000E0C54] ('They appear to have little interest in real study and research for the sake of gaining knowledge.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod13 [INFO:000E0C53] ('At present, these two groups do little beyond attempting to gain the attention and favor of the Emperor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLSynod12 [INFO:000E0C52] ('Indeed, it has been jokingly suggested that we send the exact same response to both, which each will warp into support for their side.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLSynod11 [INFO:000E0C51] ('Our actual position and policies are irrelevant. No matter the facts of the response, it will certainly be twisted to suit the whims of either group.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod10 [INFO:000E0C50] ('Thus they may claim that the Synod is indeed a political minority in the Empire and should be treated as such.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod09 [INFO:000E0C4F] ('The College of Whispers hopes to learn that our College also supports these avenues of research.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod08 [INFO:000E0C4E] ('They focus on research banned by the Synod, such as Conjuration and Necromancy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod07 [INFO:000E0C4D] ('Likewise, the College of Whispers has long been driven by its desire to directly oppose the Synod.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod06 [INFO:000E0C4C] ('It is entirely possible that they look to our College here in Winterhold in order to find supporters for their organization.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod05 [INFO:000E0C4B] ('The Synod's harsh rules and draconian structure are maintained only by suppressing any opposition to their Council's policies.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod04 [INFO:000E0C49] ('Aren believed that although the initial communications were innocent enough, they were sent with a particular motive in mind.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLSynod03 [INFO:000E0C48] ('The College of Winterhold has thus far declined requests for direct meetings. This has been at the specific request of Arch-Mage Aren.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLSynod02 [INFO:000E0C47] ('At this time, there is no indication that either group is aware of the other's correspondence.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLSynod01 [INFO:000E0C46] ('It is no secret that both the Synod and the College of Whispers have recently made inquiries as to the status of our College here in Winterhold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLDoomstone12 [INFO:000E0C45] ('The College will continue to research these intriguing objects, and of course any findings will be relayed with all possible haste.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone11 [INFO:000E0C44] ('Nonetheless, many are drawn to these stones based on the local stories describing them as a source of significant power.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLDoomstone10 [INFO:000E0C43] ('Writings from that period, including those of Ysgramor himself, do not mention the stones and thus this idea cannot be verified.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLDoomstone09 [INFO:000E0C42] ('The age of the stones themselves has yet to be officially determined. It has been widely assumed that they were placed during the Merethic Era.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone08 [INFO:000E0C41] ('Also, their placement throughout Skyrim does not correspond to any known magical phenomenon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone07 [INFO:000E0C40] ('Their relative positions do not indicate that any individual stone is part of a larger, unobserved pattern.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone06 [INFO:000E0C3F] ('At present, there is no confirmation of any of the various theories surrounding the nature of these stones.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone05 [INFO:000E0C3E] ('None, however, exactly match the markings or distribution of Skyrim's stones.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone04 [INFO:000E0C3D] ('References to similar stones appear in lore throughout the various Tamrielic cultures.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone03 [INFO:000E0C3C] ('While there is no direct evidence of this, it does seem likely.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])
MGLDoomstone02 [INFO:000E0C3B] ('The prevailing opinion of Skyrim natives is that the stones are indeed magical in nature.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

MGLDoomstone01 [INFO:000E0C3A] ('The existence of so-called "Doomstones" throughout Skyrim has been repeatedly verified. The meaning of these stones has not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000E0C34])

[INFO:000B867B] ('I never meant for any of what happened here. Tried to seal it up, lock it away forever.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8662])
[INFO:000B8675] ('But now it all comes out again...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8661])
[INFO:000B866F] ('There were six of us. Full of ambition, eager to conquer the world.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8660])
[INFO:000B8665] ('It was Atmah's idea to come here, at first. She talked me into it, and I convinced the others.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B865F])
[INFO:000B8715] ('We were sure we'd find it all here, hidden away from time. Power, knowledge... All the things we didn't want to wait for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B865E])
[INFO:000B86F6] ('We thought it would be so simple.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B865D])
[INFO:000B86E9] ('Girduin died first. It happened so fast, none of us had a chance to react.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B865C])
[INFO:000B86D1] ('One moment we joked about what we'd find below, the next he'd been ripped in half.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B865B])
[INFO:000B867F] ('And then we were all fighting just to survive. None of us were prepared. It was amazing the rest of us survived.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B865A])
[INFO:000B8679] ('When it was over, Atmah, Hafnar and I stared, pale-faced, at one another, unwilling to admit we'd made a terrible mistake.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8659])
[INFO:000B8673] ('We could have turned back. It could have ended there. But we kept going.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8658])

[INFO:000B866D] ('Elvali died here. I don't even remember what killed her. One of the countless faceless horrors. I think she was glad, in that final moment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8657])
[INFO:000B871E] ('Hafnar was covered in blood, but his stupid Nord pride wouldn't let him admit defeat.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8656])
[INFO:000B86F8] ('I... I don't know why I pressed the others on, convinced them to keep going.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8655])
[INFO:000B86DB] ('"If we can just make it through, it'll all be worth it", I told them. And the fools believed the words I myself didn't trust.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8654])
[INFO:000B86CF] ('There were only three of us left. Takes-In-Light just sat down and gave up, and we left her there to die.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8653])
[INFO:000B8682] ('I've no idea what killed her, but I'm sure something did.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8652])
[INFO:000B867D] ('Atmah cried to herself. Hafnar wouldn't look at either of us. And I kept telling them it would be all right.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8651])
[INFO:000B8677] ('I was in charge now. I pushed them on, insisting it would be worse to try and go back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8650])
[INFO:000B8671] ('What happened after was my fault. All mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B864F])
[INFO:000B8667] ('We all knew this was the end. Without even opening the door, we knew what was behind it would kill us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B864E])
[INFO:000B871B] ('None of our spells were potent enough, none of our wills were strong enough.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B864D])
[INFO:000B86ED] ('"No matter what, we stay together", Hafnar said. I looked him in the eyes and lied to him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B864C])
[INFO:000B86D2] ('I had no choice, don't you see?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B864B])
[INFO:000B86B7] ('I had to leave them behind, had to sacrifice them so I could make it out alive.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B864A])
[INFO:000B867A] ('If we'd all died there, if we'd loosed the thing on the world, who knows what might have happened?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8649])
[INFO:000B8674] ('That's how I consoled myself for years, after I'd sealed this place shut and vowed never to let anyone open it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8648])
[INFO:000B866E] ('Now you've put it all to rest, but it can't undo my mistakes. They can never be undone...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B8647])

[INFO:000B6BF7] ('Aren't you worried someone will wander in here? The entrance isn't exactly hidden you know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BEF])
[INFO:000B6BF3] ('This again? I told you we have someone standing guard out there. And, don't forget the rock trap we rigged up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BEE])
[INFO:000B6BF1] ('So, stop your worrying and get some rest. Your shift is coming up and I don't want you dozing off again like last time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BED])
[INFO:000B6BF0] ('I knew I heard something. What's this bridge doing down?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BEC])
[INFO:000B6BF8] ('I thought we had a guard posted outside.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BEB])
[INFO:000B6BF6] ('We did! Keep your eyes peeled. I don't think we're alone. You check the entrance. I'm going to look over here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BEA])
[INFO:000B6BF4] ('Anything?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BE9])
[INFO:000B6BF5] ('No, haven't seen anyone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BE8])
[INFO:000B6BF2] ('Keep looking. Someone's here, I can feel it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6BE7])

[INFO:000B667D] ('Talen, do you believe what they're saying? Do you really think the dragons have returned?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6678])
[INFO:000B6680] ('I don't know what to believe. If it's true, then dark times may be upon us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6677])
[INFO:000B6685] ('What should we do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6676])
[INFO:000B667A] ('We hold each other close and hope that all of this ends well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6675])
[INFO:000B667E] ('Madesi, have you heard the Imperials might be headed this way? What would we do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6674])
[INFO:000B6681] ('They aren't invading, milord... it's simply a response to Ulfric and his Stormcloaks. I assure you everything will be fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6673])
[INFO:000B6683] ('But I've heard from the Snow-Shods that they intend to burn this place to the ground!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6672])
[INFO:000B6679] ('Tythis, please. The Snow-Shods are good people, but tend to exaggerate. Try and stay calm for your own sake.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6671])
[INFO:000B6684] ('Have our scouts come up with any information on these reports of dragons?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6670])
[INFO:000B667C] ('Yes, milady. That unpleasantness at Helgen supposedly involved a dragon. It killed several soldiers before it departed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B666F])
[INFO:000B6682] ('I want you to speak to the city guard. Make sure there's a contingency plan in effect in case Riften falls under attack.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B666E])
[INFO:000B667B] ('Yes, milady. I've also taken the liberty in preparing a private carriage... just in case.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B666D])
[INFO:000B667F] ('Good. If Riften should fall, it's only right that its leader be spared.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B666C])
[INFO:000B646A] ('I am Lu'ah Al-Skaven. Who are you to disrupt my work? Begone, or I will add you to my army of the dead!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6469])
[INFO:000B6342] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B6341])
[INFO:000B62CB] ('Do you think we could persuade one of the dragons to join our side?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62C6])
[INFO:000B62C7] ('I'm fairly sure that the dragons don't care about our matters one way or the other.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62C5])
[INFO:000B62CA] ('But just think of the advantage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62C4])
[INFO:000B62CD] ('I'm not saying it wouldn't be useful. But there are better uses of our resources right now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62C3])
[INFO:000B62CF] ('I don't suppose we would ever really trust the thing anyway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62C2])
[INFO:000B62B2] ('Captain, have you heard these stories of dragons?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62AC])
[INFO:000B62B1] ('Elda, you know better than to believe every idiot traveler that wanders through.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62AB])
[INFO:000B62B4] ('But they're saying that one of them freed Ulfric... that he's in league with them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62AA])
[INFO:000B62B5] ('Think about how ridiculous that sounds. Come now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62A9])
[INFO:000B62B6] ('Calixto, do you know if there's any truth to these rumors of dragons?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62A5])
[INFO:000B62B7] ('Eh. I try not to trouble myself with stories of the outside world.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62A4])
[INFO:000B62B0] ('But how would you know it's real?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62A3])
[INFO:000B62AE] ('Ah, I can't reveal all my secrets to you. But rest assured, I would know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000B62A2])

CWSharedExtraReward5 [INFO:000E1937] ('I've come to rely on you. There's something I want you to have. It was my father's. It would be my honor if you carried it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWSharedExtraReward4 [INFO:000E18E8] ('Here. I want you to have this. Don't ask. Just take it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWSharedExtraReward3 [INFO:000E18E7] ('Found this among the dead. Something tells me I should give it to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWSharedExtraReward2 [INFO:000E18E6] ('We found this in the Jarl's treasury after we captured the capital. I thought you should be the one to have it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWSharedExtraReward1 [INFO:000E179A] ('We found this in the Jarl's treasury after we captured the city. I thought you should be the one to have it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWPromotionSonsCoward [INFO:000CE09F] ('But I'm disappointed to hear you ran away from the battle. The gods do not reward cowardice. Nor do I. I expect better from you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWPromotionSons4 [INFO:000CE09E] ('You've become a true hero of Skyrim. I number you among my kin. You shall now be known as Stormblade.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWPromotionSons3 [INFO:000CE09A] ('Multitudes of our enemies are buried in an avalanche of pain and retribution delivered by your hands. I shall call you Snow-Hammer now.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWPromotionSons2 [INFO:000CE099] ('Some brothers have taken to calling you Bone-Breaker, evidence of your ferocity and determination. A fitting name. So we shall all call you thus.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWPromotionSons1 [INFO:000CE098] ([SO]'We'll call you Ice-Veins now, for the thick blood of our land has seeped into your heart.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWPromotionImperialCoward [INFO:000CE097] ('However, I'm disappointed to hear that you fled from the field of battle. We do not reward cowardice in the Legion. I expect better of you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWPromotionImperial4 [INFO:000CE096] ('I have come to rely heavily upon you. It is only fitting that you join the upper echelon. I am hereby elevating you to the rank of Legate.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWPromotionImperial3 [INFO:000CE092] ('You've come a long way. I don't think we could do without you. I'm hereby raising you to Tribune. Congratulations.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWPromotionImperial2 [INFO:000CE091] ('Battles are won by trained and disciplined men. Wars are won by talented and exceptional individuals.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWPromotionImperial1 [INFO:000CE090] ([SO]'I'm promoting you to Quaestor.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricRiftWant [INFO:000A6CCF] ('Losing the Rift gives Tullius easy access to the south of Eastmarch. Talos preserve us. We must take it back!' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricRiftWonBack [INFO:000E6C85] ('I'm glad we liberated the Rift. It was dangerous having Imperials skulking about on the southern border of Eastmarch.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricRiftHave [INFO:000A6CCE] ('Damn Tullius. He's pocketed men in the Rift. It's dangerous having Imperials skulking about on the southern border of Eastmarch.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricWinterholdWant [INFO:000A6CCD] ('I don't like Imperial troops holed up in Winterhold... such a close march to Windhelm. So I'm sending a campaign up there to take it back.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricWinterholdWonBack [INFO:000E6C84] ('I'm glad we've taken back Winterhold. While the Imperials were up there, important resources were tied up stiffening our northern border.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricWinterholdHave [INFO:000A6CCC] ('I'm not sure why Tullius is wasting his time trying to take Winterhold from us. But if he wants to throw his men away, I'll gladly accept that gift.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricPaleWant [INFO:000A6CCB] ('I can't believe we let them take the Pale. Losing the port of Dawnstar is lessened only by the threat of Imperial forces being so close to Windhelm.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricPaleWonBack [INFO:000E6C83] ('I'm glad we've finally restored the Pale. It was extremely foolish giving the Empire control of another port.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricPaleHave [INFO:000A6CCA] ('Tullius has camps in the Pale, entertaining thoughts of battle. The Empire still underestimates the force of our cause. It will be their undoing.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricFalkreathWant [INFO:000A6CC9] ('The Empire thinks it holds Falkreath from us. But the souls of Skyrim's bravest are buried there and will fill our hearts and strengthen our blades.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricFalkreathHave [INFO:000A6CC8] ('I'm proud we liberated Falkreath from the Empire. In many ways it's the heart and soul of Skyrim. Not to mention its rather strategic position.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricWhiterunWant [INFO:000A6CC7] ('The Imperials have really dug into Whiterun. We'll wrest it from them soon enough. We must. Its central position is key.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricWhiterunHave [INFO:000A6CC6] ('We've driven the Imperials out of Whiterun. This is good. Very good. We now control the center. It's a powerful position. One I aim to keep.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricHjaalmarchWant [INFO:000A6CC5] ('We should take Hjaalmarch. It'll be an important pressure point on the Imperials. We'd be within spitting distance of the capital.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricHjaalmarchHave [INFO:000A6CC4] ('Tullius must be getting nervous. Taking Hjaalmarch we're practically in his backyard now. As soon as we're able, we'll march on Solitude.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricReachWant [INFO:000A6CC3] ('The Empire's ravenous hunger for Skyrim's silver makes them fierce. But rest assured, we'll win the Reach and wrest it from their greedy paws.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricReachHave [INFO:000A6CC2] ('Now that the Empire has been driven from the Reach we can put a stop to the raping of her silver mines. That silver belongs in Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricHaafingarWant [INFO:000A6CC1] ('Soon enough we will march on Solitude. And on that day the heroes of Sovngarde will march with us, and the Empire will fall to its knees in fear.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWUlfricHaafingarHave [INFO:000A6CC0] ('I almost can't believe it. The Empire has been defeated. The world bears witness to the power and righteousness of the sons and daughters of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusRiftWant [INFO:000A6CBF] ('We need the Rift. We need to regain control of it before we can march on Windhelm without worry about our rear guard.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusRiftHave [INFO:000A6CBE] ('Taking control of the Rift was a great victory. Ulfric must be rather nervous with us so close to his door step.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWTulliusEastmarchWant [INFO:000A6CBD] ('We will oust Ulfric from Windhelm soon enough. And when we do, I'll have his head on a plate.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusEastmarchHave [INFO:000A6CBC] ('I almost can't believe it's over. The rebellion is squashed, Windhelm is free. I must admit, Ulfric put up a stronger fight than I was expecting.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusWinterholdWant [INFO:000A6CBB] ('There's not much up there, but if we can regain Winterhold, our proximity to Windhelm should keep Ulfric wary and wasting troops garrisoned at home.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])
CWTulliusWinterholdHave [INFO:000A6CBA] ('Now that we have Winterhold, I can garrison some troops there until I'm ready to march on Windhelm.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusPaleWant [INFO:000A6CB9] ('Controlling the Pale gives Ulfric a port town and takes the pressure off of Windhelm. But it's only a matter of time before it's back in our hands.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusPaleHave [INFO:000A6CB8] ('Taking the Pale gives us another port in Dawnstar, and puts us within striking distance of Windhelm. That should make Ulfric a bit more cautious, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusFalkreathWant [INFO:000A6CB7] ('I fear losing Falkreath may give too much advantage to Ulfric. The rebels now control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. I want it back.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusFalkreathWonBack [INFO:000E6C82] ('By taking back Falkreath, we control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. We should never have given it up.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusFalkreathHave [INFO:000A6CB6] ('By holding onto Falkreath, we control access to the Reach, Whiterun, and the Rift. Ulfric will try for it soon. We'll be there to stop him.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusWhiterunWant [INFO:000A6CB5] ('I can't believe we lost Whiterun. The rebels have a great advantage in controlling the center now. We must take it back!' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusWhiterunHave [INFO:000A6CB4] ('Ulfric will want to take Whiterun from us. But we will hold fast. We can't give the rebellion free reign through the center of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusHjaalmarchWant [INFO:000A6CB3] ('I'm losing my patience with this damn war. We must take Hjaalmarch back! The Stormcloaks will be beating upon the doors of the capital soon.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusHjaalmarchWonBack [INFO:000E6C7E] ('Reclaiming Hjaalmarch lets me worry less about the rear guard, and push more men to the front. It was a mistake to let Ulfric control it for so long.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusHjaalmarchHave [INFO:000A6CB2] ('Hjaalmarch is an important buffer zone between the rebel forces and the capital. Ulfric will try to break through at some point.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusReachWant [INFO:000A6CB1] ('We need to stem the flow of silver to the rebellion. Until we retake the Reach, the Stormcloaks will plunder it's mines to fund further violence.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusReachWonBack [INFO:000E6C7D] ('It was important we reclaimed the Reach. Letting Ulfric control the flow of silver was a mistake. One I'm glad we've finally corrected.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

CWTulliusReachHave [INFO:000A6CB0] ('It's good we hold the Reach. Were the rebels to gain control, the silver mines would give them coin to hire more thugs and expand their violence.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWSharedInfo [DIAL:000A6CAB])

[INFO:00043DEF] ('I'm keeping my eye on you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00043DEC] ('You're welcome in Riften as long as you continue to obey our laws.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00043DEA] ('Good journey to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00043DE9] ('I'd ask you maintain civility while you're here.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00043DE8] ('Be cautious, the pilgrimage to the Shrine is not an easy one.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00043DE7] ('Please, come back and speak to me anytime.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00041F74] ('Remember, keep this to yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00041F73] ('A Dreth never forgets a friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])
[INFO:00041F72] ('What am I going to do?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])

[INFO:00041F70] ('You've been kind, I thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenGoodbyes "DialogueRiftenGoodbyes" [DIAL:000A4027])

column4: [INFO:000A2BB1] ('Just browsin' today. If the gods be kind, someone will take mercy on me and spare a few septims.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A29A5])
[INFO:000A29B8] ('If they do, promise you'll actually purchase something for once.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A29A4])
[INFO:000A29B3] ('By Ysmir, I will. Gods know it's been too long since I tasted real meat.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2996])
[INFO:000A2BBE] ('I've got a recipe for venison stew that I want to try out. Will you have venison anytime soon?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2995])
[INFO:000A2BBB] ('Certainly. I'll be sure to bring some back for you the next time I go hunting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2994])
[INFO:000A2BB6] ('Make it quick, and there might be a bowl of hot stew in it for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2993])
[INFO:000A2BB3] ('Ah, Olfina. How may I help you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2992])
[INFO:000A2BB0] ('Got any sausages? I'm cooking a special breakfast for a friend, and they're his favorite.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2991])
[INFO:000A724E] ('Glad to see you're making new friends. I know Jon's death was hard on you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A298B])
[INFO:000A2A6B] ('Would your good friend be named Jon, by any chance? I've spied the two of you talking quite intimately.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A298B])
[INFO:000A29B5] ('Best you forget whatever you think you saw, elf. Such idle talk can prove hazardous to one's health.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A290E])
[INFO:000A29B2] ('How goes the begging today, Brenuin?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A290D])
[INFO:000A2BBD] ('That's right, mock the town beggar like everyone else. But I've got a right to browse, don't I? I ain't hurtin' anyone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A290C])
[INFO:000A2BBA] ('Make it quick, then. I don't want your stink driving my customers away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A290B])
[INFO:000A2BB8] ('The gods smile on them who show charity. Best you remember that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A290A])
[INFO:000A2BB5] ('Those green apples you sold me the other day were delicious.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2906])
[INFO:000A2BB2] ('Aren't they? I always set some aside for myself when the traders bring them up from the south.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2905])
[INFO:000A2BAD] ('I'm sure you could charge double for those and still sell them all within a week.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2904])
[INFO:000A29B9] ('You're right. I'll have to remember that the next time I get a shipment in.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2903])
[INFO:000A29B4] ('Did you raise your prices, Carlotta?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2902])
[INFO:000A29B1] ('I had to. The farmers are charging me double for the produce I sell.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A28FC])
[INFO:000A2BBC] ('Let me guess, they're saying it's because of this trouble with the Stormcloaks?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A28FB])
[INFO:000A2BB9] ('Exactly. Road patrols were cut in half because the Jarl needed soldiers. Now the bandits are bolder than ever.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A28FA])
[INFO:000A2BB7] ('Maybe, but they wouldn't taste as good as a loaf of fresh-baked pumpernickel.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A28F9])
[INFO:000A27CF] ([G]'This is all just too much, too fast. Go get some work from Nazir. I need time to... to think...' in GRUP Topic Children of DB04AstridNeedTimeBranchTopic [DIAL:000A27CD])

[INFO:000A27B1] ('No! Get back! It's still here somewhere! Hroki and Tor just got grabbed when they tried to make a run for it!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A27A9])
[INFO:000A27B0] ('Guardsman! What happened here? Where's this dragon? Quickly now!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A27A8])
[INFO:000A27AF] ('I don't know!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A27A7])
[INFO:000A27B8] ('Kynareth save us, here he comes again...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A27A6])

[INFO:000A2035] ('Where is it? I know you were trying to keep it for yourself J'zhar... You always try to keep it for yourself!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2033])
[INFO:000A2034] ('No! There's got to be more Skooma... Shut up! Shut up!  Don't lie to me J'zhar! You hid it! You always try to steal it from me!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2032])
[INFO:000A2036] ('No... No! You must be the one who took my skooma!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2031])
[INFO:000A2013] ('Listen up, legionnaires. Those Stormcloaks are here for the same reason we are.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A200D])
[INFO:000A2012] ('Ulfric the Pretender wants that crown, but we're not going to let him have it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A200C])

[INFO:000A2011] ('I realize some of you may know men on the other side. But remember this. They are the enemy now and will not hesitate to end your lives either.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A200B])
[INFO:000A2010] ('General Tullius is counting on us to bring back the Jagged Crown, and that's exactly what we're going to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A200A])
[INFO:000A200F] ('Listen up. Those Imperials aren't here by coincidence.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2009])
[INFO:000A200E] ('Their spies must've found out we know about the Crown, and they don't want us to have it. But they won't stand in our way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2008])

[INFO:000A2028] ('I know some of you are ex-legion and may know men on the other side. But remember this. They are the enemy now and they will not hesitate to kill you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2007])
[INFO:000A2015] ('Keep your wits about you and watch your shield brother's back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2006])

[INFO:000A2027] ([R]'So far, so good.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2026] ([R]'The Imperials will be sorry they got in our way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2025] ([R]'All for an old crown, huh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2024] ([R]'Keep a sharp eye out. There's no telling what we might run into in here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2023] ([SO]'Maybe that claw has a clue on it? You know, how to turn the rings so the door will open.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2022] ([SO]'Careful. No telling what will happen the next time you mess with that door.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2021] ([SO]'My pa always warned me not to mess with places like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A2020] ('That crown must be here somewhere. Keep looking.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000A201F] ([SO]'Good work! Lucky we had you with us today.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])
[INFO:000C9845] ('Korvanjund. Remember?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A2004])

[INFO:000A0DFA] ('Good job!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A0DC0])
[INFO:000A0DE9] ('Alright everyone! Keep your guard up. No telling what we'll find down here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A0DBF])

[INFO:000A0E08] ([R]'Keep looking, Unblooded. There's got to be some way to get that thing open.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A0DBC])
[INFO:000A0E07] ([R]'How's it going, Unblooded? You find anything yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000A0DBC])

column4: [INFO:0009B035] ([R][RE]'It's remarkable that our farms are so prosperous given the harsh winters of late.' in GRUP Topic Children of RorikPatrolCommentTopic [DIAL:0009B00A])
[INFO:0009B034] ([R]'Looks like it's going to be a bountiful harvest once again. The gods continue to smile upon us.' in GRUP Topic Children of RorikPatrolCommentTopic [DIAL:0009B00A])
[INFO:0009B033] ([R]'Nothing refreshes the soul like an honest day's labor in good, tilled earth.' in GRUP Topic Children of RorikPatrolCommentTopic [DIAL:0009B00A])
[INFO:0009B038] ('Looks like we're in for quite a harvest. We've had better luck with our planting than any village in the hold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B009])
[INFO:0009B026] ('Luck? I think it has more to do with the hard work and good soil.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B008])
[INFO:0009B017] ('Maybe you're right. Even so, I can't help wondering if some other force it at work here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B007])
[INFO:0009B02C] ('The last wheat shipment fetched a fine price at market.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B005])
[INFO:0009B01D] ('Well done! I don't know where I'd be without you, my old friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B004])
[INFO:0009B00E] ('It pleases me to know that I can still be of use even in the twilight of my life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B003])
[INFO:0009B031] ('Look at you! You're as filthy as a pig in a pen!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B002])
[INFO:0009B022] ('I am not! You're lying!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B001])
[INFO:0009B013] ('You smell like a pig's pen, too. What a stink! Have you been rolling in the dirt all day?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009B000])
[INFO:0009B03A] ('You're a liar! I won't listen to you. Leave me alone!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFFF])
[INFO:0009B036] ('Father, how old were you when you left home?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF8])
[INFO:0009B024] ('I know where this is going, son. As I've said many a time. the world is a dangerous place. You're much safer here at the farm, with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF7])
[INFO:0009B015] ('But I don't want to be safe! I'm not afraid of the dangers out there. The only thing I'm afraid of is wasting my life on this farm.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF6])
[INFO:0009B03C] ('Yes, that's your mother's side of the family talking. Just stay on for one more season, that's all I ask.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF5])
[INFO:0009B02A] ('I heard you sneaking around downstairs last night. Were you trying to break into my chest again, son? I've told you to leave it alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF4])
[INFO:0009B01B] ('I just wanted to try on your old armor, from back when you were a soldier. I thought I might be old enough to wear it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF3])
[INFO:0009B00D] ('I've told you a hundred times, I lock that chest for a reason. I don't want you getting a head full of ideas about adventure and glory.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF2])

[INFO:0009B030] ('I'm old enough to decide how to live my life, and I'd be honored to wear your armor, if you'd just let me. I'm strong enough to handle it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF1])
[INFO:0009B021] ('Another fine day at work in the fields. I don't envy those city folk who miss out on the joys of working the land.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFF0])
[INFO:0009B012] ('I'll tell you who I don't envy - those poor children who lost their parents in this war.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFEF])

[INFO:0009B039] ('Lives lost, crops burned, land ruined... there's no greater sin than war. And yet, you were an orphan, and you've made something of your life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFEE])
[INFO:0009B027] ('I was lucky. If you hadn't rescued me, I'd probably be a thief, a mercenary or something even worse.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFED])
[INFO:0009B018] ('It's too fine a day to dwell on such things. Let's get back to work and forget about wars and orphans for awhile.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFEC])
[INFO:0009B03F] ('The way our crops have been growing, Rorikstead must have the richest soil in the hold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFEB])
[INFO:0009B02D] ('Maybe we should start selling the soil along with the dung. We could make a tidy profit.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFEA])
[INFO:0009B01E] ('Hah! Who in their right mind would pay for dirt? You'd get laughed out of Whiterun for even trying it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE9])
[INFO:0009B00F] ('Hey, people have paid money for stranger things. Take our cow dung - we sell that by the wagon load.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE8])
[INFO:0009B032] ('When you're rich, you can waste as much money as you like on far-fetched business ideas. In the meantime, there's a farm to run.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE7])
[INFO:0009B023] ('I'm not saying it's my business, but I have to ask. Why are you so cruel to your little girls?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE6])
[INFO:0009B014] ('You're right, it's none of your business. How about you keep your nose out of it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE5])
[INFO:0009B03B] ('You keep on like you are, you'll end up with two daughters who hate you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE4])
[INFO:0009B029] ('Hah! And what would a witless oaf like you know about raising children?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE3])
[INFO:0009B00C] ('Your daughters are growing up fast, Lemkil. Seems like only yesterday they were newborn babes.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE1])
[INFO:0009B02F] ('They've grown, all right - lazier and more stupid.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFE0])
[INFO:0009B020] ('There's times I think you're the coldest man in Skyrim. This is your own flesh and blood you're talking about.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFDF])

[INFO:0009B025] ('Today I'll teach you a useful spell that might just save your life. If you should ever fall into a river, you'll be very glad you learned it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFDC])
[INFO:0009B016] ('Oh! Are you going to teach me how to turn into a mud crab?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFDB])
[INFO:0009B03D] ('Oh, it's much better than that. I will teach you how to breathe underwater, with no need to turn into one of those ugly creatures.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFDA])
[INFO:0009B02B] ('Wow! Then I could dive into a river and swim so far away that Britte and father could never find me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFD9])
[INFO:0009B01C] ('Now, clear your mind and breathe deeply. Good concentration is very important for spellcasting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009AFD8])

[INFO:000935CE] ('Big swords should always beat little swords.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009353D])
[INFO:0009357F] ('Brave hearts beat lesser ones. That's the decider.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009353C])

[INFO:000935D0] ('If you want to lead this pack when I'm gone, you have to see farther. Look closer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00093539])

[INFO:00093598] ('Should I be holding the blade further away than I would a smaller one?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0009351F])

[INFO:0007EC1B] ('You shoe that gelding, boy?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBD4])

[INFO:0007EC5C] ('Groom her, too?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBD2])
[INFO:0007EC0D] ('You know I did.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBD1])
[INFO:0007EC15] ('You clean out that muck?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBD0])
[INFO:0007EC4C] ('Yes, father, I did. And I watered her, and got fresh feed, and refitted the old saddle, just like you asked. Is there anything else?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBCF])
[INFO:0007EC06] ('Don't suppose there is. But you don't have to be so damned prickly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBCE])
[INFO:0007EBE4] ('I tell you? Saw that wild mare again yesterday, just outside the walls.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBCD])
[INFO:0007EC27] ('Yeah. So?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBCC])
[INFO:0007EBDA] ('Shor's beard, boy! You forget where you're standing? What kind o' business we're running?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC8])
[INFO:000D19B8] ('So? So?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC8])
[INFO:0007EC3A] ('We manage to break that mare and bring her back here, we can sell her for a small fortune.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC7])
[INFO:0007EBE5] ('Oh. Okay. So we should try to... what? Capture it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC6])
[INFO:0007EC53] ('Yes, son. We should try to capture it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC5])
[INFO:0007EC0C] ('Listen, father. I've been thinking....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC4])
[INFO:0007EC41] ('Here it comes again. Not happy with a roof and a trade, no. You want to be something entirely... different.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC3])
[INFO:0007EBE3] ('I'm just no good at this. You said it yourself. Gods, I don't even like horses. And if it's true what they're saying about dragons...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC1])
[INFO:0007EBF8] ('Dragons? You want to go out and fight dragons? Are you completely off your nut?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBC0])
[INFO:0007EC23] ('Come on, father, how hard can it be? They're just... big lizards. And those scales and teeth, they must be worth a fortune...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBBE])
[INFO:0007EC3E] ('Big lizards? By Shor, your mother gave birth to a half-wit. That is the end of this discussion.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBBD])
[INFO:0007EBD5] ('Hello, Fralia dear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBBC])
[INFO:0007EBFC] ('Lillith - always a pleasure. Just browsing, or were you looking for something particular?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBBB])

[INFO:0007EC1F] ('Funny you should ask. I'm in the market for a new locket. Something in polished silver, maybe. Big enough to hold, say, a folded-up letter?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBBA])

[INFO:0007EC5A] ('Ahhh, I see. I think I know just what you need. I don't have anything like that here now, but my Eorlund - he can make you one right quick.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB9])
[INFO:0007EBEA] ('Perfect, my dear. Absolutely perfect. I'll see you then.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB8])
[INFO:0007EC11] ('Do you have anything even remotely fresh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB7])
[INFO:0007EC31] ('I can assure you, it's all fresh. I hunt the game myself, every day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB6])
[INFO:0007EC51] ('Hmm. As you say.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB5])
[INFO:0007EC35] ('Maybe you'd like to try the horker? Or some beef?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB4])
[INFO:0007EBD8] ('You don't prepare the meat with any of those strange Elven spices, do you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB3])
[INFO:0007EBF9] ('Ahhhh... No, no Elven spices. Just some salt, to preserve it. You're not afraid of salt, are you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB2])

[INFO:0007EC19] ('I'm not "afraid" of anything. I simply prefer quality merchandise. No, no this meat won't do at all. Too much fat, and it all smells... wrong.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB1])
[INFO:0007EC2C] ('Suit yourself, then. The woods are that way. Outside the walls, walk straight ahead. Can't miss them. Good luck on your hunt.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBB0])
[INFO:0007EC45] ('Good day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBAF])
[INFO:0007EBD7] ('Can you close up the stand early today, mama?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBAE])

[INFO:0007EBFD] ('I'm afraid not, little fairy. The fruit has about another day left before it spoils. We've got to sell as much as we can, as soon as we can.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBAD])
[INFO:0007EC17] ('That's what you always say.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBAC])
[INFO:0007EC39] ('Because it's always true.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBAB])
[INFO:0007EC5E] ('Can we at least go to the tavern for supper?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBAA])
[INFO:0007EBF3] ('Tsk. And to think, I was going to feed you cabbages and apples again. Yes, little fairy, we can go to the tavern for supper.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA9])
[INFO:0007EC07] ('Yay!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA8])
[INFO:0007EC34] ('And what might you be looking at?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA7])
[INFO:0007EC57] ('Oh, the fruit looks so good. So juicy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA6])
[INFO:0007EBF0] ('No handouts today, Brenuin. Now scat. You'll scare off my paying customers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA5])
[INFO:0007EC14] ('Oh, just one apple, Carlotta? Just one tiny apple. I'll pay you tomorrow, I swear it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA4])
[INFO:0007EC2D] ('That's what you said last week, and the week before that. Now go, before I call a guard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA3])
[INFO:0007EC49] ('No, no! Don't do that. No need to do that. I'm going. See? I'm leaving. No guards, please.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA2])
[INFO:0007EBDC] ('Look, come back tomorrow, okay? If I have anything left that's not sold or spoiled, you can have it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA1])
[INFO:0007EBF7] ('You've got the heart of Mara herself, you know that? Thank you, Carlotta. Thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EBA0])
[INFO:0007EBD6] ('Everyone is this city is so on edge. I could use some good news, Skulvar.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EB9D])
[INFO:0007EBFE] ('Ha! Four more geldings sold. Sound like good news to you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EB9C])
[INFO:0007EC5F] ('Indeed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EB9B])

[INFO:0007EBEB] ('Aye, that it has. Trust me, mum - once you've killed a man from a horse, you'll never want to fight on the ground again. Ain't no goin' back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007EB9A])

[INFO:00072F08] ([R]'Come and see what is for sale, traveler.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072F07] ([R]'Many fine things are here for you, friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072F06] ([R]'You honor Khajiit with your presence.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072F05] ([R]'May your bed be warm and your food sweet.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072F04] ([R]'Please, come and browse our goods.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072F03] ([R]'Warm sands, friend. How may this one serve you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072F01] ([R]'Welcome to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072EF0] ([R]'Fortune smiles upon this meeting.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072EBB] ([R]'Khajiit has wares, if you have coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072EB5] ([R]'Do you seek to make a purchase?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072EB4] ([R]'Khajiit welcomes you, and also your coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072EB3] ([R]'A welcome to you, fellow traveler.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072EB2] ([R]'The air is so clear in Skyrim, one can see forever.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E58] ([R]'It is a strange sight, the white flakes that sometimes fall from the sky.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E57] ([R]'A peaceful greeting to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E4D] ([R]'How high the mountains of Skyrim rise!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E4C] ([R]'There is much beauty in this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E46] ([R]'We are creatures of the desert. The north wind chills us to the bones.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E45] ([R]'The roads of Skyrim lead to many dangers.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E44] ([R]'The warm sand of Elsweyr is far away from here.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E42] ([R]'The longer we travel the roads of Skyrim, the more empty this land seems.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E3A] ([R]'The wind blows bitter cold in this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:000D83FA] ([R]'The road makes this one weary.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:000D83F9] ([R]'Perhaps you have encountered Ma'dran or Akhari? Both are sworn to me, and both have worthy goods to offer.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:000D83F8] ([R]'I have traveled far across Tamriel to serve you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:000D83F7] ([R]'Welcome. If I cannot serve you, I am sure that one of my other traders can do so.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:000D83F6] ('So many refuse to talk to us. They call us thieves and smugglers. I am glad to see that you are not such a one.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072E39] ('I welcome you, friend. How may I serve you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueCaravansHellos [DIAL:00072BC2])
[INFO:00072BD9] ('Soon it will be time to replenish our supply of water.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BC1])
[INFO:00072DA1] ('The road takes us past many cold rivers. We can fill our skins there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BC0])
[INFO:00072D0D] ('If the river is not frozen to ice, perhaps.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BBE])
[INFO:00072C81] ('My bones ache for the moonsugar. It has been too long since I tasted it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BBD])
[INFO:00072F7B] ('You know that our supply is limited. It could be a season or more before we get a new shipment from the south.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BBC])
[INFO:00072D9E] ('My ears hear the truth in your words, and yet my body shakes with the need.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BBB])
[INFO:00072D0A] ('Control yourself! Do not frighten away our customers with your fits.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB9])
[INFO:00072C6A] ('Yes, of course you are right. Still, I would give much for even a few grains of moonsugar.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB7])
[INFO:00072E34] ('Put the thought out of your mind, and do not speak of it again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB6])
[INFO:00072D9C] ('It has been a profitable journey, and yet I long for the warm sands of Elsweyr more and more each day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB5])
[INFO:00072D08] ('I feel the same. I do not think Khajiit were made for the cold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB4])
[INFO:00072C00] ('Not only that, but these Nords have no love for us. They look upon us and see only thieves and smugglers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB2])

[INFO:00072E31] ('It is a pity, but it cannot be helped. Perhaps if we continue to show that we can be trusted, they will open their cities to our caravans.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB1])
[INFO:00072D28] ('Hah! I wish that I had your optimism.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BB0])
[INFO:00072D00] ('We have been in this land for so long, I have forgotten what it feels like to walk on warm sand.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BAF])
[INFO:00072BDD] ('Yes, I know just what you mean. My toes are numb from the cold more often than not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072BA8])
[INFO:00072DF3] ('Do you ever find that you regret making this journey?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B72])
[INFO:00072D18] ('In truth, I do not. I have always dreamed of seeing new lands, and it does not hurt that we are making a good profit.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B71])
[INFO:00072CFC] ('That is true. Perhaps I should be more grateful for this opportunity. Not many Khajiit can say that they have visited Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B6E])
[INFO:00072BD2] ('All this talk of dragons returning to the world makes me more than a little nervous.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B6D])
[INFO:00072DA0] ('Moons protect us! I hope we do not encounter one of them on the road.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B6C])
[INFO:00072D0B] ('I suppose if we do, we will find out just how fast each of us can run.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B6B])
[INFO:00072C71] ('As the saying goes, you do not need to be faster than the dragon
column5: you need only be faster than your friends.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B6A])

column4: [INFO:00072F19] ('Do you believe all this talk of dragons? Can the ancient ones truly have returned?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B69])
[INFO:00072D9D] ('I wish I could say that I did not, but in every part of Skyrim, there is talk of dragon sightings. It is no coincidence.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B68])
[INFO:00072D09] ('S'rendarr be merciful! What ill fortune that this should happen now, while we are trying to make a living.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B67])
[INFO:00072C69] ('We are fortunate. We travel lightly, and can escape at a moment's notice. We have no home that a dragon can burn to the ground.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B66])
[INFO:00072E33] ('I feel pity for these Nords. When the dragons attack cities and towns, they will lose everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B65])
[INFO:00072D9B] ('And we will lose customers. Let us hope that if there are dragons, there are only a few and they are not too foul-tempered.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B64])
[INFO:00072D01] ('I wonder if we should offer discounts to the soldiers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B63])
[INFO:00072BFF] ('The soldiers? From which side, the Stormcloaks, or the Imperials?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B62])
[INFO:00072E04] ('Both. One or the other is bound to win the war eventually. Why not curry favor now, so that the victor will look upon us kindly?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B61])

[INFO:00072D27] ('Hah, you have the foresight of a Khajiit in a sandstorm. If we offer a discount to both sides, the winners will persecute us for helping the losers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B60])
[INFO:00072CFE] ('Hm. I had not thought of it that way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B5F])
[INFO:00072BDB] ('Between the war and the return of the dragons, I wonder if we should not leave Skyrim and ply our trade elsewhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B5E])
[INFO:00072DA3] ('I admit, the dragons are a concern, but we can avoid them if we do not stay in one place for too long.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B5D])
[INFO:00072D0E] ('That may be, but what of the war? That is not so easy to escape from.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B5C])
[INFO:00072CF8] ('The war? That is not a reason to leave, it is a reason to stay.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B22])
[INFO:00072BD1] ('And what makes you think that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B1F])
[INFO:00072D9F] ('Because war is good for business, of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00072B1E])

column4: [INFO:00071765] ('All right, Delvin. What gives with that case of Shadowbanish you sold me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007175E])
[INFO:000717B7] ('What do you mean? That wine tastes finer than anythin' Surilie Brothers ever made.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007175D])
[INFO:0007176C] ('Sure, it tastes great. Only one problem. You said it can make the darkness as clear as day when you drink it. Guess what? It doesn't.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007175C])
[INFO:00071777] ('Am I responsible if the vintage was off on that case? Sorry, you know the rules Vekel. No refunds.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007175B])
[INFO:00071773] ('Puttin' together another shipment from Morrowind, Vekel. Lookin' for anythin' special?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007175A])
[INFO:000717A1] ('Well, if some Moon Sugar should fall into your lap...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071759])
[INFO:0007176D] ('Maybe. That stuff's gettin' tough to bring across the border with all the Argonian patrols.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071758])
[INFO:00071778] ('Well if it turns up, I'll be willing to buy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071757])
[INFO:00071763] ('You need to tell your boys to place nice, Delvin. Almost threw two of them into the well last night.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071756])
[INFO:00071772] ('They aren't my boys. Do I look like the leadin' type?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071755])
[INFO:000717B8] ('You know what I mean. Tell your boss that rough is rough, but when someone pulls a dagger fun time is over.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071754])
[INFO:00071769] ('I'll pass it along.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071753])
[INFO:0007177C] ('Good news. I found that dwarven hammer you were looking for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071752])
[INFO:00071767] ('You did? Thanks. I get you the rest of your coin by tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071751])
[INFO:0007176E] ('Yeah, funny thing about that. The price was a hundred higher than I expected.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071750])
[INFO:00071768] ('Vekel, you have no shame. I'll get you the rest like I said. I want that hammer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007174F])
[INFO:00071799] ('Why can't you just settle down and run the Flagon with me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007174A])
[INFO:00071761] ('I don't want to settle. I like things the way they are.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071749])
[INFO:00071764] ('Come on, Ton. Marry me. Let me take care of you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071748])
[INFO:0007176B] ('I can take care of myself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071747])
[INFO:00071770] ('How dare you! After all we've been through together? How can you do this to me!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071746])
[INFO:00071776] ('Look, I need to know. What's going on between you and Brynjolf?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071745])
[INFO:0007179A] ('That's all they are... rumors. So quit worrying.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071743])
[INFO:00071762] ('I need you to do me a favor, Dirge.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071741])
[INFO:0007176A] ('Sure, Ton. You know I'm good for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071740])
[INFO:0007175F] ('There's a new guard nosing around the meadery. Can you do something about it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007173F])
[INFO:00071766] ('Gladly. He won't bother you anymore, I promise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007173E])
[INFO:000717A0] ([R][RE]'Spare a septim?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071739])
[INFO:0007179F] ([R]'Can you spare any coin?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071739])
[INFO:0007179E] ([R]'Please, I don't have anything to eat.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071739])
[INFO:0007179D] ([R]'Please help me, I'm starving.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071739])
[INFO:0007179C] ([R]'Please my lord, can you spare a gold coin for an old woman?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071739])
[INFO:0007179B] ([R]'Please milady, can you spare a gold coin for an old woman?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071739])
[INFO:00071798] ('Get away from me, you filthy woman.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071797] ('Oh, very well. Just try and clean yourself up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071796] ('Here you go, dear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071795] ('Ugh, you reek. Get out of my way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071794] ('I've told you before, and I'll tell you again. Leave me alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071793] ('Sorry, all out of coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071792] ('Edda, Edda. There's no need for this. Just come by the temple and we'll care for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071791] ('Oh you poor thing! Come by the temple and my husband and I will keep you fed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071790] ('Here you are.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:0007178F] ('Maybe you should look for work instead of begging for coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:0007178E] ('Of course, here. Be well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:0007178D] ('Here, this should help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:0007178C] ('I would if I could, but I can barely make ends meet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:0007178B] ('Are you joking? Go earn a living and stop loafing!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:0007178A] ('Certainly, good lady. Here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071789] ('Yes, of course. This war is causing your woes, it's hardly your fault.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071788] ('Yes, I hope this helps.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071787] ('All right, all right. Here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071786] ('You must be starving. Here, spend it well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071785] ('Edda, you know well I barely have any coin to call my own. I'm sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071784] ('Go away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071738])
[INFO:00071782] ([R][RE]'I could sure use some coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071737])
[INFO:00071781] ([R]'Hey, can I get a gold or two?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071737])
[INFO:00071780] ([R]'Help out an old man here with some coin, would you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071737])
[INFO:0007177F] ([R]'If you could spare a septim, I'd be grateful.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071737])
[INFO:0007177E] ([R]'Spare a coin?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071737])
[INFO:000717B6] ('Never. Now move aside.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717B5] ('Very well, please use it for food.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717B4] ('I suppose. Just get something to eat and stay away from the Bee and Barb for a change.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717B3] ('What? No. Get away from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717B2] ('If you want to awaken from your next slumber, I suggest you leave me be.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717B1] ('Sorry, no time. I'm late.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717B0] ('Snilf, I told you begging isn't the answer. I expect to see you at the temple later.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717AF] ('Oh you poor thing, you must be starving. Come to the temple later and let us feed you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717AE] ('Very well, here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717AD] ('Ugh, you smell horrible. Get yourself cleaned up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717AC] ('Absolutely. Here you are. Be well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717AB] ('Yes, I hope this helps you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717AA] ('If I had even a pot to piss in, I'd gladly share. Sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A9] ('You're disgusting, stay away from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A8] ('Certainly, my good man. Here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A7] ('Another uncounted causality of this war. Here you are, you poor man.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A6] ('Yes, I hope this helps.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A5] ('Again? Buy some food this time will you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A4] ('Oh if only I could provide more than this coin. I hope it'll do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A3] ('Snilf, it's me. I don't have a roof over my head either, remember?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
[INFO:000717A2] ('No. Now shove off.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071736])
