column4: [INFO:000711F8] ('Why are the potions I requested not completed?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C7])
[INFO:000711F3] ('I'm sorry, milady. The components for those elixirs are quite volatile and in some cases, very dangerous to handle. I must take care.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C6])
[INFO:000711F9] ('Excuses are not acceptable in my court. When I ask for something I expect results, and I expect them immediately.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C5])
[INFO:000711D1] ('Yes, milady. Sorry, milday. They will be completed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C4])
[INFO:000711E9] ('There's still the matter of the prisoner to discuss. Now, his family is willing to contribute handsomely if we release him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C3])
[INFO:000711CF] ('The execution will proceed as planned.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C2])
[INFO:000711E6] ('But, mother... this is quite a sizable contribution and the crime doesn't befit such a harsh punishment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C1])
[INFO:00071202] ('Are you going soft on me, Hemming? Perhaps I made the wrong choice installing you as steward.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711C0])
[INFO:000711D6] ('No, mother. The execution will proceed as planned.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711BF])
[INFO:000711F4] ('Hemming, have you dispatched that letter I gave you yesterday?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711BE])
[INFO:000711D0] ('Yes, and I sent it with our fastest courier and under the cover of night, exactly as you specified.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711BD])
[INFO:000711E4] ('Good. If I need to light a few fires in order to get what we need to defend this place from the Stormcloaks, so be it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711BC])
[INFO:000711FF] ('I'm almost certain he'll reach the Imperial City tomorrow, so we should have an answer by the end of the week.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711BB])
[INFO:000711D4] ('Any word about our little problem in the Ratway?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711BA])
[INFO:000711ED] ('I've spoken to Brynjolf and he assures me it'll be taken care of.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B9])
[INFO:000711C9] ('Next time you speak to him, tell him to clean up his own messes. I'm not about to jeopardize this position for a bunch of low-life thugs.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B8])
[INFO:000711DD] ('I'll let him know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B7])
[INFO:000711E2] ('Your mother seems to have taken to her seat quite well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B6])
[INFO:000711D8] ('Yes, she's been grooming herself for this for quite a long time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B5])
[INFO:000711E1] ('It's surprising the Council is allowing a Nord rule Riften under the Imperial flag. That can't be their first choice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B4])
[INFO:000711E5] ('Let's just say my mother knows which pockets to line and keep it at that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B3])
[INFO:000711EE] ('So, have you thought about what I said?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B2])
[INFO:000711FA] ('I find the concept of sleeping with you not only repulsive, but morally unsettling. Does that answer your question?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B1])
[INFO:00071200] ('You listen to me. I'd be careful wagging that pretty little tongue at me like that otherwise I may just have it cut off.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711B0])
[INFO:00071206] ('Just stay away from me and maybe I won't weave a spell to shrink something that matters to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711AF])
[INFO:000711CB] ('Maul, can I ask a personal favor of you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711AE])
[INFO:000711D5] ('Well that depends on what the favor is, now doesn't it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711AD])
[INFO:000711DB] ('It's Hemming. He's making advances and I can't bear the man's presence. Is there anything you can do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711AC])
[INFO:000711E3] ('I'll talk to him, but he's stubborn. He's like his mother
column5: he sees what he wants and he won't quit until he has it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711AB])

column4: [INFO:000711E8] ('Anything you can do to keep his filthy hands off of me would be a welcome change.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711AA])
[INFO:000711F1] ('My agents are telling me that we've appropriated the caravan from Hammerfell... with minimal losses.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A9])
[INFO:000711F7] ('For what it's costing me, I should be handed the merchandise on a silver platter.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A8])
[INFO:000711DE] ('The coin isn't just for the men, there's a lot of people that need to be compensated in order to make this happen.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A7])
[INFO:000711F2] ('And a hefty cut for yourself too I'm sure. Just see to it the items are secured and the rest disposed of properly this time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A6])
[INFO:000711F6] ('I don't understand, Elgrim. The formulas you're giving me are for novices but I've advanced well passed that point.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A5])
[INFO:000711FE] ('Until you can do those formulas with your eyes shut, you'll never be ready to master the more difficult ones.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A4])
[INFO:00071203] ('This is an utter waste of time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A3])
[INFO:000711CE] ('Ingun! If you want to remain in my shop as an apprentice I expect you to act like one. No exceptions!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A2])
[INFO:000711D3] ('Very well, I'll keep practicing them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A1])
[INFO:000711DA] ('Ingun, you clumsy fool! You've tainted our entire supply of Painted Troll Fat. You have no idea how hard that was to get.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000711A0])
[INFO:000711E0] ('I'm sure my mother can compensate you for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007119F])
[INFO:000711EB] ('I'll draft a letter to Rythe. If you could have it sent to Cheydinhal for me, that would make up for your blunder.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007119E])
[INFO:000711F0] ('I'll make sure it's sent right away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007119D])
[INFO:000711FD] ('Niluva, you promised me you'd pay me back yesterday. So what's the story?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007119C])
[INFO:00071205] ('Just give me a few more days and I promise I'll come up with it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007119B])
[INFO:000711CD] ('If you'd stop wasting your coin on that skooma, you'd have enough gold to live on.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007119A])
[INFO:000711D2] ('Sorry, Tythis. I'll get it to you somehow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071199])
[INFO:000711D9] ('How do you do it, Valindor? How do you work at Black-Briar Meadery and the Fishery without getting exhausted?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071198])
[INFO:000711DF] ('Oh, it's not so terrible. I actually find the work quite relaxing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071197])
[INFO:000711EA] ('Relaxing? They must be working you to the bone! You should rest before you do yourself in.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071196])
[INFO:000711EC] ('Not to worry, dear Svana. I promise you I can handle it, but your concern is quite flattering.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071195])
[INFO:000711F5] ('Wujeeta, you really need to stop using that skooma. It's very bad for your health and I wouldn't want to see anything happen to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071194])
[INFO:00071201] ('I can't, Valindor. It won't let me go. It's taking over my life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071193])
[INFO:000711C8] ('It's an evil substance. Whoever's selling it to you should be brought to justice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071192])
[INFO:000711FC] ('If there was any justice in the world, I'd just get this over with and die peacefully.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071191])
[INFO:00071207] ('Wujeeta, you're worrying me. You look so... well, so sad.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071190])
[INFO:000711CC] ('Don't worry about it, Svana. It's my problem... no need for you to get involved.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007118F])
[INFO:000711D7] ('Look, if you're in some sort of trouble, I could talk to Haelga.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007118E])
[INFO:000711DC] ('No, no... please, I'm just tired is all. Thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007118D])
[INFO:000711EF] ('So how are things with you and Bolli?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007118B])
[INFO:000711FB] ('How do you think? He's a pig. All I am to him is a warm body to lay with.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0007118A])
[INFO:00071204] ('Nivenor! How can you say that? He gives you everything you ask for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071189])
[INFO:000711CA] ('If I cared for your opinion on our affairs, I'd ask. Now, if you'll excuse me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00071188])
[INFO:000BFA05] ('Bless you, friend. You have renewed my hope.' in GRUP Topic Children of Favor031GiveItemBranchTopic [DIAL:0007104D])
column8: I have your amulet.

column2: DarkContractHelpBranchTopic "Any advice on my current contract?" [DIAL:0006C3D5]

column4: [INFO:00067706] ('I think you should continue with your performances.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676DB])
[INFO:000676E8] ('What's the point? I'm not very good, and it's only for the same few people every night.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676DA])
[INFO:000676F9] ('I think you play beautifully. It would be a shame if you stopped.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D9])
[INFO:00067700] ('All right, Wilhlem. I suppose it's the least I can do for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D8])
[INFO:00067707] ('I think I saw it again. That... ghost. It was over by the barrows.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D7])
[INFO:00067716] ('That thing's evil, Lynly! I told you to keep away from there!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D6])
[INFO:000676E0] ('I'm sorry. I was curious... I didn't believe the stories. I won't go over there ever again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D5])
[INFO:000676E6] ('See that you don't. I promised to keep you safe and I'm not going to break my word.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D4])
[INFO:000676E9] ('Have you spoken to Fastred yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D3])
[INFO:000676F3] ('No. I'll tell you, Wilhelm, if I could sweep her away from here tomorrow I'd do it, but Klimmek still has so much to learn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D2])
[INFO:000676EC] ('Klimmek is doing just fine. You should follow your heart.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D1])
[INFO:000676F7] ('Perhaps one day, but not today.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676D0])
[INFO:00067701] ('You heading up to High Hrothgar soon, Klimmek?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676CF])
[INFO:00067709] ('I wish I didn't have to. It's quite a difficult climb.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676CE])
[INFO:00067719] ('Take your time then. It isn't as though the Greybeards are going to complain.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676CD])
[INFO:000676F4] ('I know, but I don't want to let them down. I guess I better start thinking about it soon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676CB])
[INFO:000676FB] ('I thought you played wonderfully last night.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676CA])
[INFO:00067703] ('Thank you Klimmek. That's too kind.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C9])
[INFO:00067714] ('Perhaps when you're finished here this evening, we could...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C8])
[INFO:000676DD] ('You're sweet. I'm just not ready for that sort of thing right now. I'm sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C7])
[INFO:000676E4] ('I heard Temba yelling at you yesterday. Why do you let her treat you like that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C6])
[INFO:000676ED] ('If you'll pardon the expression, she's far more bark than bite.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C5])
[INFO:000676F2] ('Perhaps, but abuse is abuse. I don't think I could stand it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C4])
[INFO:000676F8] ('There's much more to worry about in life then a bit of a temper, my friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C3])
[INFO:000676FD] ('Fastred, I wanted to talk with you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C2])
[INFO:000676EE] ('What is it now?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C1])
[INFO:000676FF] ('Wilhelm said he saw you speaking to one of the pilgrims on the 7,000 Steps. I told you that I didn't want you to go up there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676C0])
[INFO:00067704] ('I know what you said, but I only wanted to speak to him for a moment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676BF])
[INFO:00067708] ('You have to let Fastred follow her heart. You can't tell her what to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676BE])
[INFO:00067717] ('She's our only child, Boti. Am I to throw her to the wolves?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676BD])
[INFO:000676E1] ('You're hardly throwing her to the wolves. She just wants to see the world... just like I did when I was her age.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676BC])
[INFO:000676E7] ('And if she decides to leave Ivarstead, what then? No, no... I can't bear the thought.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676BB])
[INFO:000676EF] ('I need you to pitch in a little more around here, dear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676BA])
[INFO:000676F5] ('I help, I do the chores. What else would you have me do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B9])
[INFO:000676FC] ('I know your sights are set beyond this town, but for now, while you're under our roof, I need you to pitch in a little more.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B8])
[INFO:00067702] ('Yes, mother.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B7])
[INFO:00067715] ('We're behind again. I need you to catch another two bushels by week's end if I'm to make another delivery.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B6])
[INFO:000676DE] ('Blood from a stone, Klimmek. I've been out there every morning. They just aren't biting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B5])
[INFO:000676E3] ('Come on, everyone in town knows that you spend more time with Fastred than fishing in the river.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B4])
[INFO:000676EA] ('That's none of your business and I appreciate if you wouldn't mention it again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B3])
[INFO:000676F0] ('If you have a moment, I've come up with a few ideas I wanted to share.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B2])
[INFO:000676FA] ('I'm becoming sick to death of your ideas. Not one of them has paid off since you moved in.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B1])
[INFO:000676FE] ('Look, I'm merely suggesting a few things that could expand our business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676B0])
[INFO:00067705] ('"Our" business?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676AF])
[INFO:0006770A] ('Another batch of logs completely ruined. I swear, these bears have it out for me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676AE])
[INFO:00067718] ('I hardly think the bears are clever enough to hold a grudge against you, Miss Temba.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676AD])
[INFO:000676DF] ('When I want your opinion, I'll ask for it. Otherwise, mind your business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676AC])
[INFO:000676E5] ('Gwilin! I told you to cut those boards at twice arm length! My arm's length. Not yours.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676AB])
[INFO:000676EB] ('I'm so sorry Miss Temba. Perhaps if you would have been more specific...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676AA])
[INFO:000676F1] ('Sigh. Everyone isn't as short as you are... what good are these boards to someone of the proper height!?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676A9])
[INFO:000676F6] ('Sorry, Miss Temba.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000676A8])

[INFO:00063E3F] ('I'll see what I can do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063E00])
[INFO:00063E36] ('Brand-Shei, did you hear about Helgen? It's... it's gone! A dragon burned it to the ground!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DFF])
[INFO:00063EDE] ('Yes, I heard. I think all of Skyrim knows by know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DFE])
[INFO:00063ED5] ('Do you... do you think that could happen here? I mean, could a dragon come here and burn the city down?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DFD])
[INFO:00063ECD] ('I don't know. All we can do is hope the Eight will favor us and have these creatures stay far away from Riften.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DFC])
[INFO:00063EC5] ('Hi, Marise. How are you today?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DF6])
[INFO:00063E73] ('I'm well. How are things over at the stables? Old Hofgrir giving you a hard time?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DDE])

[INFO:00063E5A] ('Naw... he's fine. Look, I wanted to ask if you'll... um, if you'd like to... well, like to have a drink with me at the Bee and Barb sometime?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DD7])

[INFO:00063E3C] ('I have two more bushels for you, Marise. That should keep you well-stocked.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DD4])
[INFO:00063E32] ('Sounds good. May I owe you for them?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DCE])
[INFO:00063EE3] ('Of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063DBF])
[INFO:00063EDB] ('You know I can't tell you that. As soon as I do, and you have a few meads in you, everyone will know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063D45])
[INFO:00063ED2] ('Dinya? I was reading that missive you gave me and I was wondering something about marriage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063D41])
[INFO:00063EC2] ('Feel free to ask me anything you like.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063C25])
[INFO:00063E65] ('There's someone I like very much in Riften. I think I'd like to marry him someday, but... well, he's not of my kind. Would Mara be angry?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063C24])

column4: [INFO:00063AC9] ('You have strong arms. You'd make a good Orc.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A97])
[INFO:00063AD8] ('Um... thank you, Lash. You'd... make a fine Nord?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A96])
[INFO:00063AE2] ('Don't say words you don't mean.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A95])
[INFO:00063AF3] ('When are those Silver-Blood men going to leave?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A94])
[INFO:00063AFE] ('Never. They've shut us down forever, Enmon. The Divines have abandoned us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A93])
[INFO:00063AB5] ('We're doomed. The mine is going to stay closed, and we'll up be carted of to Cidhna Mine as slaves.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A92])
[INFO:00063ABE] ('Only criminals get sent to Cidhna Mine. They're not going to send us there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A91])
[INFO:00063AC7] ('Oh, they'll find some way to send us there. It'll be just my luck.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A90])
[INFO:00063ABB] ('But why did they take her? What could they want with our little girl?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A81])
[INFO:00063AD2] ('I don't know. The guards are out looking for her, now. They'll be back soon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A80])
[INFO:00063ADB] ('You keep saying that. What if she's gone forever? What if they've done something to her?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A7F])
[INFO:00063AE5] ('Are you all right, dear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A7E])
[INFO:00063AF4] ('The house is so... empty, Enmon... and quiet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A7D])
[INFO:00063AAE] ('Are you all right, dear? I thought I saw a tear in your eye a moment ago.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A7C])
[INFO:00063AB8] ('Oh, I'm fine, Enmon. I just... I still miss her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A7B])
[INFO:00063AC5] ('I miss her, too, but I'm glad she's safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A7A])
[INFO:00063AD0] ('So am I. I hope she's happy at the temple.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A79])
[INFO:00063ADD] ('Enmon, dear, do you have any regrets? About letting her go?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A78])
[INFO:00063AE8] ('No... no, we did the right thing. The temple will take good care of her, and one day she'll be helping all of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A77])
[INFO:00063AEF] ('You're right. She'll be a great Sybil, won't she?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A76])
[INFO:00063AFD] ('Of course she will. She's our daughter, after all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A75])
[INFO:00063AB4] ('I've been thinking, would you like to join me in hunting?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A74])
[INFO:00063AC2] ('You want me to hunt with you? I thought you preferred being alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A73])
[INFO:00063ACC] ('Your arms and legs are fit for catching strong, agile prey. I could use your help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A72])
[INFO:00063AD6] ('I'd be honored, but I have work to do in the mines.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A71])
[INFO:00063AE1] ('When will Sanuarach Mine be open?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A70])
[INFO:00063AF1] ('I don't know. Whenever those Silver-Blood men decide to leave.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A6F])
[INFO:00063AFC] ('I haven't seen you hunting in a while.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A6E])
[INFO:00063AB6] ('I can afford to buy meat now. I prefer working in the mines, anyway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A6D])
[INFO:00063ABF] ('Tell me, Ragnar, what do you think of the Orcs?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A6C])
[INFO:00063ACD] ('Cunning warriors and skilled workers. It's good to have you here, Lash.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A6B])
[INFO:00063AD9] ('I asked what you thought of the Orcs, not about me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A6A])
[INFO:00063AE4] ('Oh. I'm sorry. Well, it's good to have you here, anyway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A69])
[INFO:00063AF0] ('Damn Nords. Always getting in the way of us honest folk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A68])
[INFO:00063AFB] ('What did you say? You lazy coward, I'll cut your throat.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A67])
[INFO:00063AB2] ('Nothing, Ragnar. Please... don't hurt me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A66])
[INFO:00063AC1] ('I... I'm sorry, Belchimac. I didn't mean that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A65])
[INFO:00063ACE] ('You're always talking about the Forsworn. You aren't thinking of joining them, are you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A64])
[INFO:00063AD7] ('Maybe I will. What do you think about that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A63])
[INFO:00063AE3] ('I'm warning you. Those people are killers. You'd never last a day with them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A62])
[INFO:00063AED] ('I don't like bunking with Orcs. It's not... clean.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A61])
[INFO:00063AF9] ('If you want me to leave, you could challenge me to a fight. I promise to stop once you've lost an arm.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A60])
[INFO:00063AB1] ('What I meant to say was... I love having an Orc here in the barracks. They're so... pleasant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A5F])
[INFO:00063AB9] ('Why do your people claim the Reach is theirs? The Orcs have been in these lands just as long.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A5E])
[INFO:00063AC0] ('You wouldn't understand, Lash. Your people aren't smart enough for politics.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A5D])
[INFO:00063ACB] ('Is that so? I'll remember that next time we're in the mine tunnels... alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A5C])
[INFO:00063AD5] ('Did... did I say you weren't smart? I meant to say that I'm not smart, Lash. I'm just not smart enough to answer your questions.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063A5B])
[INFO:0006399B] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006399A])
[INFO:00063E54] ('No, no... not at all. Mara believes that the spark of a union comes from inside us, not from our appearance.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063953])
[INFO:00063E38] ('Marise, I've come to warn you that the Thieves Guild has been harassing shopkeepers again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063952])

[INFO:00063ED7] ('I hope that doesn't mean things are going to get worse around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063950])
[INFO:00063ECF] ('Mjoll! I'm glad I found you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006394F])
[INFO:00063EC8] ('What is it, Drifa? What's the matter?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006394E])

[INFO:00063EBD] ('It's Bersi. He's getting so angry about the corruption in Riften, he said he's going to walk right up to Maven and give her a piece of his mind.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006394D])
[INFO:00063E5F] ('If I see him, I'll make sure he doesn't do anything brash. Don't worry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006394C])
[INFO:00063E49] ('Have you prepared the stables like I suggested, Shadr?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006394B])
[INFO:00063E3E] ('Yes, Lady Mjoll. If Riften gets attacked, we'll retreat inside the city gates and bar the door just like you said.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006394A])
[INFO:00063E35] ('Good. You could be our first line of defense since you live outside the city walls, so we're depending on you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006391A])
[INFO:00063EE5] ('Hello Bolli. How's the fishing?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000638B9])
[INFO:00063EDD] ('Bountiful. Although I would like to have anchored a bit closer to Goldenglow Estate.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006389A])
[INFO:00063ED4] ('Why didn't you then?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063895])
[INFO:00063ECC] ('When I got close, the mercenaries Aringoth hired to protect the estate just waved me off. I don't think he wants visitors anymore.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063894])
[INFO:00063EC4] ('Nivenor, my darling. What a pleasant surprise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063891])
[INFO:00063E72] ('Oh! Bolli... yes, hello.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063890])
[INFO:00063E57] ('Will we be dining together this evening after my work at the fishery?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006386C])
[INFO:00063E45] ('Sigh. Yes, as usual. I'll be there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006386A])
[INFO:00063E39] ('So, Tythis... you coming by the Bunkhouse later?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063869])

[INFO:00063EE2] ('I have plenty of room in my bed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0006385E])
[INFO:0006382C] ('I want you sellswords out of my mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063829])
[INFO:00063832] ('Watch your tongue, native. We'll leave when we're sure there's no Forsworn here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00063828])

column4: [INFO:0005FA34] ('Thanks, Grelka!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F5AB])
[INFO:0005F9EC] ('So while I was in Ivarstead, I heard news that something terrible happened at Helgen.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F5AA])
[INFO:0005F97D] ('You've heard too? They say the town was completely destroyed by a dragon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F5A9])
[INFO:0005F8D1] ('If that's true, then we have much more to fear than the Thieves Guild.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F5A4])
[INFO:0005F873] ('I'd still keep an eye on my purse if I was you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F597])
[INFO:0005F83E] ('Dinya, about that incense you requested? Its not arriving anytime soon. The Khajiit caravans are having tough times getting through.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F593])
[INFO:0005F7BE] ('That's a shame. What's causing them all the trouble?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F570])
[INFO:0005F6E3] ('There's the stories about Helgen, bandits, skirmishes between the Stormcloaks and the Imperials... it almost seems endless.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F564])
[INFO:0005FA5E] ('Chin up, Brand-Shei. Lady Mara will provide us strength and guidance through these difficult times.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F551])
[INFO:0005FA3A] ('Has the Thieves Guild visited you yet, Haelga?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F54F])
[INFO:0005FA30] ('They haven't been by the Bunkhouse, but I'm certain they will. How about you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F54E])
[INFO:0005F981] ('No. I'm surprised actually. I thought they had a stranglehold on the city, but in the last few years, it hasn't been that bad.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F54C])
[INFO:0005F970] ('Perhaps they moved on to greener pastures. Whatever the reason, lets be glad they're scarce.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F548])
[INFO:0005F858] ('Well met, Brand-Shei. I've come by to browse your wares today.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F542])
[INFO:0005F7D6] ('Is it true you chased a thief from your home? I overheard Aerin mentioning it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F541])
[INFO:0005F73D] ('It's true. Wasn't much of a thief though. Made enough noise to wake the Red Mountain.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F540])
[INFO:0005FB10] ('Good. Maybe that will teach them to leave honest citizens alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F53C])
[INFO:0005FA54] ('Brand-Shei... have you managed to find those boots for me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F53B])
[INFO:0005FA35] ('What's with all the boots and shoes you keep buying? You must have bought twenty pairs in the last two years.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F530])

[INFO:0005F9EF] ('Always be prepared. You never know if you might get a split in one, or lose one, then where would you be? No sir, that's not happening to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F52C])
[INFO:0005F97E] ('Um... okay. Well, the boots aren't here yet. Hopefully on the next Khajiit caravan.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F52B])
[INFO:0005F8E5] ('Thanks for that bushel of apples, Marise. They're wonderful. How did you keep them so fresh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F52A])
[INFO:0005F84C] ('Can't tell you. It's a bit of a trade secret I picked up when I was living in High Rock.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F522])
[INFO:0005F70A] ('Well, whatever you're doing, keep doing it and you'll have me as a customer for life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F51B])
[INFO:0005FA6D] ('I'm afraid it's going to be a while before I can get any more Goldenglow Honey.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F515])
[INFO:0005FA4C] ('I thought it was strange that Aringoth stopped coming into town. I suppose he's having some difficulties out there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4BE])
[INFO:0005FA33] ('May I ask what all the honey's for? I mean, you used to buy almost a jar a week. Are you cooking or something?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4AB])
[INFO:0005F9EB] ('In a manner of speaking.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4AA])
[INFO:0005F97B] ('Hey. What's the matter with you? You have no right to spread rumors around town about me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A9])
[INFO:0005F872] ('What rumors?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A8])
[INFO:0005F816] ('You know very well what I'm talking about. You're saying that I only married Bolli for his gold and that I don't really love him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A7])
[INFO:0005F73F] ('Well, if the shoe fits...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A6])
[INFO:0005FB1A] ('Oh! Miss Maven. What can I do for you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A5])
[INFO:0005FA5D] ('Relax, Marise... I have no quarrel with you. I just wish to speak a moment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A4])
[INFO:0005FA37] ('Yes?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A1])
[INFO:0005F9F0] ('You watch the market, you hear the rumors around Riften. What have you heard about these dragons?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F4A0])
[INFO:0005F980] ('I heard a traveler say that Helgen was destroyed by one of those creatures. Didn't leave a soul alive they said.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F49F])
[INFO:0005F937] ('Interesting. Keep your ears open for me and tell me if you hear anything more. I'll make it worth your while.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F49E])
[INFO:0005F894] ('Maven. How's the criminal underworld treating you this fine day?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F49D])
[INFO:0005F84E] ('You may have everyone else impressed around here, but you don't impress me. You couldn't touch me if you wanted to.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F49A])
[INFO:0005F7D5] ('You're a cold, unfeeling bitch.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F475])
[INFO:0005F73B] ('My dear, you have no idea who you're trifling with. Now I suggest you turn around and rattle someone else's cage before you get hurt.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F420])
[INFO:0005FB0D] ('I'm watching you, Maven Black-Briar. One day, you'll slip up and your Imperial friends won't be there to catch your fall.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F41F])
[INFO:0005F6D9] ('At this loss...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005F09B])
[INFO:0005F1AC] ('We weep.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EF62])
[INFO:0005F129] ('We weep.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EF24])
[INFO:0005F565] ('We weep.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EF20])

[INFO:0005EE53] ('I'm sorry you disapprove, father. But I've made up my mind. I'm not a warrior, I'm a businessman.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED95])
[INFO:0005EDAB] ('The only reason you have the gold for your "business" is because I gave it to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED89])
[INFO:0005EDA2] ('I'll pay you back, if it means that much.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED88])
[INFO:0005EE52] ('It's not about the coin, it's about honoring your legacy by picking up arms and keeping this land free.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED87])
[INFO:0005EE50] ('Haelga, we need to stop seeing each other.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED81])
[INFO:0005EE4D] ('Oh, Bolli you silly man. You weren't saying that when you were licking that honey off my...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED73])
[INFO:0005EE49] ('Haelga! That's just it. I can't keep up with you. Your Dibellan techniques... they're exhausting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED72])
[INFO:0005EE46] ('Is it really me, or is it your wife? You need to make a choice Bolli. The honey or her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED71])
[INFO:0005EE44] ('When are you going to take me away from here Bolli?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED70])
[INFO:0005EE42] ('I told you, I can't just pick up and leave. I have my wife, my business... not to mention you have the Bunkhouse.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005ED2E])
[INFO:0005EDAA] ('That old place? I could care less about it. Its you I want, Bolli.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB58])
[INFO:0005EDA1] ('I... I'm sorry Haelga, I can't. Not yet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB57])
[INFO:0005EE51] ('Sometimes I'm not certain that the people of Riften want to be helped.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB4A])
[INFO:0005EE4F] ('I think some of them do, Lady Mjoll. They're just too frightened to step up and do something about it like you are.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB43])
[INFO:0005EE4C] ('Aerin, you never cease to amaze me. You always see the good in everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB22])
[INFO:0005EE4A] ('It's only because I've had an excellent teacher.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB1F])
[INFO:0005F3FF] ('Gretta, Engar, stay and guard the entrance. We don't want any Imperial reinforcements taking us by surprise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB1B])
[INFO:0005EE48] ('So, what do you think of my plan. You in or out?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB12])
[INFO:0005EB13] ('This is the bridge out of town. The path up the mountain to the northwest leads to Bleak Falls Barrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EB11])
[INFO:0005F402] ('The rest of you lot are with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAB9])
[INFO:0005EE45] ('If you think I'd would make a move like that without asking Maven, you're out of your mind. Doing that would be a fatal mistake.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAB3])
[INFO:0005EE43] ('Come on, think about it. She'd reward us!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAB2])
[INFO:0005EDC0] ('If you want to go out to Whiterun and burn that meadery down, go right ahead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAB0])
[INFO:0005EDA9] ('I'm telling you, Vulwulf, it's the investment you've been waiting for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAAF])
[INFO:0005EE54] ('So I pay for the weapon shipments and you oversee their distribution to the Stormcloaks?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAAC])
[INFO:0005EE4E] ('Exactly. What better way to help the cause than to put weapons into the hands of young Nord warriors dying for their homeland?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAAB])
[INFO:0005EE4B] ('Shor's Beard! You're right! I'll do it... provided you supervise the shipments personally.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAA9])
[INFO:0005EE47] ('Don't worry, I'll treat those shipments as if I owned them myself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005EAA7])

[INFO:0005F519] ('Everyone else, with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E835])
[INFO:0005E2FE] ('Yes, my lord.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2EE])
[INFO:0005E2F6] ('No, my lord. It was just circling overhead when I left. I never ran so fast in my life... I thought it would come after me for sure.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2EC])
[INFO:0005E2FD] ('Good work, son. We'll take it from here. Head down to the barracks for some food and rest. You've earned it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2EB])
[INFO:0005E2FB] ('Irileth, you'd better gather some guardsmen and get down there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2EA])
[INFO:0005E2F7] ('I've already ordered my men to muster near the main gate.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2E9])
[INFO:0005E2F8] ('One last thing, Irileth. This isn't a death or glory mission. I need to know what we're dealing with.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2E7])
[INFO:0005E2FC] ('Good. Don't fail me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2E4])
[INFO:0005E2C9] ('Keeping busy, Sergius?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2BF])
[INFO:0005E2C0] ('As always. The Nords don't ever stop wanting things enchanted.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2BE])
[INFO:0005E2CC] ('At least it's more money for the College.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2BD])
[INFO:0005E2C2] ('Perhaps, but it just means more work for me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2BC])
[INFO:0005E2C4] ('Do you think you might, err, have a moment to look at something for me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2BB])
[INFO:0005E2D0] ('If this is another dwarven trinket, I keep telling you I'm not familiar with them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2BA])
[INFO:0005E2C5] ('Yes, I just thought perhaps you'd have, err, come across something like this before.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B9])
[INFO:0005E2C1] ('Why, because I'm a Dunmer? We didn't all grow up in dwarven ruins, you know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B8])
[INFO:0005E2D5] ('Well, err, yes. Sorry to have troubled you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B7])
[INFO:0005E2CB] ('Hello, Nirya.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B6])
[INFO:0005E2C7] ('Don't even talk to me, Gane.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B5])
[INFO:0005E2D1] ('Ah, err, yes. Sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B4])
[INFO:0005E2C3] ('I've had yet another complaint. Please stop barging in on experiments in progress.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B3])
[INFO:0005E2CD] ('My dear, I am merely observing the proceedings.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B2])
[INFO:0005E2CF] ('Well then "observe" from a greater distance. You're making people uncomfortable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B1])
[INFO:0005E2D4] ('How are you, Drevis?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2B0])
[INFO:0005E2C6] ('Ugh. What do you want?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2AF])
[INFO:0005E2D3] ('Why should I want anything? Why can't I simply be sociable with my colleagues?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2AE])
[INFO:0005E2C8] ('I'm busy right now, Colette.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2AD])
[INFO:0005E2CA] ('Well, then. Fine. Have a nice day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2AC])
[INFO:0005E2D2] ('What are you up to, Gane? Hmm?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005E2AB])

[INFO:00083258] ([R]'The Empire would have us become slaves to the Thalmor. We are not slaves. We are men. Free men who will slay anyone who begs to differ.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:00083257] ([R]'Look deeply into the faces of the warriors around you. These are the true sons and daughters of Skyrim. See her strength and nobility in their eyes.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:00083252] ([R]'Unblooded.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:00083251] ([R][RE]'We stand out here in the cold, as brothers, warmed by the knowledge that we fight for the rights of every free citizen of the Empire.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083250] ([R]'On the coldest of nights, in the steam rising from my breath, I see the many faces of the dead.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0008324F] ([R]'Every Legionnaire's secret weapon lies in this: knowledge of himself. And like any blade, he must be forged between the hammer and the anvil.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0008324E] ([R]'Ulfric would expunge from Skyrim citizens whose only crime was to be born of a non-Nordic woman. That is unacceptable to free men everywhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0008324D] ([R]'Were the Stormcloaks to prevail in dismantling Imperial rule in Skyrim, who would be her protector? No. We will crush this rebellion. We must do.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0008324C] ([R]'The Empire is man's last bastion. If Ulfric wasn't blinded by lust for power, he'd see we are on the same side.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0008324B] ([R]'In these grave times each Legionnaire must be his better self at all times and under all conditions.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0008324A] ([R]'General Tullius expects much of me, and thus I expect much of my men.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083249] ([R]'Skyrim is the birth place of the Empire. We won't let a bunch of thugs rob her of her lineage.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083248] ([R]'Legate.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083247] ([R]'Tribune.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083246] ([R]'Praefect.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083245] ([R]'Quaestor.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:00083244] ([R]'Auxiliary.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B41E] ([R]'If there was someone else Ulfric could trust with all this planning nonsense, I'd be out there breaking heads with the rest of you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B41D] ([R]'When we've reclaimed our homeland from the Imperials, we'll take the fight to the Thalmor. They are the true enemy. Make no mistake.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B41C] ([R]'Countless dead haunt countless sleepless nights... when Skyrim becomes whole again, perhaps so will I.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B41B] ([R]'Some say Ulfric desires to be king and nothing more... have they not seen that his anger floats on a sea of tears?' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B41A] ([R]'The Empire is weak. That is why we fight them. Skyrim must be ruled by the strong.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B418] ([R]'The Empire would have us become their slaves as they have become slaves to the Thalmor. I will not live as a slave, nor will I die as one.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B416] ([R]'What will Skyrim have become if her children submitted to tyranny?' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B415] ([R]'My hatred for the Empire is exceeded only by my hatred for their witch-elf puppet-masters.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B408] ([R]'That godless Emperor can shove his damn treaty into the steaming nether-reaches of my you-know-where.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B407] ([R]'Sometimes I wonder if Ulfric understands what I'm dealing with out here.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B406] ([R]'Always good to see someone I can trust.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B3D4] ([R]'Sometimes I miss being out there in the middle of the action.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B3D3] ([R]'When we destroy the rebellion, perhaps the Thalmor will call off their damned inquisitions. It's just making things worse.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B3D2] ([R]'What I do, I do for Skyrim and her people.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B3D1] ([R]'Sometimes I wonder if the gods have abandoned us... as we have abandoned them.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B3D0] ([R]'Damnit! Why can't Ulfric see he's tearing Skyrim to pieces?' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B3CF] ([R]'I don't fight for the glory of the Empire, nor do I glory in the death of my kinsmen. I fight to bring peace and order to my homeland.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

[INFO:0005B3CE] ([R]'Stormcloaks... even the name of their rebellion stinks of Ulfric's vanity. He wants to be king. That's all this is about. One man's ambition.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B3CD] ([R]'Ulfric... what have you done my old friend?' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B3CC] ([R]'The sooner we end this rebellion, the sooner I'll be able to sleep at night.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])
[INFO:0005B3CB] ([R]'The general expects so much with so little.' in GRUP Topic Children of CWDialogueHellos [DIAL:0005B2D2])

column4: [INFO:0005B262] ('Did I ever tell you about the day when Skald the Elder was Skald the Younger?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B22B])
[INFO:0005B26A] ('I can't imagine Skald ever being young.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B22A])
[INFO:0005B260] ('Oh, he was young, and handsome. I had half a mind to go after him, myself, before I met my husband.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B229])
[INFO:0005B26C] ('Frida, you aren't saying....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B228])
[INFO:0005B275] ('I was a beauty in my day, dearie. Don't act so surprised.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B227])
[INFO:0005B27A] ('Dawnstar has always held its own against the bandits and wild animals of the Pale.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B226])
[INFO:0005B248] ('Did you ever have to fight off bandits, Frida? Like in your stories?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B225])
[INFO:0005B251] ('Why, I once fought alongside your father when we were both younger. Saved him from getting his fool head sliced off.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B224])
[INFO:0005B257] ('Who were you fighting against?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B223])
[INFO:0005B261] ('Oh, dearie, it was so long ago. But I do remember the celebration we had afterwards. Mead never tasted so good.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B222])
[INFO:0005B264] ('Thoring, do you remember the time when that wolf pack come clamoring into town?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B221])
[INFO:0005B26D] ('How could I forget? That old alpha male almost took off my leg.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B220])
[INFO:0005B273] ('Never did find out why they came sprawling into town like that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B21F])
[INFO:0005B279] ('Animals in the Pale don't need a reason to attack Dawnstar. It's just their nature.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B21E])
[INFO:0005B27E] ('Now, who was it that kidnapped the Jarl's son 20 years ago?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B21D])
[INFO:0005B250] ('You mean Hildolf the Skull-Splitter? Remember when we rounded up the townspeople and dragged him out of that cave?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B21C])
[INFO:0005B256] ('Those were the days. I'd never seen my husband fight so bravely before.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B21B])
[INFO:0005B25A] ('Aye, to your husband. Divines bless his memory.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B21A])
[INFO:0005B265] ('Tough day at the mines. I swear the ore is getting harder to dig.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B219])
[INFO:0005B26E] ('You're just getting older.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B218])
[INFO:0005B276] ('That's why I come here to talk to you. You're all heart.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B217])
[INFO:0005B27B] ('You should quit working in the Eastern Mine. Leigelf's no good to work for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B216])
[INFO:0005B24A] ('Leigelf is a good man, and I'm not running out on him now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B215])
[INFO:0005B253] ('Oh, got a bit of an interest in your boss do you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B214])
[INFO:0005B25D] ('No, not that it's any of your business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0005B213])

[INFO:00034706] ([R]'We're bound to find some gold in these ruins, but out of respect, let's leave a few coins for the dead.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00034705] ([R]'Look at this craftsmanship! These old halls fill some folk with dread, but as a Nord, they fill me with pride.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00034704] ([R]'There's a lot of history in a place like that. I'll bet these walls could tell some amazing stories.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00034703] ([R]'The ancient Nords were a savage people, but they built some remarkable crypts and temples.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00034702] ([R]'Keep your eyes open for traps. Old ruins like this are usually filled with them.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00034701] ([R]'Remember to check behind you every once in a while. Who knows what might try to sneak up on us.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00034700] ([R]'These ruins might be interesting if I wasn't already an expert on Nordic history.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346FF] ([R]'I suppose you intend to carry off every item of value in these ruins.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346FE] ([R]'Do try not to set off any traps, will you?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346FD] ([R]'If these ruins frighten you, take comfort in the knowledge that I am here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346FC] ([R]'I wonder what the ancient Nords did in these ruins. Unspeakable sacrifices, maybe?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346FB] ([R]'I'll bet some of these artifacts would fetch a good price. I hope they're not cursed.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346FA] ([R]'I could have sworn I heard something right behind us.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346F9] ([R]'They say ruins like these are filled with treasure. Of course, they're filled with traps, too.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346F8] ([R]'Do not ask me to take treasures from this place. I will not risk the anger of the dead.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346F7] ([R]'Few would dare to trespass in these ruins. What you lack in wisdom, you make up for in courage.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000346F6] ([R]'I feel the eyes of angry spirits upon us. We are not welcome here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028585] ([R]'It is strange to think that these chambers were once home to the ancient Nords.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD837] ([R]'Do you think we'll find gold nuggets in here?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD836] ([R]'I'll take a sword or mace over a pick axe any day.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD835] ([R]'Wonder what they mine from these walls.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD834] ([R]'Hard to believe people actually have to work in places like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028579] ([R]'It seems warmer down here than it was outside.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028593] ([R]'I've half a mind to grab a pickaxe and start digging. Never know what you might find.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028592] ([R]'There's an old maid's tale that says our ancestors dug these mines with their bare hands.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028591] ([R]'It takes uncommon strength to work the mines in Skyrim. The earth here is cold and hard, like the heart of a Nord.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028590] ([R]'You know what I miss the most right now? Fresh air.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002858F] ([R]'I'm already looking forward to getting back above ground.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002858E] ([R]'I've heard that miners sometimes die from poisonous gases trapped beneath the ground.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002858D] ([R]'Not for all the gold in Skyrim would I spend my life working in these tunnels.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002858C] ([R]'Let's hope the miners didn't unearth anything besides precious stones, if you take my meaning.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002858B] ([R]'I wonder what they were mining down here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002858A] ([R]'Let's try not to make too much noise. I've heard that cave-ins can start that way.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028589] ([R]'Are you sure you wouldn't rather explore, say, a nice tavern?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028588] ([R]'It would be easy for someone -- or something -- to sneak up on us down here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028587] ([R]'Wouldn't it be something if we found a vein of gold?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028586] ([R]'My nose and mouth are so full of dust, I can hardly breath.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000BC17E] ([R]'By the gods, let this mine be small so we can be done with it quickly.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028583] ([R]'The cloying air in this place is almost unbearable.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028582] ([R]'The fewer of these mines we venture into, the happier I'll be.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028581] ([R]'These earthen passages do not agree with me. I already miss the wind and sky.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028580] ([R]'I wonder how many poor souls have lost their lives working these tunnels.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002857F] ([R]'In a mine, the poor man labors to find precious stones that only the rich man can afford.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD833] ([R]'It feels like a whole mountain of rock is above  us.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD832] ([R]'How deep is this cave?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD831] ([R]'It's kind of dark in here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000CD830] ([R]'Caves sounded more exciting in the bard's songs.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002857E] ([R]'When I was a boy, my friends and I used to play "seek the wumpus" in caves much like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002857B] ([R]'I have to admit, I admire your courage. Most folk in Skyrim wouldn't go near a place like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028573] ([R]'If a man can't feel at home in a freezing cave, then he isn't truly a Nord.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028570] ([R]'There are strange echoes in these caves. Keep you eyes open.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002856E] ([R]'At times like this, I truly appreciate the joys of a warm fire and a stiff drink.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028555] ([R]'Gods willing, we'll find a chest full of gold in one of these chambers.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028552] ([R]'Would it be foolish to stop for a while and light a fire? I suppose it would.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028549] ([R]'This cold is unbearable. It's all I can do not to shiver until my teeth rattle.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028547] ([R]'Are you sure you can find your way? It would be easy to get lost in here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028545] ([R]'Don't go stopping for a nap. If you fall asleep in this place, you'll never wake up.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002850F] ([R]'Mind your step. I think I spied a patch of ice on the floor.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:0002850D] ([R]'Take extra care you don't hit your head on a low-hanging bit of stone.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028509] ([R]'Gods, I'd hate to lose my footing in a place like this. A fall on this stony floor will break bones.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028507] ([R]'If this cold numbs my fingers any worse, I'll scarcely be able to hold a weapon.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028506] ([R]'Curse this chill! I should have dressed more warmly.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028505] ([R]'By the Nine, I'd pay good money for a pint of ale to warm my bones!' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:00028504] ([R]'Careful. Our footsteps will echo in every chamber and tunnel.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000284FE] ([R]'I do not envy those creatures that make a home in such cold, dark places as this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000284F8] ([R]'There is an unnatural chill in the air. Some evil power is at work in this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16C4] ([R]'As we walk these stone passages, we delve into the very bones of the earth.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E16C3] ([R][RE]'People say Skyrim is one of the most dangerous places in Tamriel. I think they're wrong... it's magnificent and I'm proud to call it home.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16C2] ([R]'My mother was a strong woman... she's the one who instructed me on my swordfighting techniques. Can you imagine?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E16C1] ([R]'My father wanted me to follow in his footsteps as a hunter, but I set my aspirations a bit higher. He never complained... I miss him.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E16C0] ([R]'I love the cold air... it's exhilarating. Perhaps it's because of my Nord blood, but there's something about it that makes me feel alive.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E16BF] ([R]'When I was young, I'd journey with my father on hunting expeditions into Morrowind. The cliff racers made for excellent sport.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16BE] ([R]'I've seen enough death to last three lifetimes, yet I never tire of a good fight. What do you make of that?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16BD] ([R]'I remember a cutpurse trying to rob me on the road once. When I drew Grimsever, I think the poor man soiled his armor!' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E16BC] ([R]'You should have seen me at the height of my adventuring career... I was fearless and took too many risks. But that's what it was all about.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16BB] ([R]'I've never been a sellsword... never traded my skills for pay. I've always adventured on my own terms.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16BA] ([R]'I've really missed traveling like this. Walking the breadth of Skyrim has always filled my heart with excitement.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B9] ([R]'Exploring these caves feels like coming home. I missed this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B8] ([R]'Keep your eyes open, I don't like the looks of this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B7] ([R]'I'm certain we'll find some treasure down here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B6] ([R]'Killed my first creature in a cave just like this... I'll never forget it.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B5] ([R]'I've ventured into quite a few Nord ruins in my day.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B4] ([R]'There could be Draugr about, I can smell the decay in the air.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B3] ([R]'Can you just imagine how ancient this place must be? Hundreds of years? Thousands?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B2] ([R]'Danger's about, I can tell. Be cautious.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B1] ([R]'I almost died in a ruin just like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16B0] ([R]'Mzinchaleft. I swore I'd never return here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16AF] ([R]'The dwarves were masters at subterranean construction... these ruins show  only a fraction of their capabilities.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16AE] ([R]'Watch the walls for the sphere constructs... they can appear in the blink of an eye.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16AD] ([R]'These are the most dangerous, but the most profitable types of ruins. The dwarves must have been a prosperous race.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16AC] ([R]'Keep your eyes open for ambushes. These forts have too many blind corners.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16AB] ([R]'If fought more than my share of bandits in places like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16AA] ([R]'Perhaps we can find some treasure if we search the grounds of the fort thoroughly.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A9] ([R]'Bandits... the worst type of scum.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A8] ([R]'These bandits would stab each other in the back if it meant an extra coin in their pockets.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A7] ([R]'I hope there's more bandits around... their numbers could use a little more thinning.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E16A6] ([R]'When I was a child, my village was burned to the ground by bandits. Do you know I actually saw one laugh as he ran my brother through...' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A5] ([R]'Ugh, Draugr. They reek of decay.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A4] ([R]'Many have fallen in this crypt. The Draugr show no mercy.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A3] ([R]'If there's one thing I'm certain of, it's that draugr burn like tinder. We could use that to our advantage.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A2] ([R]'Ugh... dark sorcery. Always makes my skin crawl.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A1] ([R]'Kill these casters as fast as you can, otherwise they may summon creatures we don't want to deal with.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E16A0] ([R]'Be aware of rune traps on the ground or else this could be a very short expedition.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E169F] ([R]'Don't let the vampires strike you or else you may get infected with their blood poisoning.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E169E] ([R]'Vampires... an unclean lot. It will be a pleasure to clear this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E169D] ([R]'It feels good to walk the streets of Riften again.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E169C] ([R]'My mother always loved the sea. When I was young, we'd visit Solitude and watch the ships from the bluff. Ah... better times.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E169B] ([R]'This is the first time I've set foot in Windhelm. What a dreary place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E169A] ([R]'Whiterun is a such beautiful city. Have you ever seen the likes of this place?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1699] ([R]'Incredible... imagine the manpower and ingenuity needed to carve the buildings of Markarth.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1698] ([R]'Ah, Winterhold. I've always wanted to visit this place. The secrets locked inside must be astounding.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1697] ([R]'When the weather permitted, Aerin and I would often walk the Rift's forests. The trees here are so beautiful.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E1696] ([R]'I've been to Ivarstead a few times, but never climbed High Hrothgar. I wouldn't mind visiting the monastery at the summit.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E1695] ([R]'The Greybeards are an amazing lot. Imagine, living your entire life without speaking to a friend or a loved one. I couldn't stand it.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1694] ([R][RE]'It's wonderful to be able to sleep soundly, don't you think?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E1693] ([R]'I've been enjoying this journey with you. Not for the wealth we've accumulated, but just being carry Mara's will to every corner of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E1692] ([R]'My parents are long dead, but they lived wonderful lives... I have no sad stories to tell about them. Perhaps one day I'll visit their resting place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1691] ([R]'I've never admitted this before, but I've killed more than I care to admit. I'll just leave it at that.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1690] ([R]'It was a bit difficult to come to the ways of Mara at first, but my fellow priests were kind and quite patient with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E168F] ([R]'Finding Mara was the greatest moment of my life. I'll never forget the warmth that spread through my heart when we embraced.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E168E] ([R]'After running from Nightcaller Temple, I wandered Skyrim for years until I was taken in by a priest of Mara who lived in Morthal.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E168D] ([R]'I've always felt a great deal of guilt running from Nightcaller Temple and leaving my friends to die. I'll never forgive myself for that.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E168C] ([R]'I was recruited as an acolyte of Vaermina as a young elf. I had no real childhood to speak of... we weren't permitted to socialize.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E168B] ([R]'I've done a lot of... questionable things in my life. Serving Vaermina was a horrible mistake, and I hope Mara will forgive me one day.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E168A] ([R]'I don't know what persuaded you to assist me when we met in Dawnstar, but I'm glad you did.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1689] ([R]'I don't like the looks of this place... not at all.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1688] ([R]'Trust in Mara... she'll protect us in this dark place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1687] ([R]'These caves... they harbor ill omens, I can sense it.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1686] ([R]'Why anything would chose to reside down here is beyond me.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1685] ([R]'These ruins are old, maybe a thousand years or more.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1684] ([R]'Watch yourself, these Nordic ruins are notorious for their traps.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1683] ([R]'Ugh, this place... horrible.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1682] ([R]'What a marvel of engineering. The ancient Nords were ingenious builders.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1681] ([R]'This place could be massive... very easy to get lost. We have to be careful not to lose our way.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1680] ([R]'Did you hear that? A metal on stone sound... hmmm, perhaps it was nothing.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E167F] ([R]'I've never been inside a dwarven ruin. They are simply astounding.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E167E] ([R]'I can't imagine what happened to the dwarves. How could a race with the capability to build a place like this simply vanish?' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E167D] ([R]'I served as a healer in a fort not unlike this one long ago.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E167C] ([R]'When I was a young acolyte of Vaermina, I paid my dues in a shrine located within the catacombs of a fort in Cyrodiil.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1675] ([R]'I thought I heard footsteps. Be careful.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1674] ([R]'Bandits are the worst lot. They'd steal from their own mothers given the chance.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E1673] ([R]'A group of bandits descended on Dawnstar once... if it wasn't for the guard, who knows what they could have done to the place.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1670] ([R]'Bandits know nothing of pity or mercy. No need to show them any either.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1668] ([R]'The thought of the dead rising... makes me sick to my stomach.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E165D] ([R]'These poor souls... suffering in eternal servitude.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E165C] ([R]'This place must be cleansed. These draugr were once living beings and they deserve better.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1648] ([R]'I've seen my share of black magic, but that's all in the past now.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E1644] ([R]'Let's try and stay together, the sorcerers in these places tend to... well, harvest bodies for parts.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E15D9] ([R]'Being a priest of Vaermina put me very close to dark sorcery at its worst.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])
[INFO:000E15D4] ([R]'Vampires are utter abominations. We need to do everything in our power to destroy them.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:000E15D0] ([R]'A good friend of mine was infected by a vampire long ago. He killed himself rather than change into one of those... things.' in GRUP Topic Children of HirelingIdles [DIAL:00055DEB])

[INFO:00051AE2] ('This is an exciting opportunity for us. To be able to study such an early civilization, and the magics they used...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051ABE])
[INFO:00051AC4] ('Well, this is highly unusual. And very interesting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051ABB])
[INFO:00051AD8] ('Why in the world would this be sealed off? What is this place?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051ABA])
[INFO:00051AD7] ('What do you think we'll find in there?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB9])
[INFO:00051ACD] ('It's thousands of years old. Who knows what we might find?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB8])
[INFO:00051ACC] ('I'm betting bodies. Lots and lots of bodies. And maybe some valuables...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB7])
[INFO:00051AC3] ('Don't get any ideas. We're here on official business, remember?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB6])
[INFO:00051AC2] ('Are you excited to see what's in there? This is important to you Nords, isn't it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB5])
[INFO:00051AD4] ('Not excited, no. Some very bad things happened here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB4])
[INFO:00051AD6] ('Oh, right. That whole thing with the elves. Well, it all worked out in the end, didn't it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB3])
[INFO:00051AC7] ('I think, given the state of Skyrim, some might disagree.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB2])
[INFO:00051AD0] ('This is a little creepy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB1])
[INFO:00051AC9] ('That doesn't begin to describe it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AB0])
[INFO:00051AD5] ('You seem uncomfortable being here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AAF])
[INFO:00051ACA] ('I just don't know that it's right for us to be in here like this, picking through the ruins .' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AAE])
[INFO:00051AD1] ('I'm not sure what I was expecting, but this isn't it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AAD])
[INFO:00051AC8] ('There's no gold, nothing shiny at all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AAC])
[INFO:00051AD3] ('Don't sound so disappointed. You wouldn't be allowed to take it even if there was.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AAB])
[INFO:00051AC5] ('Like anyone would even notice, in all this mess.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00051AAA])
