[INFO:00046D7B] ('Sigh. Very well. You're lucky Maramal has placed me in a very forgiving mood.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D42])
[INFO:00046D7C] ('Wujeeta, you can't keep showing up here late. Bolli's just going to get someone to replace you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D41])
[INFO:00046D79] ('No, no, no. I need this job! This is the last place in town to have work.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D40])
[INFO:00046D72] ('There's always the Thieves Guild.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D3F])
[INFO:00046D6C] ('What was that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D3E])
[INFO:00046D8A] ('Nothing, nothing. Just straighten yourself out before you find yourself headed back to Black Marsh.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D3D])
[INFO:00046D6A] ('Maven! Always a pleasure to receive you. What can I help you with today?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D3C])
[INFO:00046D74] ('Thank you, Laila. I wanted to discuss the protection of my shipments.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D3B])
[INFO:00046D73] ('Yes, indeed. An entire caravan shipment of your mead taken by Imperial soldiers. What of it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D3A])

[INFO:00046D7F] ('Well, I'm also certain you're aware that our own city guard failed to provide the protection required to ensure safe passage of the shipment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D39])
[INFO:00046D80] ('Indeed. We lost three soldiers in that attack. A sad day for Riften.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D38])
[INFO:00046D78] ('Quite. To be brief, I need compensation for the lost shipment. Since Riften was responsible for it, Riften should pay for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D37])
[INFO:00046D92] ('We... don't have enough to...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D36])
[INFO:00046D77] ('Laila, Riften is my home, but if my meadery can't be safe here, I'll just move it elsewhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D35])
[INFO:00046D61] ('No, that won't be necessary. You'll have compensation for your loss.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D34])
[INFO:00046D70] ('Thank you, Laila.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D33])
[INFO:00046D90] ('Hafjorg! Where did you put it woman?!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D32])
[INFO:00046D6B] ('Sigh. What is it now, dear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D31])
[INFO:00046D76] ('Don't you "dear" me! I had a bowl of Vampire Dust on my worktable not an hour ago and after you swept in there it's gone!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D30])
[INFO:00046D95] ('Oh my. Elgrim, it's on the shelf to the right of the table, as always.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D2F])
[INFO:00046D7A] ('Ah, I see. Well, just be careful around my things!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D2E])
[INFO:00046D69] ('Elgrim, honey. I'm concerned about your new pupil. She seems very... odd.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D2D])
[INFO:00046D81] ('Ingun? She's brilliant
column5: a natural!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D2C])

column4: [INFO:00046D64] ('Oh dear, I didn't mean to say she isn't bright.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D2B])
[INFO:00046D8F] ('Damn it, woman! Ingun is the most promising alchemist I've ever seen and I won't have you scaring her off!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046D2A])
[INFO:00046B02] ('So, Talen. Have you reconsidered my offer?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A6D])
[INFO:00046ABD] ('Sorry Hemming, I've no interest in becoming your valet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A6C])
[INFO:00046B0D] ('What's the matter, I thought you people were used to indentured servitude.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A6B])
[INFO:00046AB5] ('Xhuth! Black-Briar or not, say that again and so help me you're going to need more than your mother to protect you from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A6A])
[INFO:00046A8A] ('Talen! Another round!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A67])
[INFO:00046AF8] ('I think you've had plenty, Vulwulf. Maybe you should head on home.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A66])
[INFO:00046A97] ('You stupid lizard! I said give me some more drink, or I'll have your head on a pike!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A65])
[INFO:00046B1D] ('Suit yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A64])
[INFO:00046AC5] ('Have I told you about Valen, my dear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A63])
[INFO:00046A84] ('I love when you spin that yarn. Gets better every time you add something new.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A62])
[INFO:00046AEB] ('He killed six Imperial Guards before they dragged him into the prisons.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A61])
[INFO:00046A91] ('Was this before or after the Mythic Dawn attacked the Emperor and Valen single-handedly fought them off? Just shut up and drink, Romlyn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A60])
[INFO:00046B04] ('Ungrien! I just found another spoiled keg! What's the matter with you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A5F])
[INFO:00046AA1] ('I... I'm sorry. I could have sworn I sealed it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A5E])
[INFO:00046AF9] ('Tell me something. Do you enjoy spending Lady Maven's gold for her? It certainly seems that way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A5D])
[INFO:00046AC8] ('No.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A5C])
[INFO:00046A72] ('This is the last warning. You do it again, and you'll be sleeping in Beggar's Row with the rest of the riff-raff!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A5B])
[INFO:00046ACB] ('Do you know what Indaryn told me? He said if I'm late one more time he'll kick me right out the door!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A5A])
[INFO:00046A74] ('That s'wit. One day, he'll regret pushing all of us around.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A59])
[INFO:00046ACF] ('What do you mean?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A58])
[INFO:00046A77] ('All I'm saying is Indaryn's going to push someone too far one day and they're going to push back... hard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A57])
[INFO:00046AD2] ('I don't know if I can stand the abuse here much longer. They treat us like outcasts.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A56])
[INFO:00046A7C] ('The Dark Elves and the Wood Elves have never been the best of friends. Be patient, they'll come around soon enough!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A55])
[INFO:00046AD8] ('Wretched Dark Elves. It's just my luck I ended up working under one of them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A54])
[INFO:00046A81] ('Chin up, Ungrien! Remember, you have a roof over your head and food in your belly thanks to the very same Dark Elves. Be thankful.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A53])
[INFO:00046ADD] ('You keep giving and giving Bersi, and they'll keep taking and taking. When is it going to end?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A52])
[INFO:00046A85] ('What would you have me do, woman? Cross the Guild? Take them all on one by one?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A51])
[INFO:00046ADF] ('You know I don't mean that. We need to find a way out of this. Perhaps talk to Laila...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A50])
[INFO:00046A87] ('Laila is as clueless as she is stupid. No. If anything's to be done about this, we have to deal with it ourselves.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A4F])
[INFO:00046AE0] ('Drifa? I was looking through our books and there's an entry for "spices." Says we spent 300 septims. What is that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A4E])
[INFO:00046A88] ('Spices? I'm certain I have no idea what you're talking about.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A4D])
[INFO:00046B25] ('You sure? It was in your handwriting. If you can't keep the books straight then let me do them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A4C])
[INFO:00046AC0] ('Oh, yes... spices. That was a special order for someone in Whiterun. Should be along any day now. Don't let it worry you, my dear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A4B])
[INFO:00046B27] ('Ingun, how much longer do you intend to waste your life concocting your foolish little potions?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A4A])
[INFO:00046AC1] ('I've told you, my interest in the family business is quite low. I wish to be much more than just a merchant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A49])

[INFO:00046B28] ('Your interests lay where I wish them to lay otherwise my favorite daughter may end up homeless and without a septim to her name. Is that clear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A48])
[INFO:00046AC3] ('Yes, mother.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A47])
[INFO:00046A76] ('Hemming, I need you to bring a note to Sibbi. I need him to do something for me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A46])
[INFO:00046AD1] ('Sibbi? He's in prison... you put him there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A45])
[INFO:00046A7A] ('I know that!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A44])
[INFO:00046AD7] ('Why do you tolerate him, mother? All he contributes to this family is embarrassment and disgrace.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A43])
[INFO:00046A80] ('I tolerate your son because he'll do anything I ask, without question. I'd expect the same from my own son.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A42])
[INFO:00046ADC] ('I understand, mother. Forgive me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A41])
[INFO:00046A99] ('They laughed at me again, Dinya. They simply don't understand.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A3F])
[INFO:00046B07] ('I'm so sorry my husband. You must remember, they're at the Bee and Barb to drink, not to listen to a sermon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A3E])
[INFO:00046A9A] ('Yes, yes, I know. I just wish to show them there's more to life than drowning your sorrows in a goblet of mead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A3D])
[INFO:00046B09] ('You're a good man, Maramal. We're lucky to have you watching over us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A3C])

[INFO:00046A9B] ('It fills me with joy to hear you're with child, Dinya. They said it wouldn't... that it couldn't happen, but Mara has shown them they're mistake.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A3B])
[INFO:00046B0B] ('And to think I was wandering the ash wastes only two years ago. I never knew my path would lead to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A3A])
[INFO:00046A9D] ('You were guided here
column5: you were always meant to be here. That's the way of things.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A39])

column4: [INFO:00046AA2] ('Then I thank Lady Mara with all my heart
column5: for you, for our child and for our love.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A37])

column4: [INFO:00046B10] ('How are things at the Meadery, my dear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A36])
[INFO:00046AA6] ('Not this again...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A35])
[INFO:00046AAA] ('Hush, Vulwulf... let the boy speak.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A34])
[INFO:00046B14] ('It's going very well, actually. The war hasn't even slowed down our production or shipping at all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A33])
[INFO:00046AAE] ('Of course it is. That's what happens when you're partners with a corrupt Imperial whore like Maven.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A32])
[INFO:00046B17] ('Vulwulf! The Empire may be our enemy, but Asgeir is still our son and we're a long way from Cyrodiil.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A31])
[INFO:00046AB1] ('Father, I promise you, this has nothing to do with Empires or politics. It's just business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A30])
[INFO:00046B19] ('It has everything to do with politics. Asgeir my son, you have so much to learn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A2F])
[INFO:00046AB3] ('Mother, what can I do to make father happier? It seems no matter how successful I become he doesn't care.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A2E])
[INFO:00046AE1] ('Of course he cares. You just have to understand that your father was a soldier and he'll always be a soldier.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A2D])
[INFO:00046A79] ('I understand. It just isn't me. I'm not a warrior and I don't think I ever will be.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A2C])
[INFO:00046AD5] ('Then by Talos, you do what you feel you're meant to do. I'll take care of your father for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A2B])
[INFO:00046A7F] ('You need to be easier on Asgeir. All he wants to do is please you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A2A])
[INFO:00046ADA] ('It would please me if he'd take up arms and fight for to save his homeland. Is that too much to ask my own son?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A29])
[INFO:00046A83] ('That's right. He is your son. He has his own hopes and dreams and we have no right to tell him otherwise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A28])
[INFO:00046ADE] ('You can't deny the fact that he needs to give back to his people
column5: to fight to keep us free.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A27])

column4: [INFO:00046B18] ('Aunt Haelga, why you... demean yourself with these people you barely know? They show no real love for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A26])
[INFO:00046AB2] ('It's only a bit of fun. You're a lovely young thing, you should try it sometime.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A25])
[INFO:00046B1A] ('No! I'm saving myself for someone special. Someone who loves me dearly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A24])
[INFO:00046AB4] ('You mean Sibbi? You must be joking! All he wants to do is bed you and be done with it. You may as well get it over with and let him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A23])
[INFO:00046B1C] ('You're wrong! Sibbi and I are in love and you're just jealous!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A22])
[INFO:00046AB6] ('Svana! Has that skooma-addled idiot Niluva paid us her rent yet? Or does she have more excuses?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A21])
[INFO:00046B1F] ('She said she'll have it soon. She still has her job at the meadery for now, so she'll be able to pay us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A20])
[INFO:00046AB7] ('Why do you insist on defending that woman? All she does with her money is spend it on that Dark Elf garbage!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A1F])
[INFO:00046B22] ('Just be patient, aunt. She'll have it, I promise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A1E])
[INFO:00046ABA] ('Hey, Svana... I hear you like Dark Elves. Perhaps I could should you what a real Dark Elf can do to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A1D])
[INFO:00046B23] ('You're an animal, Tythis... keep away from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A1C])
[INFO:00046ABC] ('Ah, so my reputation as a lover precedes me. Care to reconsider?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A1B])
[INFO:00046B24] ('You're disgusting! Don't you even think of laying a finger on me or I'll cut off something you can't live without.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A1A])
[INFO:00046ABE] ('So, Brand-Shei... business as awful for you as it is for all of us?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A19])
[INFO:00046B26] ('Worse. The Khajiit Caravans are the only way to get supplies into the city, and even those are becoming more infrequent.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A18])
[INFO:00046AA4] ('Well, let's all raise a flagon to Ulfric
column5: future King of Skyrim and bringer of poverty to the working class!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A17])

column4: [INFO:00046B12] ('Grelka! Lower your voice before you get us both in trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A16])
[INFO:00046AA7] ('Drink up, my boy! Drink to those who have fallen! May their souls find their way to Sovngarde!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A15])
[INFO:00046B13] ('Take it easy, father. You're making a scene.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A14])
[INFO:00046AAC] ('I'll rest easy when we've driven every last Imperial pig back across the Jerall Mountains!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A13])
[INFO:00046B08] ('Yes... father.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A12])
[INFO:00046A6F] ('You've been in Riften for quite some time now, Lady Mjoll. I fear that you soon may leave us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A11])
[INFO:00046AC7] ('Riften has problems of its own. Now is not the time for exploration and discovery.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A10])
[INFO:00046A71] ('I'm relieved to hear you say that. If you were to leave, I'd miss you terribly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A0F])
[INFO:00046AC9] ('Aerin, I owe you my life. It would take a threat to all of Skyrim for me to depart.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A0E])
[INFO:00046A73] ('Romlyn, I've been meaning to speak to you. I did a count at the meadery and we're four cases short... again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A0D])
[INFO:00046ACC] ('What are you saying? You think I had something to do with that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A0C])
[INFO:00046A75] ('I'm not accusing you of anything. Yet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A0B])
[INFO:00046AD0] ('The Dreth family doesn't steal, Indaryn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A0A])
[INFO:00046A78] ('For your sake, I hope you're right. Because if it is you, and Maven finds out, the Dreth family is going to be one member smaller.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A09])
[INFO:00046AD3] ('Hemming, I want you to personally supervise the next shipment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A08])
[INFO:00046A7D] ('We already have people that do that and they make quite a bit of coin for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A07])
[INFO:00046AD9] ('I don't trust them. Come to think of it, I don't trust you either, but at least you're family.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A06])
[INFO:00046A82] ('Anything you say, Mother.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A05])
[INFO:00046AB9] ('Bersi still refuses to cooperate. What did you want to do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A04])
[INFO:00046AF5] ('I've known Bersi a long time. Even before he opened that rubbish heap he calls a shop.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A03])
[INFO:00046B21] ('And if he still refuses?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A02])
[INFO:00046A93] ('Then put the thumbscrews on him and hit him... hard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A01])
[INFO:00046AD6] ('I was hoping you could help me. It seems I've lost a ring that also means quite a bit to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00046A00])
[INFO:00046AE6] ('I'm afraid not. I don't deal in stolen goods.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469FF])
[INFO:00046B20] ('Stolen? How can you be certain? I may have just misplaced it somewhere in the city.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469FE])
[INFO:00046A8F] ('Lady Mjoll, if you lost a gold ring anywhere in this city I'm afraid it's likely never to be seen again. I'm sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469FD])
[INFO:00046AB8] ('Ah, Nivenor. What can I sell you on this fine day?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469FC])
[INFO:00046B00] ('I'm looking for a necklace. Do you have anything with garnets?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469FB])
[INFO:00046A7E] ('I have a single one left, quite expensive, but also quite elegant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469FA])
[INFO:00046AA5] ('Posh. I'm not paying for it. Put it on Bolli's account if you please.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F9])
[INFO:00046AE3] ('Madesi, what's this bill for 300 septims!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F8])
[INFO:00046B16] ('Begging your pardon, milord. Your wife has run up quite an account in the last few months.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F7])
[INFO:00046A90] ('Outrageous! Who does she think she is?!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F6])
[INFO:00046ACD] ('Lady Haelga, so pleased to see you. Your Marks of Dibella are ready.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F5])
[INFO:00046B0F] ('Oh, splendid! I can't wait to use them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F4])
[INFO:00046A89] ('Begging your pardon milady... I know these have something to do with Dibella, but whatever are they for?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F3])
[INFO:00046AAD] ('Maybe I'll show you one day, Madesi. Have them delivered to the Bunkhouse, won't you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F2])
[INFO:00046AE8] ('We got a few pieces of jewelry at the Prawn, Madesi. Want to come take a look at them later?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F1])
[INFO:00046B1E] ('I wish I could, milady. Sadly, I haven't sold enough of my own jewelry let alone buy some from you. I'm sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469F0])
[INFO:00046A92] ('Oh, I'm so sorry. I'm certain Bolli would be happy to lend you a few septims.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469EF])
[INFO:00046AC6] ('Much appreciated, Lady Drifa, but I'll manage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469EE])
[INFO:00046A96] ('When are you going to stop by the temple, Madesi?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469ED])
[INFO:00046AFE] ('Sorry Lady Dinya, but I've been busy of late.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469EC])
[INFO:00046A9C] ('It only takes but a moment to say a silent prayer to Mara. Please come by soon
column5: not for me, but for yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469EB])

column4: [INFO:00046AED] ('Very well, I'll try milady.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469EA])
[INFO:00046A94] ('Lady Maven, how may I help you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E9])
[INFO:00046AFC] ('Is it true that you refused to sell one of your... trinkets to Hemming?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E8])
[INFO:00046A7B] ('Please, milady, it was only because he threatened me. He said he'd have me thrown in the prisons if I didn't give him what he wanted!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E7])
[INFO:00046AA8] ('Next time a Black-Briar asks for something, I suggest you respond quickly and affirmatively.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E6])
[INFO:00046AEE] ('Hello, Lady Mjoll.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E5])
[INFO:00046A8E] ('Madesi, my friend. How have things been since last week's incident?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E4])
[INFO:00046B0E] ('Ever since you scared off that thug from the Thieves Guild, not one of them's bothered me. We're lucky to have you here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E3])
[INFO:00046B06] ('It's my pleasure. If you see the Thieves Guild harassing anyone else, you be sure and let me know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E2])
[INFO:00046A95] ('Here's another septim, Madesi. How much more do I need?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469E0])
[INFO:00046B01] ('Only thirty more and it'll be all yours. If I might ask, who is the lucky woman?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469DF])
[INFO:00046AF3] ('It's for Marise, but don't say a word to her!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469DE])
[INFO:00046AF0] ('Don't worry, Shadr, your secret is safe with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469DD])
[INFO:00046B15] ('Anuriel, a word please.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469DC])
[INFO:00046AA9] ('Yes, my lady?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469DB])
[INFO:00046AEF] ('It's been brought to my attention that the poison known as skooma may be present in our city. What do you know of this?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469DA])
[INFO:00046A9F] ('I believe it to be a falsehood perpetrated by the Empire in order to weaken the citizen's confidence in your ability to rule.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469D9])

[INFO:00046AC2] ('Mother, how long must we put up with Saerlund spouting his nonsense about the Empire?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469D4])

[INFO:00046B03] ('I will hear no more of this, Harrald. Do you understand me? No more!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469D1])

[INFO:00046A8C] ('Yes mother? What is it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469CF])
[INFO:00046AFD] ('This situation with the sewers beneath the city. I hear people have entered this place and have gone missing. Do you know of this?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469CE])
[INFO:00046AF4] ('Yes, I've heard such things. Anuriel assures me they're just fabrications and there's nothing down there save a few stray skeever.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469CD])
[INFO:00046AA3] ('Well, make sure we keep the patrols out night and day, just to be certain.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469CC])
[INFO:00046AC4] ('I see you still have the run of the place, traitor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469CB])

[INFO:00046AFF] ('At least I've chosen a side instead of acting like a spectator.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469C8])
[INFO:00046A8D] ('So, is this what it's come to? You'd have your own flesh and blood hanged just to solidify your grip as the next Jarl?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469C7])

[INFO:00046AAF] ('What's become of us? We used to be inseparable... always fighting back to back and letting nothing stand in our way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469C5])

[INFO:00046AFB] ('Anuriel, would you please stop declaring that the city is safe for the Jarl to roam? You and I both know that isn't true.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000469BF])

[INFO:0008BBCE] ([SO]'Please, mister. You got to get me out of here. Ever since Aventus left, Grelod's been even meaner than usual. I swear, she's going to kill one of us.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00016CA1] ([G]'When Aventus escaped, Grelod got meaner than ever. I really thought she was going to kill one of us. Guess not!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000D82CC] ('If the forest wasn't so dangerous, I'd spend every spare moment riding.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000D82CB] ('Horses are all I know. I've been riding since I could walk.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BF3] ('Hofgrir is a great teacher. I've learned so much about horses from him.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000C1E02] ('If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir. I'm afraid I'm in too much trouble to help you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BF2] ('If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir at the stables.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000C1E03] ('If it's horses you want, I'm not sure I can help you. I have too much on my mind as it is.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000C1E04] ('If it's horses you want, you're talking to the right person.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00065C2D] ('Got horses that need shoeing, so make it quick.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BED] ('Too lazy to walk, eh? Well, you've found the right place.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00065C2C] ('Back, eh? Ready to brawl?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00065C2B] ('You up for another wager?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BEC] ('If it isn't the best brawler in Skyrim. Good to see you again!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BEB] ('There's two things to do at the Flagon: spend coin and then get out.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BEA] ('Vekel doesn't like strangers snooping around the Flagon.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE9] ('Last person who made trouble for Vekel ended up with a smashed head.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE8] ('Stay outta trouble, or there's gonna be trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE6] ('The last person that made trouble for Vekel ended up floating in the canal... catch my drift?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE5] ('I don't care if you're best buddies with the Guild Master. I'll still smash in your skull if you try anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE4] ('Even if you're one of us, you better not make trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE3] ('Don't make trouble or else I'll ask Dirge to "walk" you out.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE2] ('There's a reason the city guard doesn't come down here you know.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE1] ('I wouldn't stay here long if I were you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BE0] ('Got a lot of nerve coming down here. People tend to get hurt in the Ratway.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BDF] ('You better have coin to pay for your drinks. There's no handouts here.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BDE] ('Something has to change soon or I may as well pack this place up and leave it for the skeevers.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BDD] ('Less coin in everyone's pocket means less coin in mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BDC] ('I hear even the simple jobs are becoming difficult. It never used to be like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BDB] ('It's been a long time since anyone joined us. Seems like people are in a rush to leave.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BDA] ('It's one thing to say you've got the skills to be a thief. It's another to actually use them.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00044BD9] ('So, you're Brynjolf's new protege, eh? Don't look like much to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00083868] ('Come see me in the market if you're looking for the finest custom jewelry in all of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423C5] ('If you have any jewelry to sell, I'd be glad to pay you a fair sum in gold for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423C4] ('If anything pleases the eye, don't hesitate to make me an offer.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423C3] ('Greetings, honored friend. Could I interest you in some fine jewelry?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423C2] ('Just leave Riften. Go far, far away and never return. This place is nothing but a rotten, stinking corpse that's sat in the sun far too long.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423C1] ('Edda... she's crazy as a loon, but at least she doesn't have the mind to realize what a horrible world this is. She's the lucky one.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423C0] ('You think you know pain? Do you!? Try watching your wife and daughter burn alive after they've been ravaged by brigands! That's pain, my friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423BF] ('To Oblivion with all of you! You rich piles of dung walking by us like we're not there! Pretending we don't exist! How dare you!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423BE] ('Sure, sure. I'm a dirty beggar... why would you want to even speak to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423BD] ('Are you scared of death? I am. I hear everything just stops... forever. It just all goes away, but you don't realize it. I don't want to die.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423BC] ('No one cares about us! No one! We could die and no one would ever even know! They'd just throw our corpses in the canal!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423BB] ('So cold, so hungry, so tired.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423BA] ('I can't take this place anymore. The trees... all the colors, but the city, so dark. Why? It makes no sense.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423B9] ('Please, please. I need but a septim. A septim is all I ask. Is that so bad?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423B6] ('I apologize in advance for my husband's crankiness
column5: I promise you he means well.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

column4: [INFO:000423B5] ('Where's my head? I never even greeted you properly.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0005B1E8] ('This place has seen better days, but it's not my fault.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0005B1D1] ('Have you managed to make it out to Shor's Stone?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423B4] ('Thanks again for delivering that ore sample.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423B0] ('Take a look at my supplies if you must, but do hurry... I'm not getting any younger you know!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423AE] ('Do you have any idea how busy I am? My mixture could be burning as we speak!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423AF] ('You here for lessons like Ingun? Or did you wish to buy something?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423AD] ('I hope that someday this city will be free from corruption and we can all live in peace.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423AC] ('Mjoll's brought me nothing but safety and piece of mind... and some lessons with the blade.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423AB] ('Mjoll told me that it isn't this bad everywhere. Maybe one day I'll venture out and see if she's right.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423AA] ('I've never seen Mjoll this upset about anything. The city really gets to her.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423A7] ('Visitors like us are rare in this part of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00083AA4] ('You're a stranger here too, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00083AA3] ('Well met, friend. How can I help you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00053304] ('Oh, it's you. Not here to rob me are you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00083AA2] ('Ah, you're back. What have you discovered?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000423A4] ('Welcome back! Good to see you again.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423A3] ('Folks in town say that Balimund is the greatest blacksmith in all of Tamriel. I hope I can live up to that some day and make him proud of me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423A2] ('At first I don't know why he picked me. I never even held a hammer in my life! But the first time I picked it up, it just felt right!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423A1] ('Balimund took me in and has been so kind to me. I don't know why, but he thinks I can be a great blacksmith like him.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000423A0] ('I used to live at the orphanage here in Riften. Grelod said my ma and da left me there when I was a baby... that they didn't want me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00021CFA] ('Have you met Balimund? I'm his apprentice. He's teaching me all about being a blacksmith.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00021CF8] ('How can I help you today?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004239F] ('Here to purchase some armor or a weapon?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004239A] ('Looking for some armor? A weapon perhaps?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042399] ('Nothing like the smell of a white-hot blade, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00013631] ('What brings you to Balimund today? Repair? Purchase?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00053303] ('Come to see Balimund perform miracles with steel, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042395] ('Excuse my disorganization, but I'm in the middle of some delicate experiments.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00043E01] ('Did we have an appointment? No... it was a delivery? I can't remember.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042394] ('I know you. Where was it? Hm. Oh! You were getting something for me?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042392] ('The only reason I stopped fighting was a plea from Laila, otherwise I'd would have fought to the death.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042391] ('I killed scores of the Empire's men before I was forced to surrender.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042390] ('Being in exile is the most humiliating thing I've experienced in my life.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004238F] ('I'd request that when speaking to Jarl Laila, you show the proper respect.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004238E] ('Did you have some sort of official business here?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004238D] ('As Jarl Laila's housecarl, I would ask that you maintain a respectable distance from her at all times.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000BD784] ('Perhaps the Stormcloaks might rally to take back Riften one day. Only time will tell.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000BD783] ('The Imperials now control Riften and have placed Maven Black-Briar on the Jarl's throne.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042387] ('I'm afraid my days as the steward of Riften has come to an end.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000BD782] ('If you're here to report any instances of corruption, be confident that we're handling these rumors accordingly.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042388] ('As Riften's Steward I'm afraid I can provide only limited assistance, but speak your mind.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042389] ('Welcome to Mistveil Keep. I'm Jarl Laila's steward, Anuriel.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042383] ('Did Harrald send you to taunt me?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042382] ('I can feel you laughing behind my back.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042381] ('Come to gloat, have we? To poke fun at the jarl's youngest son?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000BD781] ('I presume you have something important to say?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004237D] ('If this isn't about official city business, you're wasting my time.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004237B] ('Out of my way. The son of the Jarl has no time for idle conversation with travelers.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:000BD77D] ('If Riften can be retaken, I will redouble my efforts to ensure the safety of my subjects and the defense of the Rift.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000BD77C] ('Unmid and Anuriel shouldn't blame themselves for Riften's fall, I am the one who's ultimately responsible.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042376] ('I feel so helpless out here. The people of Riften depended on me, and I failed them.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000BD77B] ('Speak, I wish to hear everything my subjects have to say.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042375] ('What can I do for you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042374] ('Welcome to Riften, traveler. I hope the road fared well for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042368] ('If Riften is the best Skyrim has to offer, I may as well turn back right now and just head for home.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042367] ('I'm beginning to think leaving Mournhold was a mistake.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042369] ('Working at the Riften Fishery is tough, but it puts some coin in my pocket.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00083867] ('If you're ever in the market, I deal in specialty goods from Morrowind at one of the stands.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042363] ('If there's anything you wish to purchase, just let me know.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042364] ('Have anything you wish to sell? I pay fair prices for all sorts of goods.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0006DA84] ('Can I interest you in some fine goods from Morrowind?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0006DA83] ([G][R][RE]'This is unfair! I'm innocent!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0006DA82] ([G][R]'This city is corrupt! You're all corrupt!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042362] ([G][R]'Who did this to me?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004235F] ('The Bunkhouse isn't an inn. I'd recommend the Bee and Barb.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004235E] ('I'd appreciate it if you'd keep your hands to yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F88] ('Sorry about the mess. Keeping this place clean is quite a chore.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F86] ('Any luck getting the marks from those men?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004235D] ('Hey! Good to see you again.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042357] ('You looking for something or what?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042356] ('If you're looking for a bed, this is the wrong place.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F85] ('New around Riften? Take my advice. Stay at the Bee and Barb... the Bunkhouse isn't for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00053301] ('Oh, it's you. Come to extort more from me?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042351] ('I can see that disapproving look in your eye.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00043DFA] ('Come to laugh at the grave tender?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00043DF9] ('Anything else before you make the journey?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00043DF8] ('The pilgrimage is complete, I can feel it.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042350] ('I'm feeling much better thanks to your efforts.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004234F] ('Mark my words. If Bolli thinks he's giving all of our wealth away to some poor slob, I'll leave him high and dry.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004234E] ('I spend every Friday at the fishery, so I know the meaning of hard work. All those forms to fill out and file
column5: it's exhausting!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

column4: [INFO:0004234D] ('Such a waste of time preaching to the poor. If they're that hungry, they should just grow some food or something.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004234C] ('At this rate, he'll give the entire Riften Fishery away to charity. Then how will I live?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:0004234B] ('With my husband's new found religion, what I do with our coin and what I do all day seem less important to him. Suits me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004234A] ('Bolli's around somewhere, planning to feed the poor with his nonsense about Mara.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:00042349] ('If you're looking for a handout, you'll want to speak with my husband. If you're looking for company, I suppose I could do worse.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000D82CA] ('If you're looking for a handout, you'll want to speak with my husband.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000D82C9] ('Can you believe my former husband used to give most of our gold to the poor?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042348] ('If you're looking for a handout, you're not going to get one from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00036C45] ('If you're hungry, Marise sells fresh fish... caught by yours truly.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000557AC] ('There's nothing like fishing on Lake Honrich, you should try it sometime.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042341] ('New in town, eh? Here for the fishing I'd guess.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000557AA] ('Did you get that purchase agreement to Markarth yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042342] ('Thanks again for the delivery to Markarth. What can I do for you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00064988] ('Please to meet you, I'm a priestess at the Temple of Mara.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00064987] ('Visiting Riften? All are welcome at the Temple of Mara.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004233B] ('What is it you seek, my child?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F82] ('Lady Mara bids you welcome to Her Benevolence.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F7F] ('Has the Warmth of Mara been given to Riften?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00053300] ('Lady Mara's messenger returns. What can I help you with, my child?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F7E] ('How may I help you, my daughter?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042336] ('How may I help you, my son?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00041F7D] ('Blessings of Mara upon you!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042335] ('Welcome back to the temple, messenger.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:00042330] ('What was it you wanted?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0004232F] ('My mind is on my experiments today. What did you need?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0003C4F2] ('Hm? Sorry, just thinking about my experiments.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:0003C4EE] ('Any luck gathering those ingredients?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000532FE] ('My experiments continue to go well thanks to you. How can I return the favor?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])
[INFO:000532FC] ('Ah finally, someone besides the stupid guards to talk to.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueRiftenHellos [DIAL:00040760])

[INFO:0003ECA5] ('Hello, Jora. I'm glad to see you. In fact, I was just thinking about you and your husband.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBCD])
[INFO:0003EBFE] ('Is that so? And what were you thinking, exactly?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBCC])
[INFO:0003EBE1] ('Well, I've heard awful stories about these Thalmor, and how they're rounding up everyone who still worships Talos.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBC5])
[INFO:0003EBDD] ('I doubt Ulfric would let Thalmor into Windhelm without a fight. But please, do continue. How would you help us?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBC4])
[INFO:0003EE43] ('Well, let's just say that I know some people who are experts at helping others disappear when they need to.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBC1])
[INFO:0003EDF1] ('We accept the risks that come with our faith, but I'll keep your offer in mind. Thank you, Niranye.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBC0])
[INFO:0003EDDF] ('I wanted to thank you again for the mince pie you sent over. It was delicious.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBAE])
[INFO:0003ED4C] ('It was my pleasure, Torbjorn. I enjoy cooking, and after what you and Tova have been through, it was the least I could do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBAB])
[INFO:0003ECAA] ('My little Friga loved to cook, but she was terrible at it. Then one day, out of nowhere, she made the most amazing leek soup.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBAA])
[INFO:0003EC9B] ('I... I'm so sorry, Torbjorn. You must be suffering terribly. I wish there was some way I could help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBA1])
[INFO:0003EBE4] ('You've done more than enough already. You've been a good friend in a time of need, and we won't forget that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EBA0])
[INFO:0003EBE0] ('I've been meaning to speak to you, Niranye. Rumor is, you've got ties to the Thieves' Guild.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB9B])
[INFO:0003EDF5] ('One should never pay too much attention to rumors, Torbjorn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB9A])

[INFO:0003EC9F] ('I understand you purchase used goods, as well as sell them?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB96])
[INFO:0003EC3A] ('Yes, that's right. Whether or not I'm interested depends on what you've got, of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB95])
[INFO:0003EBE2] ('I have some things that belonged to my daughter, Friga. She... she won't be needing them any more.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB94])
[INFO:0003EBDE] ('Oh, I see. Yes, yes of course I'll take a look. Just bring them by whenever it's convenient for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB93])

[INFO:0003EDF3] ('A pleasure to see you as well, Niranye. What can I do for you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB91])
[INFO:0003EDED] ('I was wondering if you still had many associates in the shipping profession.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB8F])
[INFO:0003ED46] ('If that business proposition includes smuggling, forget it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB8E])
[INFO:0003ECA4] ('You're such a wet blanket, captain. Can't a girl have a little fun from time to time?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB8D])
[INFO:0003EC9D] ('Is that new batch of tomatoes ready for sale yet, Hillevi?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB8C])
[INFO:0003EBE5] ('You know, I'm not sure. My husband's been tending to the vines, so I'll have to ask him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB8B])
[INFO:0003EBDC] ('Just promise me when you get some more in, I'll have the first crack at them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB8A])
[INFO:0003EE42] ('What is it Ulfric's always saying... "On my honor as a Nord, I swear it." (Laughter).' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB85])
[INFO:0003EDF0] ('So serious! (Laughter)' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB81])
[INFO:0003ED96] ('Friend Brunwulf, how good to see you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB80])
[INFO:0003ED4B] ('That's not necessary. I'll pay the same price as anyone else.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB7F])
[INFO:0003ECA6] ('But I insist. and with good reason.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB7E])
[INFO:0003ECA3] ('I'm not looking for special treatment, Aval. All I did was talk to Ulfric.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB79])
[INFO:0003EC9A] ('Oh, I see. Well, I'm sorry to have troubled you about it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003EB78])

[INFO:0008AFA0] ('Thanks for bringing the claw back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DD26])
[INFO:0003DD28] ('It means so much to us to have the claw back where it belongs. Thank you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DD26])

[INFO:0003DD27] ('Thank you so much for taking care of those thieves. The Riverwood Trader is back to the way it used to be!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DD26])
[INFO:0003DAC4] ('Brynjolf, have you had a chance to speak to our contact in Whiterun?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA82])
[INFO:0003DABD] ('Sorry Mercer, they no longer wish to be involved in our operation.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA81])
[INFO:0003DA99] ('I trust you've applied the appropriate pressure in order to change their mind?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA80])
[INFO:0003DAB8] ('I have. I think we may have to turn this one over to the Dark Brotherhood.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA7F])
[INFO:0003DA9A] ('Yes, I'm afraid you're right. Such a shame...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA7E])
[INFO:0003DAB9] ('Maven has been nagging us about her request. Any thoughts?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA7D])
[INFO:0003DA9B] ('Do we have anyone reliable to send out there? I don't want to look the fool again in front of her, Brynjolf.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA7C])
[INFO:0003DABB] ('Yes, I know. That last job was my fault. I obviously thought Niruin was ready, but I was wrong.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA7B])
[INFO:0003DA9C] ('Remind me why we even bother to allow him to be a part of the Guild.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA7A])
[INFO:0003DA9F] ('Two reasons. He's rich and because we need every sword we can get right now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA79])
[INFO:0003DAC5] ('I think we need to prepare for the worst. The coffers are dwindling and I can barely keep our contacts happy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA78])
[INFO:0003DAA0] ('There's no need to be concerned. We've been through more difficult times than this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA77])
[INFO:0003DAC6] ('Normally I'd agree, but we've already lost so many contacts across Skyrim. If we lose the ones in Riften, we may as well close up shop.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA76])
[INFO:0003DAA2] ('I'll speak to the Jarl and see what I can do. Just keep them at bay a little longer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA75])
[INFO:0003DA84] ('Delvin, please tell me you have good news.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA74])
[INFO:0003DAA3] ('If I told you that, I'd be lying. We haven't had a bite in weeks. Our clients are starting to get angry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA73])
[INFO:0003DA85] ('You tell this sorry bunch of thieves that they need to put down their flagons and get to work if they want to keep their status!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA72])
[INFO:0003DAC0] ('I will, I will...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA71])
[INFO:0003DA95] ('So, Thrynn, you were a bandit, huh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA6E])
[INFO:0003DAA9] ('Yeah, what of it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA6D])
[INFO:0003DA92] ('So is it true, bandits get... you know, real friendly with the wildlife?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA6C])
[INFO:0003DAAE] ('You're an idiot.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA6B])
[INFO:0003DA8D] ('So, what do you think, my dear? Could a beautiful woman like you ever see yourself with an old codger like me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA6A])
[INFO:0003DA8B] ('Absolutely.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA69])
[INFO:0003DA88] ('Oh, really? Well then... how can I make that happen?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA68])
[INFO:0003DAC2] ('When you're in your grave and I'm standing over it. Now get out of my way!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA67])
[INFO:0003DABE] ('Delvin, that last shipment we heisted on the Cyrodiil frontier was worthless!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA66])
[INFO:0003DAA1] ('That's impossible. I distinctly heard that lout in the tavern say it was a full shipment of furs. They should be worth a fortune.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA65])
[INFO:0003DABC] ('You idiot. He said "firs" not "furs." It was a damn logging caravan!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA64])
[INFO:0003DAC1] ('Oh my... umm, you won't let Mercer hear about this will you? Ahem.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA63])
[INFO:0003DA93] ('I've picked up some new clients and did a few jobs on my own, but I'm not sure if that will cover our expenses.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA62])
[INFO:0003DA89] ('Thank you, Vex. You've always been the most reliable one in the Guild.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA61])
[INFO:0003DA9E] ('Well, what the hell is Mercer going to do about this mess? Have you even talked to him?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA60])
[INFO:0003DAB1] ('Mercer is being Mercer. If he has a plan to get us out of this rut, then he isn't sharing it with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA5F])
[INFO:0003DAB6] ('How are you feeling, Vex?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA5E])
[INFO:0003DAC3] ('Pretty angry actually. I can't believe I botched the Goldenglow job. That should have been like stealing a sweetroll from a baby.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA5D])
[INFO:0003DABF] ('Well, I see your wounds have healed but your pride still needs some time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA5C])

[INFO:0003DAAB] ('Brynjolf, something stinks around here and it's more than just the Ratway. We all know it. The question is, what's Mercer going to do about it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA5B])
[INFO:0003DAA7] ('Hold a moment, Rune. What did you think about my idea?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA5A])
[INFO:0003DA98] ('Your idea to start a brothel, right? Do you want me to tell you exactly what I think?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA59])
[INFO:0003DAB0] ('Well, yes! Please!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA58])
[INFO:0003DAAC] ('I think if Brynjolf catches wind of it, he'll boot you right out of here... so drop it already!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA57])
[INFO:0003DAB2] ('What in the name of Oblivion is going on in this place?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA56])
[INFO:0003DA86] ('Yeah, I know what you mean. If things don't start getting better soon, I may look for work elsewhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA55])
[INFO:0003DAB4] ('Hey, I still have a contact in Valenwood that may have some work for us. You're welcome to join me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA54])
[INFO:0003DA8A] ('I'll keep that in mind.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA53])
[INFO:0003DAA6] ('I tried to fence some goods to Tonilia, and you know what she told me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA52])
[INFO:0003DA97] ('I think I know, but go ahead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA51])
[INFO:0003DA8F] ('She said that she barely had enough coin to cover it and I should come back later. Can you imagine that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA50])
[INFO:0003DA83] ('This place is getting worse and worse.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA4F])
[INFO:0003DAA5] ('So, Sapphire. Can I do anything for you, or more to the point... to you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA4E])
[INFO:0003DAB5] ('Vipir "the Fleet." The only man who's foolish enough to name himself after his bedroom prowess.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA4D])
[INFO:0003DA87] ('You stupid cow. You don't know what you're missing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA4C])
[INFO:0003DA94] ('No, but I know that you're going to turn up missing if you keep up this kind of talk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA4B])
[INFO:0003DA91] ('You seem to be a bit closer to Brynjolf than the rest of us. Is he giving you any idea why this place seems to be falling apart?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA4A])
[INFO:0003DAA8] ('If he does, he isn't telling me a thing. I've asked, but all I get from him are more questions.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA49])
[INFO:0003DA96] ('What about Mercer? Have you asked him?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA48])
[INFO:0003DAAA] ('No, and I'm not about to either. I value my life you know... you may want to remember that for yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA47])
[INFO:0003DA90] ('All right. I have everything you asked for all ready to go.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA46])
[INFO:0003DAB7] ('I hope this deal goes through. I'm putting quite a bit of coin on the line... and the last two you set up fell through.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA45])
[INFO:0003DAAD] ('I don't understand it either. They were a sure thing, I swear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA44])
[INFO:0003DABA] ('You just better hope this one isn't another waste of my coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA43])
[INFO:0003DAA4] ('So, the ending of my tale I began earlier...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA42])
[INFO:0003DAB3] ('Is this your tale of single-handedly fighting off a pack of trolls or my favorite... where you bedded four women on the same night?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA41])
[INFO:0003DA8E] ('Well, if you don't want to hear it, that's your loss.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA40])
[INFO:0003DAAF] ('If I wanted to hear a tall tale, I'll read a children's storybook. Get some better stories, Vipir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003DA3F])

[INFO:0003D1E2] ('Nonsense. The best place for our men is driving the Imperials back. I will ensure that men from Dawnstar get every opportunity for glory.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1AE])
[INFO:0003D1B5] ('Glory is meaningless if they have no home to return to. I urge you to lower our commitments to the front until I'm sure we're safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1AD])
[INFO:0003D1C1] ('I won't have you rob our soldiers of their chance to drive out the Empire. I'm done discussing this, Jod.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1AC])
[INFO:0003D1D3] ('Bulfrek, I have an order of swords and armor from the local blacksmith coming here. I need every piece polished to a fine shine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1AB])
[INFO:0003D1DF] ('Yes, my Jarl. We could hardly waste anyone else's precious time on such a tedious task.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1AA])
[INFO:0003D1B7] ('Exactly, Bulfrek. You always know your place.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A9])
[INFO:0003D1B9] ('Skald, if you don't mind sir, I have a request.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A8])
[INFO:0003D1D8] ('You, have a request of me, Bulfrek? This should be interesting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A7])
[INFO:0003D1E3] ('Well, I was thinking sir, with the war going on and all. Maybe, I could enlist? Fight the Imperials?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A6])
[INFO:0003D1FD] ('A servant? Enlisting in the Stormcloaks? Ah, Bulfrek, that's why I like having you about. You're always good for a laugh.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A5])
[INFO:0003D1B6] ('Uh, yes sir. That's me. The oafish servant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A4])
[INFO:0003D1C9] ('Madena, can we count on your spells to assist us in this war? The Empire is bound to bring their battlemages against us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A3])
[INFO:0003D1C7] ('I told you before, Skald, I have no interest in taking sides in this war. I've no desire to be killed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A2])
[INFO:0003D1CC] ('What good is a court mage if she refuses to fight? Where's your sense of duty?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A1])
[INFO:0003D1E8] ('When I came here, my only duties were to cure crop diseases and occasionally light a bonfire on holidays. I didn't sign up to kill.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D1A0])
[INFO:0003D1FA] ('Fine, but this isn't over Madena. We'll talk again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D19F])
[INFO:0003D1BA] ('Skald, I've been meaning to ask you for a leave of absence. I wish to return to High Rock until this war is over.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D19E])
[INFO:0003D1CD] ('You wish to leave now? In Skyrim's moment of triumph, just before we cast off the yoke of Imperial rule?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D19D])
[INFO:0003D1E4] ('Yes, that's exactly what I'm asking. I'm not a Nord, I'm a Breton, and I have no wish to fight this war.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D19C])
[INFO:0003D1F2] ('I don't think so, Madena. There will be no deserters in this hold, and that's final.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D19B])
[INFO:0003D1CA] ('Just like old times, huh Horik? You and me fighting in a war over some forsaken scrap of land.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D19A])
[INFO:0003D1B3] ('Brings back memories. Do you have any orders for me, Legate?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D199])
[INFO:0003D1F9] ('Keep the guard alert. I want to make sure no townspeople get hurt if there's trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D198])
[INFO:0003D1DC] ('Yes, Legate. No one is getting through us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D197])
[INFO:0003D1E5] ('Shor's bones, I hope you're right.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D196])
[INFO:0003D1E6] ('We should go over our strategy again in case the Stormcloaks attack.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D195])

[INFO:0003D1DD] ('I don't think that's needed, Horik. It's the same strategy we used for every major defense during the Great War. It'll serve just as well now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D194])
[INFO:0003D1B8] ('Considering how the Great War ended, I think we need to be cautious about what we rely on.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D193])
[INFO:0003D1BD] ('Maybe you're right. I guess the battles I won yesterday won't win today's wars.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D192])
[INFO:0003D1DE] ('I'm sorry, Legate. I didn't want to imply anything about your ability to lead. You're a hero to the Empire, and I....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D191])
[INFO:0003D1FE] ('Oh, don't be such an old stick, Horik. I was joking. I can do that, you know. Redo the battle plans. I'll look over them later.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D190])
[INFO:0003D1E0] ('Yes, Legate.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D18F])
[INFO:0003D1E1] ('I want you to know I don't trust you, Madena. And I'll be watching you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D18D])

[INFO:0003D1D4] ('I'll tell you the same thing I told Skald. I'm here to help the people of Dawnstar, not play politics. Point your suspicions of treachery elsewhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D18C])
[INFO:0003D1BE] ('So you say. We'll see if that's true when the Stormcloaks make their move.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D18B])
[INFO:0003D1FF] ('Well, at the first sign of battle I'll be comfortably sitting in my room, waiting for it to end, so don't you worry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D18A])
[INFO:0003D1D9] ('I've seen you walking with a bit of pain sometimes, Horik.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D189])
[INFO:0003D1C4] ('I'm fine, Madena.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D188])
[INFO:0003D1CB] ('I know old men sometimes have pains in their legs when they rise from bed. I know a few spells that could help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D187])
[INFO:0003D1F8] ('I said I'm fine, Madena. I won't have some court mage fixing me up like some magical experiment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D186])
[INFO:0003D1EC] ('Still suspicious of me. Well, don't say I never offered.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D185])
[INFO:0003D1C5] ('Madena, I was wondering if you could help me with something. Your magic would be invaluable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D184])
[INFO:0003D1DA] ('If this is about battle magic, forget it. I've told every Jarl I've served under that I won't....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D183])
[INFO:0003D1D1] ('Actually, I was just wondering if you could make sure people are tended to if they get hurt. I'm sure you wouldn't object to that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D182])
[INFO:0003D1C0] ('I, well, no of course not. I would be glad to help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D181])
[INFO:0003D1B2] ('Thank you, Madena. I appreciate your assistance.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D180])
[INFO:0003D1F3] ('Father, do you want to talk? About mother?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D173])
[INFO:0003D1EB] ('No, Karita. I don't think I could.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D172])
[INFO:0003D1F6] ('I'm sure she would want you to be happy, father. Entertaining the guests and drinking and making your lewd jokes like before.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D171])
[INFO:0003D1C2] ('I'm sorry. I just don't feel up to entertaining anyone just now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D170])
[INFO:0003D1E9] ('I was wondering, father. Maybe you should take a day off and head into town. I could watch the inn while you're away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D16D])
[INFO:0003D1D5] ('Why would I do that? There's work to be done here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D16C])
[INFO:0003D1D2] ('It'll do you good! Maybe you could visit Irgnir or Fruki on your way out? I've seen them looking at you when they come in for drinks....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D16B])
[INFO:0003D1C6] ('Why would they be looking at me? Are they upset about the service?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D16A])
[INFO:0003D1E7] ('Oh, never mind.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003D169])

[INFO:0003CD8F] ('You never talk much about yourself, do you Horik? I swear, these past 30 years you've been at my side, and I think I barely know you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD7B])
[INFO:0003CDA4] ('What's to say? I was born on a farm, joined the Legion when I came of age, and I've served you ever since.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD7A])
[INFO:0003CD84] ('What about your family? There must have been someone waiting for you back at the farm. Wondering if you were ever coming home?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD79])
[INFO:0003CDB1] ('No. Can't say there was. My parents died when I was young. You and the Legion have been my only family since.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD78])
[INFO:0003CD96] ('I see. You're a good soldier, Horik. I'm sorry for intruding.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD77])
[INFO:0003CD94] ('You weren't. There's just not much to it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD76])
[INFO:0003CDBC] ('Are you all right? You seem tired.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD75])
[INFO:0003CDB6] ('I'm fine, Horik. I just... are you worried about this war?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD74])
[INFO:0003CDA1] ('No. If we must fight, we will, and you will lead us to victory. As you always have.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD73])
[INFO:0003CD82] ('With you by my side, is that right Horik?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD72])
[INFO:0003CDA8] ('Of course. I would have it no other way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD71])
[INFO:0003CD8B] ('So much for old soldiers settling down to a life of luxury, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD70])
[INFO:0003CD90] ('The forge is hot today.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD69])
[INFO:0003CDB7] ('Not hot enough. Does your Skyrim ever get warm, husband?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD68])
[INFO:0003CDAC] ('Rustleif, I've been wondering. Maybe after the baby is born, we should move to Hammerfell.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD65])
[INFO:0003CD9D] ('Hammerfell? I'm not against the idea, but why?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD64])
[INFO:0003CD81] ('I'm just worried about raising a child in the middle of this war of yours.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD63])
[INFO:0003CDA6] ('War of mine? It's not my war, Seren!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD62])
[INFO:0003CD8A] ('Your people's war, I mean. The Nords. What kind of life would we be giving our little one if we stayed here?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD61])
[INFO:0003CDB0] ('I... well, let me think about it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD60])
[INFO:000545D0] ('Keep at it. We need to work twice as hard now that fat-headed Leigelf has declared war!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD5A])
[INFO:0003CD9B] ('We're at war with Leigelf? Isn't he your husband?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD59])
[INFO:0003CDBE] ('No he isn't! He's the enemy, and we are going to crush him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD58])
[INFO:0003CD9C] ('Drafted into a war, how could my life get worse?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD57])
[INFO:0003CDA0] ('Work hard, now! The pride of Iron-Breaker Mine is on the line.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD53])
[INFO:0003CDA2] ('Pride of the what? This isn't the Legion, boss. We're miners, not soldiers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD51])
[INFO:0003CD80] ('You'll shut your mouth and get back to work, or you won't be a miner or a soldier by the day's end. Hear me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD50])
[INFO:0003CDA3] ('Uh, yes ma'am.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD4F])
[INFO:0003CDB8] ('Thank you for sticking by me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD46])
[INFO:0003CD9F] ('Where else would I go? Dawnstar is my home and working here is my job.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD45])
[INFO:0003CD7D] ('It's good to hear you say that. I wish my wife was as simple as you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD44])
[INFO:0003CDA5] ('I'll, uh, just take that as a compliment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD43])
[INFO:0003CD87] ('If you don't mind me saying, Leigelf. You're working too hard. Go home.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD42])
[INFO:0003CDA9] ('Never. Not until we turn this mine around, drive Beitild out of business, and force her to apologize to me for everything she's done!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD41])
[INFO:0003CD88] ('What is this feud you have with your wife? What started this?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD40])
[INFO:0003CDAA] ('I don't want to talk about it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD3F])
[INFO:0003CD89] ('You don't want to talk about it, or you don't know?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD3E])
[INFO:0003CDAB] ('I don't want to talk about it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD3D])
[INFO:0003CDB9] ('We are poised for glory, Jod. The Empire will never take Dawnstar while every last man, woman, and child here draws breathe!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD3C])
[INFO:0003CD8E] ('With respect, Jarl. You can't ask everyone to throw themselves against trained Legionnaires. Let's leave the fighting to the Stormcloaks.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD3B])

[INFO:0003CDB4] ('You're right. Why dilute the glory with too many souls fighting over it? We'll drive out the Empire and be celebrated as heroes when we win.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD3A])
[INFO:0003CD97] ('If we win. This war is going to drag on for years. I can feel it. We need to prepare for a long struggle ahead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD39])
[INFO:0003CDBB] ('Enough of your dire predictions! We will talk about this another time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003CD38])

[INFO:00090E15] ('Let me know if you need a drink. That's what we're here for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003B68E])
[INFO:0003C3C2] ('The Windpeak Inn features the finest bard in all of Dawnstar. Me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003B68E])

[INFO:000D830E] ('What do you want, Imperial? Ain't my life hard enough?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003B68E])
[INFO:000CADE5] ('Jarl gets booted from Dawnstar, and I'm still stuck cleaning up the dirt.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003B68E])

[INFO:00090E13] ('I've been in charge of Dawnstar for over 35 years.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003B68E])
