column4: [INFO:0003A935] ('When we go back to Largashbur we'll be kings. I like Narzulbur, but don't tell Mul.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A934] ('Mining is tough, but Mul says the money is good so we mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A933] ('Mul is the smart one. I go where he tells me.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A932] ('One of these days we need to head back to the Rift. Get some of that good Riften mead.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A931] ('Mauhulakh brought us in when he found ebony in the mine. Not enough men in town to work it, so here we are.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A930] ('Gadba and me came to work the mine. The plan is to get rich and then go back to Largashbur and take over!' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A92F] ('My sister is blind. I've told her she shouldn't spend so much time with Yatul, but she won't listen. Thinks she's nice.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7AF5] ('I think I like this new mate of my father's. I mean... nothing like that. I just think she's nice.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A92E] ('I never knew my mother, but I doubt even she acted as affectionate with my father as Yatul and Bolar do.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7AE8] ('Glad my father seems to have found someone. I just hope she can hold her own against my aunts.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A92D] ('Haven't you seen how my aunts act with my father? It's beyond strange.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A92C] ([SO]'New to Narzulbur? If you're smart, you'll keep moving. There is a wicked shadow over this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A92B] ('Sometimes I wonder if my aunts are right about my father -- he does seem weak.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A92A] ('Yatul's been teaching me to hunt. I'm still learning, but she's the best teacher I could have.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7AD1] ('I never would have thought, but Uglarz is an even better hunter than Yatul was. The things I'm learning now...' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7ACE] ('Uglarz is a great huntress. Perhaps she can teach me something new.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A929] ('My brother keeps trying to spin these fantasies to me about my aunts and our father. He's crazy.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A928] ('I know I sound abrasive. It's just that I love Mauhulakh so much that I want us to be happy together.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A927] ('Orc chiefs should be strong and stand alone. They need no companions. Progeny is a poor excuse.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7ACD] ('Well at least now Mauhulakh has nothing to whine about. Until this one dies, too.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A926] ('Mauhulakh. He wants to be a leader but spends too much time moping over women. Bolar and I should be all he needs.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A925] ('Yatul and I tend to dote on Mauhulakh. You know how aunts can be with their favorite nephew.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A924] ('Mauhulakh was such a darling boy. Until he got older and started having opinions.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])

[INFO:0003A923] ('Urog and Dushnamub were such lovely children. I held them as they watched their mothers die after birth. They know me best, now.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7AC7] ('All my auguring never predicted this. A woman for Mauhulakh, eh? We'll see how this goes.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A922] ('I've read the entrails many times, but can't fathom why Mauhulakh's wives keep finding tragedy.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7AC5] ('I'm hoping this wife can outlast the winter.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A921] ('Been married many times, but the gods keep taking them from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:000E7AC3] ('I am proud to have a mate to share in my blessings.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A920] ('The blessings of the mine have been many, but I have no mate to share them.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A91F] ('Come to purchase ebony? Our Gloombound Mine runs thick with black veins.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A91E] ([SO]'The great stronghold of Narzulbur welcomes you, outsider.' in GRUP Topic Children of NarzulburHellos [DIAL:0003A8AE])
[INFO:0003A954] ('I wonder if I could put the dogs to work somehow. But I don't really have the heart to force them.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A953] ('Once the sun goes down, it's just me and the dogs. They keep me warm, and don't talk too much.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])

[INFO:0003A952] ('Master Cruel-Sea comes and works the fields sometimes. I don't think the Mistress likes it, but she won't come out here to catch him.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A951] ('Better to work in the cold than in the heat, I say. Though some sun would be nice.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A950] ('Every now and then someone from the city comes by. Think they aren't used to seeing a Nord working for a Dark Elf.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A94F] ('Starting to get too old to work all day, but hopefully Master Hlaalu will let me slow down a bit.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A94E] ('My sister and I both work for the Nords. Our brother is ashamed of us, but at least we can affort to eat.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A94D] ('Of course working for Bolfrida isn't my first choice. But what else can a Dunmer do out here?' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])

[INFO:0003A94C] ('Farm work is hard work. It's good to relax when I can, but I still have to listen to my brothers harping about "injustices."' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A94B] ('Bolfrida is certainly grating, but she pays well. Thankfully nobody from the city can see me out here.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A94A] ('The weather's harsh, but I like to think my sunny personality is what helps the grain grow.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A949] ('Nothing tastes better than food you've grown yourself. Something magic about dirt and sunshine making food.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A948] ('Welcome, welcome, welcome! Don't see many strangers out here. Come to get your hands dirty on a real farm?' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A947] ('Of course, without functioning mills, who will make the arrows for our soldiers? Men have no sense of irony.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A946] ('There's plenty of good wood around here, but I just can't harvest it all by myself. Everyone able-bodied is fighting.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])

[INFO:0003A945] ('I used to have five good men who worked the mill with me. Then this war started and they all ran off. Idiots with mead in their blood.' in GRUP Topic Children of EastmarchHellos [DIAL:0003A8AD])
[INFO:0003A8E4] ('Calm yourself, Galmar. Save it for the battlefield.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8AC])
[INFO:0003A8F4] ('Our men are getting massacred out there. Damn Imperials.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8AB])
[INFO:0003A8E9] ('We can't march on Solitude. Not yet. One thing at a time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8AA])
[INFO:0003A8E1] ('We need to move faster. Keep them off balance.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A9])
[INFO:0003A8F0] ('It's working, Galmar. Our patience has won us friends and allies. And our armies are systematically taking care of the rest.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A8])
[INFO:0003A8C3] ('Is there any news from High Rock?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A7])
[INFO:0003A902] ('Not a peep. Those prissy Bretons can't be made to lift a finger to help their neighbors.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A6])
[INFO:0003A8F9] ('I suppose we shouldn't be surprised. They've never had many problems with the Empire.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A5])
[INFO:0003A940] ('Those milk drinkers? Might as well be elves. Think they're better than us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A4])
[INFO:0003A955] ('Regardless. It appears Skyrim must stand alone. Again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A3])
[INFO:0003A8C8] ('I'm still not sure I understand what you're asking.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A2])
[INFO:0003A8BF] ('A navy, my lord. We could stop the influx of Imperial troops to Solitude, and choke their northern lines.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A1])
[INFO:0003A941] ('But most of their supply routes come south, from Cyrodiil.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A8A0])
[INFO:0003A8C0] ('But imagine -- fleets of ships sailing from Windhelm, all bearing the Stormcloak flag! It would be glorious!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A89F])
[INFO:0003A909] ('And I suppose the Cruel-Seas would be just the clan to provide ships and men?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A89E])
[INFO:0003A8F7] ('You need but ask.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A89D])
[INFO:0003A8CE] ('I'll think on this, but I make no promises.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A89C])
[INFO:0003A8E7] ('I can ask no more. Thank you, my lord!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A89B])
[INFO:0003A90E] ('Captain, I've been receiving complaints about this Giordano woman.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A89A])
[INFO:0003A93D] ('Yes, sir. I've been trying to quiet her, but she's insistent. She thinks she can find out who's been killing the women...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A899])
[INFO:0003A8E0] ('I don't care if she can find a living dwarf -- I can't have her stirring up trouble. We have enough problems as it is.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A898])
[INFO:0003A8BC] ('Yes, sir. I'll try to contain her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A897])
[INFO:0003A907] ('See that you do. I will not let Windhelm descend into chaos over a few overactive imaginations.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A896])
[INFO:0003A8B8] ('What's the current spirit among the dark elves?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A895])
[INFO:0003A91A] ('As restless as ever, sir, but I don't see them taking any kind of incendiary action. Not soon, anyway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A894])
[INFO:0003A8B7] ('Well that much is good. Let's finish this first war before starting the next one, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A893])
[INFO:0003A8BA] ('Um... yes, of course, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A892])
[INFO:0003A90A] ('Carry on, Lonely-Gale. And loosen yourself a bit.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A891])
[INFO:0003A901] ('Galmar thinks we should double our men in the Reach.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A890])
[INFO:0003A8D6] ('A reasonable strategy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A88F])
[INFO:0003A8F8] ('And you, Jorleif?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A88E])
[INFO:0003A8CF] ('Well, sir, the hold of Falkreath is fairly vulnerable, and blocks the only road from Cyrodiil.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A88D])
[INFO:0003A8DC] ('A good point, old friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A88C])
[INFO:0003A90C] ('To be sure, my lord, I am not skilled in the arts of war or military tactics.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A88B])
[INFO:0003A917] ('But you're able to see the whole in the parts, and for that I'm grateful.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A88A])
[INFO:0003A93A] ('As you wish, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A889])
[INFO:0003A8B3] ('Sir, there continues to be unrest in the Gray Quarter.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A888])
[INFO:0003A8CA] ('Blasted dark elves. I don't suppose you could tell them that I presently have larger concerns? Such as all of Skyrim?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A887])
[INFO:0003A90B] ('They don't seem to be very sympathetic to our cause, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A886])
[INFO:0003A8C5] ('Let me know if you hear anything more substantial?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A883])
[INFO:0003A8FD] ('Of course, my lord.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A882])
[INFO:0003A938] ('Jorleif, I want you to send a messenger to our western camps.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A881])
[INFO:0003A8C7] ('And the message, sir?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A880])
[INFO:0003A8E3] ('I'm diverting Gar and Haddring's men to join him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A87F])
[INFO:0003A8FB] ('Is that wise, sir?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A87E])
[INFO:0003A91C] ('It will work if we can pull Hran's men from the south. And find a bit of luck.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A87D])
[INFO:0003A8C2] ('Of course. Something that seems to be in short supply these days.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A87C])
[INFO:0003A93F] ('I'm not seeking advice right now, friend. Just send the message.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A87B])
[INFO:0003A8EC] ('So what's the news on the street, Captain?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A862])
[INFO:0003A937] ('The dark elves are uneasy. There's a killer on the streets. And Viola Giordano won't leave me alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A861])
[INFO:0003A8E2] ('How would you like a drink?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A860])
[INFO:0003A900] ('Very much so.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A85F])
[INFO:0003A8AF] ('Coming right up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A85E])
[INFO:0003A8D7] ('Calixto, someone left an interesting ring in here a few weeks ago. Would you like a look?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A85D])
[INFO:0003A8EF] ('Of course, my dear. It may prove to be quite the curiosity! One must always be alert.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A85C])
[INFO:0003A90D] ('Well, I seem to have misplaced it at the moment. But it was white, like alabaster, with three bright rubies set in it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A85B])
[INFO:0003A942] ('Be very careful with that. It sounds as if it may be the Death Ring of Dro'farahn. A ring of the most dangerous sort.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A85A])
[INFO:0003A8B2] ('Oh dear. What should I do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A859])
[INFO:0003A8C6] ('Bring it to me straight away when you find it. Don't dally. I can keep it safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A858])
[INFO:0003A936] ('Oh, thank the gods you're in Windhelm, Calixto!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A857])
[INFO:0003A90F] ('Think nothing of it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A856])
[INFO:0003A8C9] ('Oh, Jora. Good to see you. I was wondering if you might ask Lortheim something for me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A855])
[INFO:0003A93B] ('Don't bother. I don't have much chance of seeing my husband these days. He's always up in the palace with Ulfric.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A854])
[INFO:0003A8B5] ('Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Is everything all right?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A853])
[INFO:0003A8ED] ('It's been better, I'll be honest with you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A852])
[INFO:0003A8B9] ('Here, let me get you some mead. This one's on me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A851])
[INFO:0003A8D1] ('I just don't know what to do anymore. He's hardly ever in the temple. I see him at breakfast, and that's it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A850])
[INFO:0003A8C4] ('I know, dear. He's a busy man, though, and loyal to the Stormcloaks.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A84F])
[INFO:0003A93C] ('What about being loyal to his wife?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A84E])
[INFO:0003A911] ('I... I'm sorry, dear, I've got some other customers. I'll be back around in a minute.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A84D])
[INFO:0003A8EA] ('Don't you ever find it demeaning, working for that Nord family?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A848])
[INFO:0003A8DA] ('Look, Ambarys, I just came here for a drink. I don't need any trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A847])
[INFO:0003A8B4] ('Fine, then. I guess some Dunmer are content to be their pets.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A846])
[INFO:0003A8CB] ('Here's what's going to happen. I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that, and you're going to leave me alone. Deal?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A845])
[INFO:0003A8CC] ('What's new with the Cruel-Seas, Suvaris? Have they given you one of those helmets with the horns on them yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A844])
[INFO:0003A8F5] ('What do you want from me? I work for them ok? We're not friends. They pay me, and I get the job done. That's it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A843])
[INFO:0003A905] ('Touchy. Maybe some Dunmer lives in you yet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A842])
[INFO:0003A903] ('Either pour another drink or keep moving, Ambarys.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A841])
[INFO:0003A8E6] ('Why do the Nords bother you so much, Ambarys?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A840])
[INFO:0003A944] ('Why do you even need to ask? They treat your people as bad as they do mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A83F])
[INFO:0003A8FC] ('I think that's just their way. The Nords don't like anybody who's not a Nord, but they're not bad people, deep down.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A83E])
[INFO:0003A918] ('Look around you. Don't you know what their little war is about? They want all non-Nords out of Skyrim. That means you and me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A83D])
[INFO:0003A908] ('Oh, I doubt that very much. Who would load their ships, then?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A83C])
[INFO:0003A91B] ('Just you wait and see.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A83B])
[INFO:0003A8E5] ('How much do they pay you per day?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A83A])
[INFO:0003A8BB] ('That's really none of your business...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A839])
[INFO:0003A8FA] ('How much?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A838])
[INFO:0003A8E8] ('Eight septims per day, plus lodging.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A837])
[INFO:0003A913] ('Eight septims for breaking your back, and then you live in squalor. How much is your dignity worth?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A836])
[INFO:0003A8CD] ('If it's all the same to you, Scouts-Many-Marshes prefers to eat and drink in peace.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A835])
[INFO:0003A8F6] ('Sorry, my scaly friend, you've come to the wrong place. Around here we don't ignore what's happening in the world.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A834])
[INFO:0003A919] ('Niranye, I just have to know -- what is your secret?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A833])
[INFO:0003A904] ('My... my what, now?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A832])
[INFO:0003A8B1] ('You know. Where do you get your goods? I am always amazed at how you manage to sell things so cheaply.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003A831])

column4: [INFO:00038286] ('Have you been learning your ores?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003826A])

[INFO:00038278] ('Don't even bother with that one. Leave it to the orcs.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038268])
[INFO:00038284] ('Oh, right. That makes sense. Kind of a messy metal, anyway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038267])
[INFO:0003827B] ('Exactly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038266])
[INFO:00038273] ('Is Ulfric's armor done yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038265])
[INFO:0003827D] ('Fenrig! You're alive!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038264])
[INFO:00038277] ('Of course I am. What brings you here?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038263])

[INFO:0003827C] ('But that battle isn't expected until tomorrow... Ruki, what's going on?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038261])
[INFO:00038274] ('I'm so confused. What's happening?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038260])

column4: [INFO:000382B8] ('We are done talking about this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003825D])
[INFO:000382C5] ('Well what are you going to do then, huh? Let's hear it!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003825C])
[INFO:0003824E] ('Foolish old woman! You know nothing! Nothing of our struggles, our suffering!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038244])
[INFO:0003824C] ('Nothing? And what of my son? Hmm? What of Thorald? Is he nothing? So don't talk to me about suffering!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038243])
[INFO:00038245] ('Your son chose his side, and he chose poorly. And now he's gone. Such is the way of war. The sooner you accept his loss, the better.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038242])

[INFO:0003824F] ('I will never accept his death! My son still lives. I feel it in my heart. So tell me, Battle-Borns, where is he? Where are you holding my Thorald?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038241])
[INFO:00038247] ('Do you believe this old hag?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038240])
[INFO:00038250] ('"Holding him"? Why I've got him in my cellar. He's my prisoner.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003823F])
[INFO:00038248] ('Face it, cow! Your stupid son is dead! He died a Stormcloak traitor. And you... you best keep your mouth shut before you suffer the same.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003823E])
[INFO:00038246] ('Come on, father. There's nothing more to be said here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038238])
[INFO:000382BE] ('So this is your plan, Lucan?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003814A])
[INFO:00038309] ('Yes. So now you don't have to go, do you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038149])
[INFO:000382C3] ('Oh really? Well I think your new helper here needs a guide.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038148])
[INFO:000382B9] ('Wh- no... I.... Oh, by the Eight, fine. But only to the edge of town!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038147])
[INFO:00038308] ('Those thieves must be mad, hiding out there. Those old crypts are filled with nothing but traps, trolls, and who knows what else!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00038142])
[INFO:000382BD] ('I wonder why they only stole Lucan's golden claw. I mean, we have plenty of things in the shop that are worth just as much coin.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003810E])

[INFO:00038064] ([R]'Some fool is opening a museum in Dawnstar. They say he's paying people to collect artifacts from that old Mythic Dawn cult.' in GRUP Topic Children of DA07RumorsTopic [DIAL:00038063])
[INFO:00037EB6] ('Arch-Mage, the Synod have contacted us again, asking if we've any word on their researchers. What shall I tell them?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EB5])
[INFO:00037EBE] ('What did you tell them last time?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EB4])
[INFO:00037EC1] ('That they had arrived, asked for information which was provided to them, and went on their way with no suggestion of further interaction.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EB3])
[INFO:00037EB7] ('That hasn't changed, has it? Then just tell them again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EB2])
[INFO:00037EC2] ('Should we consider investigating the matter?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EB1])
[INFO:00037EB8] ('No, I don't think so. Respond to their request, and we'll leave it at that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EB0])
[INFO:00037EC3] ('Yes, Arch-Mage. Thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EAF])
[INFO:00037EB9] ('Err, excuse me Enthir. Might I have a moment?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EAE])
[INFO:00037EC4] ('What is it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EAD])
[INFO:00037EBA] ('Yes, err, apologies for the intrusion. I was wondering, err, if you could possibly, ah, procure a few select items for me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EAC])
[INFO:00037EBD] ('Really, Arniel? Because I seem to recall doing just that for you recently, at which point you assured me that you'd cover my expenses.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EAB])
[INFO:00037EC5] ('And that, my nervous little friend, has not happened. Would you care to comment on that, perhaps?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EAA])
[INFO:00037EC7] ('Ahh, hmm. Yes. I, err, I was unaware that I had forgotten that. I will, err, I mean I'll take care of that as soon as possible.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA9])
[INFO:00037EBB] ('See that you do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA8])
[INFO:00037EBF] ('So, Arniel. How's that little project of yours coming along? Any progress worth mentioning?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA7])
[INFO:00037EC6] ('Oh, that. Err, yes. It's... It's quite promising, I believe. Definitely on the right track. Results, err, results should be soon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA6])
[INFO:00037ED4] ('Right. And what did you say the point of this little venture was?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA5])
[INFO:00037EBC] ('Oh, no. Err, wouldn't do to say at all. Not, err, not now. Not at all. I have far too many things to do still.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA4])
[INFO:00037EC0] ('If you say so.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037EA3])
[INFO:00037E6E] ('You've been spending a fair bit of time with Sergius lately, I see.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E61])
[INFO:00037E78] ('What? Why, the audacity! How dare you imply such a thing!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E60])
[INFO:00037E71] ('Calm down! Why are you over-reacting? I was going to ask if the two of you are collaborating on research!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E5F])
[INFO:00037E66] ('Oh! Well... I... I'm sorry. Yes, we have been working on something together.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E5E])
[INFO:00037E63] ('This is why I avoid being social.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E5D])
[INFO:00037E75] ('Ah, my dearest Urag! How are you today, my green-skinned friend?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E5C])
[INFO:00037E73] ('Did you need something, Colette?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E5B])

[INFO:00037E68] ('I only wish to escape the constant glaring of my "colleagues" and discover an opportunity for repose. Your Arcanaeum is so lovely and quiet...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E5A])
[INFO:00037E65] ('I... see.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E59])
[INFO:00037E6B] ('Don't fret, my fanged acquaintance. I shan't trouble you a bit.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E58])
[INFO:00037E72] ('Was there something specific you needed?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E57])
[INFO:00037E7A] ('I'm positive whatever I require will be revealed to me on its own, in due time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E56])
[INFO:00037E64] ('So, you don't need anything then.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E55])
[INFO:00037E6D] ('Oh, my dear Urag. You're trying so hard to help. I do hope you're not disappointed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E54])
[INFO:00037E74] ('"Disappointed" is not the word I would choose, Colette. Excuse me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E53])
[INFO:00037E7C] ('Mirabelle, would you please make sure my schedule is clear for the next few days? I'm working on something important.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E52])
[INFO:00037E67] ('Your schedule is always clear, Arch-Mage. I see to that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E51])
[INFO:00037E6C] ('Ah, yes. True. Well, thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E50])
[INFO:00037E76] ('Sir, the Imperial Legion has again requested assistance. What shall I tell them?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E4F])
[INFO:00037E7B] ('The same thing we've told them before, and the same thing we've told these Stormcloaks. It's not our concern.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E4E])
[INFO:00037E69] ('Forgive me, but at what point does it become our concern?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E4D])
[INFO:00037E6F] ('Never. The College cannot become mired in local politics. What happens inside these walls is our worry. What happens outside is theirs.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E4C])
[INFO:00037E77] ('Is there anything new I should be aware of, Mirabelle?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E4B])

[INFO:00037E62] ('I'm dealing with a few new research proposals, evaluating the results of three long-term projects, and keeping an eye on our new Apprentices.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E4A])
[INFO:00037E6A] ('There were also two items requiring disciplinary action recently.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E49])
[INFO:00037E70] ('Everything's under control, then? Right. Keep up the good work.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E48])
[INFO:00037E79] ('Yes, thank you Arch-Mage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037E47])
[INFO:00037DFE] ('I'm not so sure the few guards they've assigned to the farm are enough.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF6])
[INFO:00037DF9] ('It will have to do. Besides, if it came to blows, I'm sure the Snow-Shod's would come out here and assist us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF5])
[INFO:00037DFC] ('I suppose so. I just fear they won't make it out here in time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF4])
[INFO:00037DFA] ('Just worry about keeping the fields tended and let the Jarl worry about the war.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF3])
[INFO:00037DFB] ('My darling, you've made me the happiest woman in all Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF2])
[INFO:00037DF8] ('It brings me joy to hear that, but what possessed you to say that so suddenly?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF1])
[INFO:00037DFD] ('I've already lost a family, and we're about to start a new one. I don't want that to happen again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DF0])
[INFO:00037DF7] ('My sweet Leanora, I will never let anything happen to us. I promise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DEF])
[INFO:00037DBE] ('Can you believe we're here? Saarthal, of all places.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DBB])
[INFO:00037DC0] ('I'm surprised that the College is allowed to excavate here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DBA])
[INFO:00037DC6] ('I bet your family would be amazed, right?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB9])
[INFO:00037DC7] ('Amazed isn't the right word. They might find this... offensive.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB8])
[INFO:00037DBF] ('Are you looking for any specific volumes, Drevis?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB7])
[INFO:00037DC4] ('Hmm? Oh, no. No, not really. I... Actually, I've forgotten what I was looking for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB6])
[INFO:00037DC8] ('Ah. Well, then. Let me know if you need anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB5])
[INFO:00037DBC] ('What's that? Oh yes, yes. Thank you, I will.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB4])
[INFO:00037DC1] ('Can I help you with anything, Nirya?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB3])
[INFO:00037DC5] ('I was wondering. Has Faralda been in recently? Borrowed any books that you can recall?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB2])
[INFO:00037DC9] ('Nirya...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB1])
[INFO:00037DBD] ('Did she, perhaps, mention any dangerous research she might be working on? Anything that could get her in trouble?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DB0])
[INFO:00037DC2] ('I'm here to help you with books, Nirya. That's all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DAF])
[INFO:00037DC3] ('Ah, yes. Of course. No, I don't need anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037DAE])
[INFO:00103286] ([G]'What in blazes is going on? Are you working with Karliah?' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00103285] ([G]'Vex better leave a piece of Mercer for us. It's payback time.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00103284] ([G]'How dare you bring that Dunmer bitch here.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00103283] ([G]'I can't believe he emptied the vault. Right from under our noses.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5C4] ('I heard what happened and the Guild owes you thanks for bringing this to light.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5C3] ([SO]'There's no doubt Mercer will make for the borders of Skyrim. I hope you find him before he escapes our grasp.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00103282] ([G]'Vex is ready to tear you apart. I hope you have a good excuse for bringing Karliah here.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5C2] ([G]'Punishment's too good for Mercer Frey. The only penalty for his betrayal is death.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00103281] ([G]'They're waiting for you in the cistern. No tricks.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5C1] ([G]'If I find Mercer first, I'm going to crush his skull with my bare hands!' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00103280] ([G]'They say that Karliah murdered Gallus, but I'm not so sure.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5C0] ([G]'How can Karliah remain so calm when Mercer had her on the run for that long? Amazing.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:0010327F] ([G]'If you don't have a good reason to be partnered with Karliah, you're dead.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5BF] ([G]'I won't rest until Mercer's dead. How could he murder Gallus and betray all of us like that?' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5BE] ([G]'I hope he turns up soon... he needs to answer for his betrayal.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:0010327E] ([G]'So it's true. You've turned traitor. I can't believe it.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5BD] ([G]'I never saw this coming, I thought we were just having a run of bad luck.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:0010327D] ([G]'Look at that dark elf whore... strutting around like she's innocent. I'll cut her open from gullet to groin!' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000EA5BC] ([G]'I dare Mercer to come back here! He sets one foot in the cistern and I'll cut it off!' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00072AFF] ('This is Mercer Frey's place and he don't like visitors. Now go away.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00072AFE] ([G]'Can't talk.... I'm outta' here.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000C0518] ([G]'Just take a step back and let me figure this out. Then we'll talk.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000C0517] ('I can't believe this is happening, lass.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00037D77] ('I can't believe this is happening, lad.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:0005DF61] ('Quickly, what is it?' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00055AA1] ([G]'The time for talk has passed. We must hurry.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000C0516] ('How can I help?' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00037D73] ([SO]'I'm relieved Brynjolf has an open mind or that could have gotten bloody.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00037D72] ([G]'We can talk after I find out what's going on.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000C0515] ('Need to stay focused in case Frey comes back, make it fast.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00037D71] ([SO]'If I see Frey, I'll pluck his eyes from his skull with my bare hands!' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000C0514] ([G]'Hold your thoughts 'til after we untangle this mess.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:000C0513] ('Can't talk long, got to keep my eyes open for Mercer.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00037D6E] ([SO]'Stabbed in the back. It's like the Dark Brotherhood all over again.' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07Hellos [DIAL:00037D67])
[INFO:00037D6B] ('Better question would be "what did he leave."' in GRUP Topic Children of TG07VaultBranchTopic "What's missing from the vault?" [DIAL:00037D66])

column4: [INFO:000750A0] ([G]'Patience. Give me a moment and I'll explain everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of MQ203EsbernBlockingTopic [DIAL:00037BB8])
[INFO:00036362] (in GRUP Topic Children of MQ203EsbernBlockingTopic [DIAL:00037BB8])
[INFO:0007509F] ([G]'I can't wait to see what's inside!' in GRUP Topic Children of MQ203EsbernBlockingTopic [DIAL:00037BB8])
[INFO:0007509E] ([G]'Just think. We're the first to set foot here in thousands of years.' in GRUP Topic Children of MQ203EsbernBlockingTopic [DIAL:00037BB8])
[INFO:00016F99] ('Isn't it amazing?' in GRUP Topic Children of MQ203EsbernBlockingTopic [DIAL:00037BB8])
[INFO:00037BC4] ('Delphine! I... it's good to see you. It's been... a long time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BB3])
[INFO:00037BDB] ('It's good to see you, too, Esbern. It's been too long, old friend. Too long.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BB2])
[INFO:00037BC9] ('Well, then. You made it, safe and sound. Good. Come on, I have a place we can talk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BB1])
[INFO:00037BB9] ('Orgnar, hold down the bar for a minute, will you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BB0])
[INFO:00037BCC] ('Yeah, sure.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BAF])
[INFO:00037BBC] ('This way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BAE])
[INFO:00037BCF] ('Now then. I assume you know about...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BAD])
[INFO:00037BC5] ('Oh yes! Dragonborn! Indeed, yes.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BAC])
[INFO:00037BBE] ('This changes everything, of course. There's no time to lose. We must locate...  let me show you. I know I had it here, somewhere...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BAB])
[INFO:00037BD8] ('Give me... just a moment...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BAA])
[INFO:00037BC8] ('Esbern, what...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BA9])
[INFO:00037BDA] ('Ah! Here it is. Come, let me show you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BA8])

[INFO:00037BBD] ('You see, right here. Sky Haven Temple, constructed around one of the main Akaviri military camps in the Reach, during their conquest of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00037BA7])

column4: [INFO:00036752] ([R]'I lost my eye defending the Empire... Spare some grub for a veteran?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F4])
[INFO:00036751] ([R]'Please, ma'am, I've got nowhere to go...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F4])
[INFO:00036750] ([R]'Spare a bite for a poor old veteran?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F4])
[INFO:0003674F] ([R]'Alms? Alms for a veteran?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F4])
[INFO:00036781] ([R]'Here, it's all I can spare...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F3])
[INFO:00036780] ([R]'We barely have enough for ourselves...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F3])
[INFO:0003677F] ([R]'I'm sorry...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F3])
[INFO:000367B2] ([R]'We hardly ever get new customers anymore.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F2])
[INFO:000367B1] ([R]'Sure has been quiet around the shop lately.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F2])
[INFO:0003676B] ([R]'I suppose in wartime, people aren't looking to part with their old junk...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F1])
[INFO:0003676A] ([R]'Not that I mind the break, of course. But, still...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F1])
[INFO:000367AB] ([R]'Father oughtta punch them in the mouth! That'd get people in here!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F0])
[INFO:000367AA] ([R]'Who needs customers and their old junk?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F0])
[INFO:000367A9] ([R]'We'll make it through, dear. We always do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F0])
[INFO:000367A8] ([R]'It's okay, dear. More work than ever down at the blacksmith.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366F0])
[INFO:00036759] ([R]'You're making progress, Heimvar. But my boy could still work the bellows better than you do!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366EF])
[INFO:00036758] ([R]'Come on, Heimvar. My son could stoke the forge better than you do!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366EF])
[INFO:00036784] ('Sure, but I bet he can't hold his mead as well as me!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366EE])
[INFO:00036783] ([R]'Yeah, but can he hammer the anvil for 8 hours straight?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366EE])
[INFO:000367B5] ([R]'Right you are! Guess I'll keep training you... for now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366ED])
[INFO:000367B4] ([R]'Give him time. In a couple years, he'll be the age you were when you started!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366ED])
[INFO:000367B0] ('How's it coming there, Jawanan?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366EB])
[INFO:000366FB] ('Slow, but looking good, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366EA])
[INFO:0003673D] ('Slow's the only way to do it! Work too hard and you'll warp the wood.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E9])
[INFO:00036717] ('Fihada, where did you learn how to make bows so well?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E7])
[INFO:0003678C] ('The same place I learned my charm and quick wits: I used to be an Imperial ranger, my boy!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E6])
[INFO:00036773] ('Wish I could learn some of that charm. I'm just good with bows, not people.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E5])
[INFO:00036730] ('You'd make a better Imperial ranger than me. I may have charmed the locals, but my fellow soldiers hated my waggling tongue.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E4])
[INFO:0003671E] ('Sister dear, could you try sewing those sleeves a little tighter? We can't have our customers looking sloppy because of your work.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E3])
[INFO:000366F6] ('Oh certainly, dear sister. We couldn't afford to have our customers look like the simple pigs they are, now could we?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E2])
[INFO:00036768] ('Good. And while you're at it, perhaps you should sew your mouth shut when our fine customers are within earshot, hrm?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E1])
[INFO:0003671D] ('Vivienne, could you check out supplies of mandrake root?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366E0])
[INFO:0003670E] ('Which one is that again?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366DE])
[INFO:00036766] ('It's the root that looks like an ugly little man.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366DD])
[INFO:00036728] ('In that case, I'm pretty sure it tried to buy me a drink last night.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366DB])
[INFO:000366FC] ('Sir, we can't just keep trading blows with the rebels like this - it's only strengthening their resolve.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366DA])
[INFO:0003678B] ('Your concerns are duly noted, Legate, but unfounded. I assure you, this war will be over in another six months.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D9])

[INFO:0003674C] ('Sir, this is costing lives of both imperial loyalists and Skyrim citizens alike. And it's winning the rebels support where they had none before.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D8])
[INFO:0003672F] ('Don't you think I know that? But these commands come straight from Cyrodiil.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D7])
[INFO:00036703] ('New orders for the soldiers, Legate. Make sure they're distributed as noted.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D6])
[INFO:0003679D] ('Sir, these are missing commands for about half of the commanders.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D5])
[INFO:0003675E] ('That is correct. Those orders have been delivered by special courier. I can't trust some of our normal distribution channels.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D4])
[INFO:00036737] ('Understood, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D3])
[INFO:000366FF] ('Rest up, scum. Probably getting executed tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D2])
[INFO:000367B3] ('Yeah, you said that yesterday.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D1])
[INFO:00036755] ('Guess the headsman's been busy with all your friends. Ha ha ha ha ha!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D0])
[INFO:00036754] ('Come now. You'll want to show up in Sovngarde refreshed. You got an eternity of merrimakin' ahead of you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366D0])
[INFO:00036742] ('Hey, jailor! What I don't understand is why you're siding with the Imperials.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366CF])
[INFO:00036739] ('Shut up, scum.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366CE])

[INFO:00036707] ('I mean, the Redguards fought off the Aldmeri and the Empire, and now Hammerfell is an independent state. That's all we Nords want for Skyrim!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366CD])
[INFO:00036753] ('I said shut up, scum!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366CC])
[INFO:00036761] ('So it's okay if your people rebel against the Empire, but not mine?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366CB])
[INFO:00036708] ('They aren't my "people." I'm with the Empire because they pay me. And that means I'm out here, and you're in there. So shut up, scum!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366CA])
[INFO:0003670D] ('Big shipment coming in later tonight. I need you three working late.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C9])
[INFO:00036762] ('Oh, we'll make sure it's emptied out by morning. You can trust us!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C8])
[INFO:0003672C] ('Yeah, we'll get the valuables out of there, no problem!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C7])
[INFO:00036743] ('My contact, she says Hammerfell steel is much desired by certain parties.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C6])
[INFO:0003670B] ('I know of a ship coming in from Hammerfell. Some cargo might get "lost"...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C5])
[INFO:00036748] ('Why should we settle for half a fin when we could just take the whole whale?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C4])
[INFO:000366F9] ('Patience, sister. Patience.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C3])
[INFO:00036776] ([R]'I ain't begging. I just need a job. Anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C2])
[INFO:00036775] ([R]'Got any work?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C2])
[INFO:0003675C] ([R]'Sorry, I have everyone I need at the warehouse. Times are tight.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C1])
[INFO:0003675B] ([R]'You bother me again, maybe you will not walk away. Understand?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C1])
[INFO:0003675A] ([R]'Shoo! Go away! You get nothing from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C1])
[INFO:00036769] ('My lady, I'm pleased to inform you that you have a new gown for court, specially tailored by madame Endarie.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366C0])
[INFO:000366F5] ('Really? How did we afford that? Besides, I like the gown I already have.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366BF])
[INFO:00036713] ('Madame Endarie insisted. She made it free of charge, in honor of your lenience about last month's rent discrepancies.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366BE])
[INFO:00036746] ('That was suspiciously nice of her. I thought she hated everyone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366BD])
[INFO:00036770] ('She does, my lady. But apparently, she hates you just a little less than the others.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366BC])
[INFO:000366FA] ('What news have you heard from the war, Irnskar?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366BB])
[INFO:00036718] ('You won't like it, my lady.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366BA])
[INFO:00036749] ('I'm well aware that I won't like it. But it's my duty to keep my people safe. Tell me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B9])
[INFO:00036774] ('Possession of the holds change on an almost daily basis, but I can report that Haafingar is still secure. Your people are safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B8])
[INFO:00036700] ('I'm not just talking about my subjects. I'm talking about my people: the proud Nords of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B7])
[INFO:0003671F] ('I told you you wouldn't like the news.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B6])
[INFO:00036756] ('Falk, you shouldn't have come. You know what'd happen if people found out about us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B5])
[INFO:0003677C] ('I know, my lady. I just needed to see you outside of court, away from all of the politics.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B4])

[INFO:0003671B] ('I'm serious. If Erikur knew about us, he'd force you to resign from your position. And without you helping the Jarl, Solitude would be weaker.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B3])

[INFO:0003671A] ('I'm serious. If Erikur knew about us, he'd force you to resign from your position. And without you, he'd have the Jarl bent around his little finger.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B3])
[INFO:00036704] ('You're right, of course. But when this war is over, I'll gladly resign and we can stop sneaking around like this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B2])
[INFO:00036778] ('One more reason to pray for the fighting to end then, my love.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B1])
[INFO:0003675F] ('Sister, how is my fortune coming along?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366B0])
[INFO:0003677D] ('Profits continue to rise. The warehouse continues to bring in good revenues, and rent on your stores in the Well is acceptable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366AF])
[INFO:00036709] ('I'm afraid "acceptable" just isn't acceptable anymore. I'm sure they can spare a few more coins in monthly rent.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366AE])
[INFO:00036723] ('Yes, brother. I'm sure they'll agree it's a fair price to pay in order to avoid interacting with you on a daily basis.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366AD])
[INFO:00036764] ('Fair or not, they'll pay it, and that's all I need to care about. Bear that in mind, sister.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366AC])
[INFO:00036787] ('That clumsy maid at the palace spilled wine on my best suit. Sister, I believe it's time for a replacement.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366AB])
[INFO:00036710] ('I can commission one from the Radiant Raiment. It won't be cheap, but if you want the best, they're the only choice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366AA])
[INFO:00036729] ('I swear, those scheming elves charge us twice what anyone else would pay.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A9])
[INFO:0003676E] ('Of course they do, brother. You keep raising their rent.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A8])
[INFO:00036791] ('Melaran, you lazy milk drinker, have you finished studying the imports from Black Marsh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A7])
[INFO:00036715] ('Indeed I have, sir. Elven weapons for their armies, sir. Elven material, but poor workmanship, like most of what we get from them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A6])
[INFO:00036732] ('Scary, thinking of those boots with an army of Elven weapons at their command. Let's be thankful they're half a world away, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A5])
[INFO:00036772] ('Even a fine weapon is only as good as its wielder, sir. But they should fetch a high price from the Imperial army.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A4])
[INFO:000367AC] ('Right you are, elf! Or even from the rebels, if they've got enough money to make a competitive offer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A3])
[INFO:0003671C] ('As always, lord, your loyalty is a shining example to us all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A2])
[INFO:00036738] ('It's all we've got for today. Don't be greedy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A1])
[INFO:0003677B] ([R]'Potatoes? Again?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A0])
[INFO:0003677A] ([R]'Fish? Again?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000366A0])
[INFO:00036790] ('Eat up, Svari.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003669F])
[INFO:00036701] ('Maybe we'll have better luck tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003669E])
[INFO:00036731] ('We'll make it, Greta. We always have so far...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003669D])
[INFO:00036757] ('Where've you been all day?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003669C])
[INFO:000367A7] ('At the market, father.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003669B])
[INFO:0003674B] ('Well, did you bring back any mead?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003669A])
[INFO:00036745] ('I barely make enough for us to eat as it is, father. You can't just drink it all away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036699])
[INFO:00036702] ('Humph. Some daughter you are.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036698])
[INFO:000366F8] ('Svari, Jala said you stole an apple from her cart yesterday. Is this true?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036697])
[INFO:0003675D] ('Just a little one! I was hungry!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036696])
[INFO:00036747] ('I'll talk with Jala, dear. I'm sure she'll accept a potato as repayment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036695])
[INFO:0003670A] ('I suppose. But Svari, we don't steal. We're better than that. Understand?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036694])
[INFO:000366FD] ('Yes, papa.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036693])
[INFO:00036765] ('Father, could you clean up the house a little while I'm away?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036692])
[INFO:0003674D] ('Maybe. I'll see if I feel like it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036691])
[INFO:00036711] ('I'm on my feet all day. Can you please do this one thing for me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036690])
[INFO:00036705] ('Sure, whatever.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003668F])
[INFO:00036785] ('A word, my love?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003668E])
[INFO:00036763] ('What troubles you, darling?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003668D])
[INFO:00036726] ('I fear attendance is down. There are so few worshippers coming to see us. Could it be that the war has weakened their faith?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003668C])
[INFO:0003670F] ('Nonsense, dear. I've had more visitors than ever seeking the wisdom of the hearth goddesses.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003668B])
[INFO:00036789] ('Ah, that must be it. So many of the men are serving in battle. I shall pray to Stendarr that they return victorious.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003668A])
[INFO:0003676D] ('Silana, you don't seem yourself. Is something the matter?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036689])
[INFO:0003672D] ('Oh, yes sir. I feel many of Solitude's families are having trouble getting by, and the wealthy do nothing to help them!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036688])

[INFO:00036714] ('Your compassion is admirable, but you see, we cannot help them all. The poor must learn from the examples of the gods and raise themselves up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036687])
[INFO:0003679B] ('I respectfully disagree, sir. Stendarr and Zenithar may demand strength from them, but Mara and Dibella demand compassion from us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036686])
[INFO:00036771] ('I see you have meditated on this subject quite thoroughly. I shall not stop you, but please, try to attend to your temple duties as well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036685])
[INFO:00036735] ('Mistress, a word?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036684])
[INFO:00036779] ('Certainly, acolyte. What troubles you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036683])

[INFO:000367AE] ('I know you and father Rorlund have many duties to attend to in the temple, but sometimes I feel that there are more important matters to attend to.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036682])
[INFO:00036722] ('What could be more important than hearing the prayers of the faithful, and answering the questions of the dedicated?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036681])

[INFO:0003673B] ('Mistress, the people of Solitude are destitute. Many are starving and desperate for work. We need to be more active, to reach out to them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036680])
[INFO:00036782] ('We took you in, didn't we? We would be glad to extend our welcome to any other who showed your dedication. What more could we do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667F])
[INFO:000367B8] ('I know, and I appreciate it dearly. But I can't help but feel we could be doing more...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667E])
[INFO:00036725] ('Kynareth has blessed you with tremendous compassion, Silana. You will find a way, I'm sure of it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667D])
[INFO:0003678F] ('Pardon me, but I trust you've been working on your poem, on the classical heroes of Skyrim, yes?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667C])
[INFO:0003678E] ('Your solo performance is about a week away. I expect to hear your early rendition tomorrow, understand?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667C])
[INFO:0003678D] ('You there. Have you performed your voice exercises today?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667C])
[INFO:000367A6] ('Why do we always focus on retelling the old stories? There are so many new stories being made, right now...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:000367A5] ('Must it be written? Poetry is so dull when it isn't set to music.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:000367A4] ('Yes sir, Professor Gemane! It's a war epic about Hoag Merkiller's last stand!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:000367A3] ('Oh, thank you! I've been working on an original piece. I hope it can stand up to the classics!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:000367A2] ('At this point, I hardly see how your advice would improve it. It's flawless.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:000367A1] ('I've converted the classic tale of Eyldi the Bear to be performed with drums. I think you'll be impressed!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:000367A0] ('Yes, madam. I know I have a lot to work on.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:0003679F] ('Always! Perfection takes dedication, after all!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:0003679E] ('Yes, Lady Ateia. My voice is strong as a Dragonborn's!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667B])
[INFO:00036799] ('I'm sure it will be fine. Just don't be late.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667A])
[INFO:00036798] ('Patience, Illdi. We study the heroes of the past so we can have better understanding of the heroes of today... and tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667A])
[INFO:00036797] ('I'll be the judge of that. Now, back to your practice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667A])
[INFO:00036796] ('Yes, well, see that you keep at it. That is all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003667A])
[INFO:000367B6] ('How are your students coming along?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036679])
[INFO:00036786] ('Yes, headmaster.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036678])
[INFO:00036740] ('Bunch of distractions, if you ask me. They just interrupt the rest of my work.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036677])
[INFO:0003673F] ('Some of them have a long way to go, but they're mostly passable. Don't let them hear I said that, though!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036677])
[INFO:0003673E] ('Passably. Aia is my star pupil. None of the others can hold a candle to her. Especially not that wretched llldi.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036677])
[INFO:00036795] ('I'm sorry to break it to you, Giraud, but students are an unfortunate necessity of a college. Do try to persevere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036676])
[INFO:00036794] ('Of course not! Complacency is the bane of art. They're in good hands with you, Inge.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036676])
[INFO:00036793] ('Try not to play favorites, Lady Ateia. It does a disservice to the whole class.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036676])

[INFO:00036719] ('What're you going to do after you graduate? I'm thinking of joining the Legion. I hear they're looking for skalds. Just think. Me - a war bard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036675])
[INFO:00036727] ('Lady Ateia has already arranged for me to perform in the court of the Jarl of Falkreath.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036674])
[INFO:00036777] ('You'd better hope the war's over by then. The Stormcloaks would eat you alive!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036673])
[INFO:0003678A] ('Hmph. Music tames the most savage beasts. Even Nords.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036672])

[INFO:00036720] ('As you know, Solitude's coffers are much depleted by the war efforts. Thane Erikur, you have a strong head for business. What do you suggest?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036671])

[INFO:0003672E] ('This is an unfortunate but unavoidable ebb in revenue. But as long as we continue to support the Empire, our sacrifices will be well rewarded.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036670])
[INFO:0003677E] ('Listen to you, speaking of sacrifice. You've never gone hungry a day in your life, Erikur!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003666F])
[INFO:0003679C] ('And what would my impetuous Thane Bryling suggest, instead?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003666E])
[INFO:00036724] ('Simple. Let the Empire fight its own war, with its own funds, and without hijacking our supplies and soldiers. Let Haafingar rebuild.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003666D])

[INFO:00036736] ('My lady... Surely you're not that naive. Such foolishness would only leave us defenseless. The rebels would storm the palace in an afternoon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003666C])
[INFO:00036788] ('The Stormcloaks only rebel because the Empire uses Skyrim as its personal larder. The more they take, the more support the rebels gain!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003666B])
[INFO:000367AF] ('That is quite enough. Perhaps I will raise these issues when I have an audience with General Tullius.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003666A])
[INFO:0003672A] ('Thane Bryling, what do you have to report about the state of Haafingar's defenses?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036669])

[INFO:0003673C] ('The news is the same as it's been for the rest of the war, your grace. Our borders are secure, but at the cost of the guards for our towns and roads.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036668])
[INFO:00036792] ('I don't see any reason why we'd need them. As long as those dogs stay outside of our borders, we're fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036667])

[INFO:000367B9] ('The Stormcloaks are far from the only threat to the hold. The roads are beset by bandits and beasts... and now there's even talk of bloody dragons.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036666])

[INFO:000366FE] ('My dear Bryling. Barring any... fancy and folly... the good people of Haafingar are surely capable of dealing with the odd highwayman or stray dog.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036664])
[INFO:0003672B] ('Trouble on the roads and cities means less commerce. Less commerce means less money and more starving people. And that means more crime.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036663])
[INFO:0003674E] ('Humph. That's only a problem for people who can't afford to hire their own security.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036662])
[INFO:0003679A] ('That may well be our only answer. I will empower my Steward to seek out capable individuals to secure Haafingar. Thank you, my Thanes.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036661])
[INFO:00036706] ('Steward, when is my appointment to meet with General Tullius? There are some issues we must speak about.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036660])
[INFO:00036734] ('I'm afraid he's had to reschedule, my grace. By all accounts, waging war takes his every moment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003665F])
[INFO:00036760] ('Again? He can't simply cancel an appointment with the Jarl! He serves in my capital city!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003665E])
[INFO:000367AD] ('I'm afraid he can. His authority comes from the emperor. Who you also serve, technically.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003665D])
[INFO:0003670C] ('He uses all of Haafingar's resources, and doesn't answer to me in the slightest? This hardly seems fair.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003665C])
[INFO:0003673A] ('"Fair" is a word rarely applied to politics, my grace. I'm afraid you must learn to accept this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003665B])
[INFO:00036767] ('Steward, I will need the following reagents for my studies. Please see to them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003665A])
[INFO:000367B7] ('Miss Stentor, these are quite expensive. I trust you know how limited the hold's funds are at this time?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036659])

[INFO:00036712] ('Yes, and I'm also aware of how necessary my divinations and wards have been in the city's defense. My experiments are all I ask for in return.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036658])
[INFO:00036744] ('Very well. But I suspect her grace will not be pleased.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036657])
[INFO:0003676F] ('And? I've seen jarls come and go. This one only became Jarl because her husband died. She'll be replaced in a matter of months.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036656])
[INFO:000366F7] ('Miss Stentor, watch your tongue in the Jarl's court!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036655])
[INFO:00036716] ('On threat of what, exactly? This city wouldn't run without me! Now if you'll excuse me, my work awaits.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036654])
[INFO:0003664F] ('Make Laelette go away!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003664E])

[INFO:0004E84E] ([R][RE]'Now this is real guard duty. Just throw them in the mine and be done with it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0004E84D] ([R]'I catch you stealing anything, I'll break your neck.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0004E84C] ([R]'You mess with the Silver-Blood family, you end up here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362AA] ('I swear, if I ever get out of here, I'm giving up thieving. Really.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362A9] ('I got locked up one too many times. Now I'm in for life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00036A85] ('Jarl decided I was too much of a problem. Threw me in here with the Forsworn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00072E22] ('What do you want, new blood?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362A0] ('I wonder how grandma Bothela is doing. She's probably worried sick about me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00036A84] ('I'm innocent. The Nords framed me. I was nowhere near that murder weapon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0003629F] ('I was sent here because someone said I was a Forsworn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0003629E] ('Whenever I get out of here, I'm going to go kill a Nord.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00036A81] ('Other prisoners get suspicious when we talk to each other, so keep it down.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00036A80] ('What do you want? Have digging to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00036298] ('Don't reach for a shiv around me, or we'll both regret it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0003628E] ('You do something out of line, I'll put you down.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0003628D] ('No funny business. I'm watching you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:0003628C] ('I'm in charge of the prisoners here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000CD11C] ('Cidhna Mine's for prisoner scum only. Keep out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00072E1F] ('What?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00036A7F] ('Prison's not so bad. Less complaints when I kill people.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362A7] ('You serve your time by digging. So dig.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00072E1C] ('You're talking to a killer, remember that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362A5] ('You need to not bother me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00072E1B] ('I'm just another Forsworn sent to rot here in this mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362A4] ('How old is my daughter now, I wonder? In prison, you lose track of time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:000362A3] ('I left behind my daughter Uaile when I was taken.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
[INFO:00072E17] ('You're not in here for life, like I am.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003626B])
