column4: [INFO:000361E6] ([G]'When you're ready, I'll keep the rest of your gear safe until you get back.' in GRUP Topic Children of MQ201DelphineExplainsCarriageRide [DIAL:000361D1])
[INFO:000361C3] ('Give it up, Brynjolf... those days are over.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000361C0])
[INFO:000361C4] ('I'm telling you, this one is different...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000361BF])
[INFO:000361C1] ('We've all heard that one before, Bryn! Quit kidding yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000361BE])
[INFO:000361C5] ('It's time to face the truth, old friend. You, Vex, Mercer... you're all part of a dying breed. Things are changing!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000361BD])
[INFO:000361C2] ('Dying breed, eh? Well what do you call that then!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000361BC])
[INFO:000C82C4] ([R]'May I help you, Arch-Mage?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C82B1] ([R]'Greetings, Arch-Mage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ED3] ('If he could, Savos would float the the entire College above Skyrim, for all the Nords to see.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ED2] ('Savos doesn't care for politics. He likes to believe the College is removed from the rest of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ED1] ('The local Nords may not like us very much, but they don't seem to mind having access to enchanted weapons and armor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ED0] ('I think we could blow up half of Eastmarch, and people would still come to us for enchantments.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ECF] ('J'zargo can learn magic from these men and elves, but they cannot learn to be as dashing as he. J'zargo comes out on top.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ECE] ('Khajiit are not known as mages, so J'zargo has much to prove.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ECD] ('J'zargo will go wherever he can to learn more. Oblivion itself, if need be.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C82AF] ('Skyrim couldn't be more different from Elsweyr. But magic... Magic's the same no matter where you go.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C82AD] ('Are the Arch-Mage's robes as comfortable as J'zargo believes them to be?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C82AB] ('J'zargo had expected to be named Arch-Mage. But there is still time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ECC] ([SO]'J'zargo is pleased, and more than a little jealous, to greet the new Arch-Mage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ECB] ('Don't expect the local Nords to take kindly to you once they find out you're from the College.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037ECA] ('They won't say much, but most people have very strong opinions about the College and those that study here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037EC9] ('Nords don't trust magic, or those that use it. Made it difficult for me growing up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81FA] ('The College is a bit of an oddity in Skyrim. Magic isn't something that's looked upon fondly here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81F6] ('I wonder if the College's reptuation will ever recover from our adventures.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81ED] ('I've certainly learned more here than I ever expected to.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81E6] ('I never would have suspected that the Eye could be so dangerous. Tolfdir is right, isn't he? Magic really can overwhelm you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037EC8] ([SO]'Thanks to you, the people of Skyrim will continue to have a place to study magic. Even if most of them resent you for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037DCC] ('There's a lot of pressure for me to excel in my studies. I hope I can live up to expectations.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037DCB] ('I think my parents reserved a spot for me here at the College on the day I was born.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00037DCA] ('You know, this is one of a very few places where you can receive a real education in the schools of magic.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81DF] ('I still can't believe it. You, the Arch-Mage? Never would have guessed it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8D1] ('It is up to each of us to present ourselves publicly as maturely as possible, and to remain above petty local squabbles.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8D0] ('Like it or not, this College is a direct influence on the public's impressions of magic and those that use it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036625] ('Mine is not a popular position, but someone needs to keep things running smoothly around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036624] ('Day-to-day operations are my responsibility, which means if you become a problem, you get sent to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036623] ('If there are any problems, let me know. It's my job to keep things running smoothly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036622] ('Please don't bother the Arch-Mage unless it's absolutely necessary.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8CF] ('Someday the College may be fully accepted by the Nords. I hope that my work as Arch-Mage may help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036621] ('It is not the place of the College to become involved in local politics.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036620] ('Please don't do anything to anger the locals. They don't need additional reasons to hate us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003661F] ('It's no secret that the College's reputation in Skyrim is... tainted.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003661E] ('What you learn here will last you a lifetime. Several, if you're talented.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8CE] ('Another day, another opportunity to learn!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003661D] ('Have you, by chance, seen my research notes? I seem to have misplaced them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003661C] ('Education is never appreciated until after the fact. Young people never understand this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003661B] ('The College will be here for you, no matter what. We always look after our own.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81DD] ('It's always encouraging to see the younger generations embracing education.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81AF] ('After all that it's been through, the College still stands. In no small part thanks to you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81AC] ('Like it or not, you are a shining example to future generations of College Mages.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003661A] ('I am always available should you need me, Arch-Mage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036619] ('I've spent a long time building up a list of contacts for goods from all over Tamriel.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036618] ('If you ever need something, especially something hard to come by, let me know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036617] ('There are some experiments the College frowns on. If they're aware of them, of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81AB] ('Even with the College's laid-back attitude, there are still some things that are off-limits.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81AA] ('Certainly nothing illicit going on here, Arch-Mage. You can be quite sure of that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81A9] ('I'm quite pleased that we're back to business as usual.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036616] ([SO]'The Arch-Mage triumphant! The College... Skyrim... All of Tamriel owes you a great debt!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8CD] ('It's a small group of us here at the College. Favors don't go unremembered. Neither do affronts.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036615] ('I hope I can count on you if I ever need a favor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036614] ('Just like anywhere else, it's all about who you know. Lucky for you, you know me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036613] ('If you're working on any experiments, please clean up after yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036612] ('I think the College is due for a change in leadership.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C81A7] ('If there's ever any way I can assist you, please let me know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C819E] ('May I just say, it's a pleasure to have you leading the College. Really.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C819D] ('I'm sure you've made note of who's been the most helpful during your time here, Arch-Mage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C819C] ([SO]'Ancano is exactly why we're so restrictive about access to the College. We'd all have perished if it weren't for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036611] ('Just because I don't fit in here is no reason for others to ridicule me behind my back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036610] ('Once again, I have found very insulting notes left in my personal effects. Simply barbaric.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003660F] ('Why are my research materials constantly disappearing?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003660E] ('Restoration is a perfectly valid school of magic, and don't let anyone tell you otherwise!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003660C] ('Should you ever fall victim to an unfortunate accident, I promise your remains will be put to good use...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003660B] ('The people of Skyrim have no appreciation for what we do here. Not that I care.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0003660A] ('That 'incident' in Morthal was just a misunderstanding. No matter what the guards claim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036609] ('There are few places where one can pursue my type of work without fear of persecution.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C819B] ([SO]'I care little for idle conversation, but perhaps you need help with Conjuration magic?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036608] ([SO]'Nasty business with that Ancano fellow. Pity that I was unable to assist, but I was... otherwise occupied.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8CC] ('Don't you think I'd make a wonderful Master Wizard? Maybe even Arch-Mage someday?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8CB] ('I'm sure when the time for promotions comes, they'll go to the most deserving mage.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036607] ('Savos Aren is wise beyond his years. He knows real talent when he sees it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036606] ('Certainly a few of my colleagues aren't quite as talented as they'd like to believe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036605] ('I can't wait to see who succeeds Mirabelle. I've no doubt she'll be promoted to Arch-Mage at some point.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8199] ('Mirabelle does a fine job as Master Wizard, I suppose. Still, there's always room for improvement.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:0002D8CA] ([SO]'If you need any help with Destruction spells, please let me know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8198] ('And to think, Mirabelle questioned my allowing you into the College. I can just imagine the look on her face now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8197] ('Tolfdir as Master Wizard. Certainly didn't anticipate that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036604] ([SO]'We all have you to thank for saving the College. Your position is well-deserved.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036602] ('The Arcanaeum is always accepting new volumes. I'll take what I can get.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036601] ('I don't care if you wrote it yourself -- if you want a book from here, you go through me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00036600] ('You need a book, you talk to me. Otherwise you're going to find yourself in a lot of pain.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365FF] ('Hundreds of years have gone into assembling this collection. It's going to stay pristine, understand?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8196] ('I don't want to see you treating any of these books poorly. Are we clear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8195] ('All this knowledge might have been lost, were it not for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8194] ('Arch-Mage or not, my rules about books still stand.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365FE] ([SO]'I'm not one for commendations, but I might've lost everything that matters. So... thanks.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365FD] ('If only I could be free of the mundane, day-to-day activities life so often requires.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365FB] ('Illusion really is the least appreciated of the schools of magic.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C818E] ('You know, they say knowledge is its own reward.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C818D] ('Have you seen Mirabelle around? I know she's dead, but I thought... Well, I thought she might stop in and say hello anyway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C818C] ('I wonder what we could've done with the Eye, had it been put to better use?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C818B] ('The Eye of Magnus. Here, but lost. Slipped through our grasp. Oh, what we might have learned.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365FA] ([SO]'We have survived difficult times, and are better mages for it. We owe you that, Arch-Mage. Thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00087997] ('I had hoped your scholars would be on a level comparable with my own colleagues. They are not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00087996] ('I'm disappointed to say I've learned little during my time here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00087995] ('Are you quite sure we need to be speaking?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00087994] ('I have many important things on my mind. Your concerns are not among them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365F9] ('When I've finished what I'm working on, everyone will understand its significance.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365F8] ('I don't think anyone here truly understands how useful my work will be.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365F7] ('The exact nature of my research is a secret, I'm afraid, but it really is quite valuable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C818A] ('I'm working on some very important research, I assure you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C8189] ('Perhaps we can go another few decades without a disaster. That would be nice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000365F6] ('Perhaps we can go another few decades without a disaster. That would be nice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:000C7FED] ('Enchanting services are one of the few things that keep us in touch with the rest of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00036190])
[INFO:00035ED6] ('What was that you said, venomous wife of mine?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035ED4])
[INFO:00035ED5] ('Nothing, you pig-headed oaf!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035ED3])
[INFO:00035E12] ('So, you made it out of there alive. Ancano was right... you are dangerous.' in GRUP Topic Children of MG07EstormoAmbushBranchTopic [DIAL:00035E11])
[INFO:000C2778] ('What are we waiting for?' in GRUP Topic Children of MG07TolfdirForcegreetBranchTopic [DIAL:00035E10])
[INFO:000130DA] ([SO]'You survived! You have it, then?' in GRUP Topic Children of MG07TolfdirForcegreetBranchTopic [DIAL:00035E10])
[INFO:00035E0D] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035E07])
[INFO:00035E0C] ('We need to find that burial mound before its dragon comes back to life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035E07])
[INFO:00035E0B] ('If my analysis is correct, the dragon buried near Kynesgrove will be the next to come back to life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035E07])
[INFO:00035E0A] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035E07])
[INFO:0005F5B1] ('Look around, see if you see anything unusual. Any signs of the mound being disturbed. Anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035E07])
[INFO:00035E08] ('This is worse than I thought...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035E06])
[INFO:00035D4F] ('I'll be damned, you did it!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035D4D])
[INFO:00035D4E] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035D4C])
[INFO:00035D50] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00035D4B])

[INFO:000DA666] ([R]'The Dunmer get their drinks at the New Gnisis Cornerclub. Why they can't just call it a tavern is beyond me...' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DA665] ([R]'By the gods, you're diseased. Get yourself to the White Phial and purchase a remedy, before you infect us all.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DA664] ([R]'If you need an apothecary, the White Phial has respectable stock.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DA662] ([R]'You should unload some of that unwanted gear. Head over to Sadri's Used Wares, talk to the Elf.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DA663] ([R]'Stay away from the Aretino Residence. The place is cursed.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003ED8D] ([R]'If you're an Imperial spy, better turn around right now.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003ED52] ([R]'Loyal Nords are always welcome here. Anyone else better watch their step.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003ED51] ([R]'If you're here to join the Stormcloaks, the palace is inside.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003ED50] ([R]'This is Stormcloak territory. If you're one of those craven Imperials, don't expect a warm welcome.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34BA] ('I understand what potions do, but I don't always understand how they do it.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD69F] ('If I make enough money from the farm, I'll buy myself a longship to sail the rivers of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD69E] ('The Cruel-Seas have been sailors for generations. In truth, I regret not following in the footsteps of my ancestors.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD69D] ('I own Hollyfrost Farm outside the city. It's honest work, if a bit dull.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD69C] ('I'm proud of my farm. It takes no small effort to grow crops in this part of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD69B] ('Too many dark elves in Windhelm complain about the way we're treated. What good does complaining do?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD69A] ('The best way for us to win the Nords' respect is through hard work.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34B9] ('While you're on my boat, you follow my rules. First rule is, don't touch anything that doesn't belong to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34B8] ('Been on the river since I could walk. Wouldn't trade it for the world.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34B7] ('You don't know what freedom really means until you've lived on the river.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34B6] ('Sorry, but I'm not looking to hire any more crew right now.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34B5] ('Can't wait until we raise anchor. Anytime the boat's not moving, I start to get impatient.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A34B4] ('I heard those Forsworn out west live in caves. Can't be any worse than trying to live in Windhelm.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A345F] ('I'm a lot happier out here on the deck than I am wandering around in that ruin of a city.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A3450] ('Never much cared for Windhelm. The place is depressing.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A344F] ('Captain Kjar expects the best, but he's a fair man. He never fails to reward hard work and loyalty.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A344E] ('A life on the river makes for weak legs, so I do a lot of walking when we dock.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035040] ('It's good to spend some time on solid land.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000A344D] ('I'm a sailor on the Northwind. We're laying over in Windhelm for awhile.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003503F] ('I have a decent mind for potions, but I've also learned how to craft magical items.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0CB] ('I'll never have Master Nurelion's skill with potions.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003503E] ('My master can be a bit short-tempered, but I've learned so much from him.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003503C] ('Must you bother me now? I've almost figured out where it is.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003503D] ('Alchemy is simple. Unless, of course, you are simple. Then I can't help you.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003503B] ('I don't see why we should live as an underclass to the Nords. If anything, they owe us.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003503A] ('Not a day passes that I don't wonder if life would be better in Morrowind.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035039] ('We might be poor, but is it really any better out there?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00039CD9] ('The cornerclub's been filling up at night lately. I'll bet Elda up at Candlehearth is jealous.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035038] ('The Gray Quarter's not much to look at now, but it wasn't always so bad.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094199] ('I thought the the Gray Quarter would be a haven for my kind. I was wrong.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035037] ('When Ulfric was killed, justice was done. That might sound harsh, but it's how I feel.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035036] ('Prove your valor in the Pit! If you haven't got any valor, prove your pocketbook!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035035] ('It's very important to Huki that all the battles are fair. What's more important to me is that my pay is fair.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])

[INFO:00035034] ('Hello, hello, hello. Interested in fighting in the Pit? The rules are strict, but if I don't see it, it didn't happen, know what I mean?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035033] ('When I'm cutting wood, I pretend there's an Imperial soldier's head on the stump.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035032] ('Can't just throw the big logs on the fire. Got to have the little bits, too.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035031] ('Name's Nils. I'm the cook up at Candlehearth Hall.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0CA] ('It bothers me that fewer people come to Windhelm these days.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003502D] ('I don't care much for the war one way or the other.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003502C] ('My sister and I once traveled the world to assemble our collection. Such adventures we had!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003502B] ('Welcome, friend, to Calixto's House of Curiosities!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000E14DE] ('If you've got some time, stop by my House of Curiosities. I promise you'll see wonders!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003502A] ('Welcome to the House of Curiosities! I offer a brief tour for a few coins, or you can simply browse at your leisure.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035029] ('The sooner this war ends, the sooner we can all get on with our lives.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035028] ('If Ulfric had his way, anyone who wasn't a Nord would be shipped right out of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035027] ('They call me a war hero. I'm no hero, I'm just a soldier who didn't want to die.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0C9] ('There's no glory in war. It's just something they tell soldiers so they'll risk their lives.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0C8] ('I told you, I've got no patience for fools. Keep walking.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094198] ('Got no time for a Nord who thinks he's better than everyone else. Keep walking.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094197] ('Being a Jarl isn't something I ever wanted, but if I can help these people, then I will.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094196] ('The dark elves and Argonians won't soon forget Ulfric's prejudice, but I'm doing what I can to repair that rift.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0009418E] ('It'll take time to rebuild, but the Nords are no strangers to hard work.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035026] ('My time is limited, so speak quickly.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035025] ('Don't get too many folks up here these days. Sometimes I think they've forgotten about me.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])

[INFO:00035024] ('Watching the wheel isn't as simple as you might think. Have to inspect all the way around the ice, make sure it's not melting.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035023] ('My job? Well, I'm the Watcher of the Wheel! Which is... exactly what it sounds like. I watch the Wheel.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035022] ('Yes, I'm a powerful wizard. No, I won't put on a magic show for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035021] ('I'd explain my research, but you'd just be confused.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035020] ('If Ulfric needs a favor, he has it. Anyone else better pay well for the service.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003501F] ('Whatever you've heard I can do is probably true.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003501E] ('Someday all of Skyrim will worship Talos openly, as we do here.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003501D] ('The way I see it, Ulfric's fighting a holy war.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003501C] ('Talos created the Empire. You'd think they'd show him more respect.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0009418C] ('I've spent my life serving Talos. I don't plan to stop now, no matter what the Empire says.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003501B] ('With Ulfric dead and the Stormcloaks gone, who will have the courage to champion the cause of Talos?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003501A] ('Steel. Barehanded. Armor. Naked. It's all fighting. I can kill you with a weapon or by myself. No difference.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035019] ('Ulfric once tried to get me to fight for him, but marching bores me.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0C7] ('There's two kinds of Pit fighters -- good ones and dead ones.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035018] ('I've been fighting in the Pit for years. That should tell you something.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035017] ('We should get a dragon for the Pit. I'd love to fight one.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035016] ('I've been a lot of things in my life. Pit fighter's the one I'm best at.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035015] ('My father says we need to just get on with our lives. Like it's that easy.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035013] ('I lost my twin sister a while back. Have you ever lost anyone close?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035012] ('With my swords in their hands, Ulfric's men will send those legion dogs running.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035011] ('Hermir's become a decent smith. Like to think I had a hand in that.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035010] ('Need some metal hammered?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0009418B] ('Everyone says Eorlund Gray-Mane is the best smith in Skyrim. I plan to change a few minds about that.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003500F] ('Can't believe Ulfric's gone. If not for Hermir, I'd have left the city by now.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003500E] ('You seem like such a nice person. I'd love to hear more about you.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003500D] ('I see why the Nords like Skyrim. This crisp air is wonderful for the lungs!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003500C] ('I hope someday we'll get to know each other better.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003500B] ([SO]'Oh, pardon me. Was I in your way?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0003500A] ('You look like someone who appreciates nice things.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035009] ('I have a lot of respect for Ambarys Rendar, but his views are a little extreme.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035008] ('You need anything, come see me. I'm as resourceful as I am discreet.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035006] ('What I lack in strength, I make up for with tenacity.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035004] ('Brond's one of the most savage fighters I've ever seen...' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035003] ('Seeing a good tavern brawl might be just the thing to lift my spirits.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035002] ('Poor Nilsine has been wrecked since her sister was killed.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035001] ('Both my daughters. Now my wife? How much is one man supposed to take?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035000] ('When I've made enough money, I'm going to return to Morrowind in high style.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FFF] ('It's not the cold of Skyrim that gets to me. It's the stink from the people.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0009418A] ('Things have been a lot worse around here since Ulfric took over.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FFE] ('At long last, Windhelm is free. No longer must we suffer persecution at the hands of Ulfric Stormcloak.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FFD] ('Apparently some Nord women were murdered. Not sure why I should care.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FFC] ('Welcome, sister. Please, enjoy yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FFB] ('Welcome, brother. Please, enjoy yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0C4] ('Come slumming to the Gray Quarter, have you?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FFA] ('Oh splendid, another Nord.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF9] ('Know any tales of nobility and courage? I'm keen to record them.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0C3] ('I'll find some way to finish my book.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF8] ('Now more than ever, the world needs tales of heroism.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF7] ('I still can't believe Isabella's gone. She was such a helpful young lass.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF6] ('I really can't thank you enough for your help.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF5] ('The conquering hero returns!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF4] ('Can you believe the company won't even dock ships here anymore?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF3] ('"Windhelm's an easy posting!" they said. Guess they didn't count on Ulfric's little uprising.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF2] ('Pardon the mess. We're really trying to do better around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF1] ('Trader dropped by recently with some lovely pieces, if you'd like to have a look.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FF0] ('I like to share my good fortune with those who deserve it.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094189] ('All my goods are legitimate, which is more than I can say for some.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FEF] ('Can't say I mind the sight of all the Imperial guards. It's a change for the better.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FEE] ('I'm not too proud to admit that I need a bit of help from time to time.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FEB] ('I once killed six men, single-handed, while rescuing my brothers-in-arms from ambush by an Imperial patrol.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002DDE6] ('Rumor holds that the Aretino boy brought an assassin here. Sounds like nonsense to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002DDE5] ('The milk drinkers in this town wouldn't last five minutes in a real battle.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])

[INFO:0002DDE4] ('What? Were you hoping to claim this house for yourself? Well, the Aretinos always liked me, so I think I'm family enough to take up here.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])

[INFO:000CD8F1] ([SO]'Ever since that Imperial craven ran me through from behind, I've had trouble breathing. Don't have any trouble drinking though.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:0002C0C2] ([SO]'I'd be out there fighting the Imperials right now if it wasn't for my war-wound.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FEA] ([SO]'I was one of the best soldiers in the Stormcloak army, until I took a sword through the chest.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE9] ('Terrible shame, what happened to those women.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE8] ('If you have any news of the western holds, take it to Ulfric immediately.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE7] ('I'm not much of a strategist, but Lord Ulfric listens to my counsel all the same.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE6] ('The Stormcloaks are finding victory across the land.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094187] ('I don't care that we lost, I'm just glad the war is over.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE5] ('Serving as Steward to Ulfric Stormcloak was a great honor, but I don't miss his temper.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE4] ('Did Viola send you to bother me?' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE3] ('I lost my family years ago. Truth is, I don't really know what keeps me going.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE2] ('The townsfolk call me "captain" because I used to be a sailor.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE1] ('I made my fortune as a sea captain, but now I'm retired.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FE0] ('They say dragons are coming back. I want to kill one!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FDF] ('All the Argonians at the docks are nice to me. Good thing, too, or father would run them off!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD699] ('Did you know my father? He was really important. He even talked to the Jarl sometimes.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FDD] ('Do you know my father? He's really important. He even talks to the Jarl sometimes.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FDC] ('The young folks are too happy to break their backs for the Nords. They forget what it was like to swim free.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FDA] ('Another day, another septim.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD9] ('Huh? What's that now? Leave me alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD8] ('The docks can be a dangerous place. Don't expect me to save you if you fall in.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00035F43] ('Haven't seen you here before, egg sister. Welcome!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD7] ('Haven't seen you here before, egg brother. Welcome!' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD6] ('Look, we don't have much love for your kind down here. Probably best if you just left.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD5] ('The Nords don't appreciate us, but so what? I don't appreciate them right back.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD4] ('Shatter-Shield, East Empire Company... we'll work for any ship that pulls in, as long as they can pay.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD3] ('The water is cold, but it's a lot better than having to work up in the dry air.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD2] ('We Argonians do the work the Nords don't want to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00094186] ('I wish the Nords, Argonians and dark elves in Windhelm got along better.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD1] ('It's a new day in Windhelm. The Stormcloaks are gone, and so is their prejudice.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FCF] ('I couldn't ask for a better teacher than Oengul.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD698] ('I just can't believe that Ulfric is gone. Skyrim will never be free now.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:000DD697] ('Ulfric was a true hero of Skyrim. He will be missed.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FD0] ('I never expected Ulfric to live up to his legend, but he does.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])
[INFO:00034FCE] ('Working in Windhelm is great. I get to see Ulfric up close.' in GRUP Topic Children of WindhelmHellos [DIAL:00034F93])

[INFO:00034CFE] ([R]'I am the perfect weapon. My innocent, childish form grants me nearly unrestricted access. Poison or a good bite usually takes care of the rest.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])

[INFO:00034CFD] ([R]'You give me too much credit. For how could I fail? I am, after all, just a little girl. What threat could I possibly pose? He he he he he.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:00034CFC] ([R]'In truth? It was so easy, I feel a bit guilty. Once again, the sweet, innocent child earned more trust than was wise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])

[INFO:00034CFB] ([R]'My greatest challenge was deciding which weapon to use, for I am prone to indecision. Bow, dagger... axe? In the end, I opted for my claws.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:00034CFA] ([R]'It was a simple matter, really, when one has mastered the art of camouflage. Scale becomes stone, becomes shadow. Then... death.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:00034CF9] ([R]'He he. Don't forget that I am Shadowscale. I was, quite literally, born to kill.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])

[INFO:00034CF8] ([R]'When I first received the blessing of the wolf, my creator gave me a valuable piece of advice. "Arnbjorn," he said. "Never lose!" And I never do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:00034CF7] ([R]'When I am become wolf, I am treachery incarnate. And then, then... there is no one who can stand between the hunter and his prey.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:0001681E] ([R]'Romantic, isn't? Like that time we first met. Remember that? Never seen so much blood. Ah, to be young again...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:00034CF6] ([R]'Once again, you have underestimated me. You see the man, brutish and hulking. But I am wolf as well. Deliberate. Cunning.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])

[INFO:00034CF5] ([R]'What? You think me too old, too feeble? There is more knowledge in me than in two of you pups put together. And knowledge... knowledge is my weapon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:00034CF4] ([R]'Bah! A child could have accomplished it. Such is the power of the arcane. If you only knew of the spells I didn't use. He he he he he.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:0006D26D] ([R]'Let that be a lesson to you young pups. There is no challenge that magic cannot overcome.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:0006D26C] ([R]'Hmph. Been awhile since I've actually cleaved someone in two. Forgot how hard it was to get the scimitar back out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:0006D26B] ([R]'Yeah, well, don't expect many more stories like that in my future. I'm getting old. Being that amazing takes too much damn effort.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])

[INFO:0001681D] ([R]'It's all thanks to a special technique I developed. I call it the "Razor-Winged Butterfly." I'd teach it to you... but then I'd have to kill you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034C12])
[INFO:0002E149] ('It's good to see a fresh face. You wouldn't have happen to come from Whiterun would you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034B31])

[INFO:000167E0] ([R]'So, is it true?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034944])
[INFO:000167DF] ('Tell me, husband. Is it true what I've heard?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034944])
[INFO:00034945] ('Astrid, I've been hearing some, er... interesting things, from the others... about what you did when you left the Sanctuary last week...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034944])
[INFO:00016813] ([R]'Oh, you mean in that manor house? During the thunderstorm? Heh. What can I say? It happened, just like you heard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:00016811] ([R]'Ah, you must mean my little adventure on the ship...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:00034951] ([R]'The Redoran contract? Yes, you heard correctly. In and out of Vvardenfell in less than forty eight hours.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:00034950] ([R]'The temple contract? Well, I certainly won't deny my involvement. He he he he he.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:0003494F] ([R]'Word certainly travels fast, doesn't it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:0003494E] ([R]'You must be talking about the caravan job...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:0003494D] ([R]'You're referring to that blacksmith contract?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034943])
[INFO:00016810] ([R]'I'm just trying to imagine you hiding inside the body of a mammoth. Bloody brilliant idea.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034942])
[INFO:000167E3] ([R]'It's the part with the severed head I find most impressive. My compliments.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034942])
[INFO:000167E2] ([R]'But really. A horker, some twine, three wood elves, and a hatchet? Points for creativity, if nothing else.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034942])

[INFO:00034CF3] ([R]'By Sithis, you slew everyone! Well, except for that one you kept alive, to serve as witness. Does your wickedness, or your skill, know no bounds?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034942])
[INFO:00034C14] ([R]'It was a suicide mission! Astrid said as much. Yet here you stand, hale and hearty.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034942])
[INFO:0003494C] ([R]'To kill triplets, secretly, and then have the whole thing blamed on the mother. Remarkable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00034942])

column4: [INFO:0006F807] ('I am an Orc and a warrior, but I have no desire to become chief.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033643] ('We honor the bravest fighters, but I have seen many types of bravery in my travels.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033642] ('I used to wander the corners of Skyrim like you. I miss those days.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003363F] ('I don't know how Ghorbash has so much spirit. He should act his age.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003363E] ('Sorry, outlander, but this old Orc cannot help you. Burguk is the chief here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033640] ('I serve my chief and my brothers by working in the mines. It's the only place fit for an aging Orc.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003363C] ('One day, I intend to be chief. I will fight my father and my brother for it, as is tradition.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003363B] ('Brother Umurn is a strong warrior. I look forward to fighting him for chiefdom one day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003363A] ('I help my mother Arob with the hunt. We bring much meat and skins to the stronghold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:000C78B6] ('One day, I must fight my brother Nagrub for chiefdom. It will not be easy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033638] ('I help in the mines as well as the forge.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033637] ('One day I will shape a weapon fit for a chief. Maybe that chief will be me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033636] ('I work the forge, with my mother Gharol. We mine our own ore and shape our own metal.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033634] ('Umurn and Nagrub will be held up as weak next to the son I will one day bear for my chief.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033633] ('Arob and Gharol eye me with envy. They don't know how to please their chief.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033632] ('I am Burguk's favored wife. He knows my beauty should be praised.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003362F] ('As forge-wife, I'm also in charge of our mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:000C5046] ('I'm Burguk's forge-wife. I shape all the steel for the stronghold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C821] ('We can trade when there's light outside.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C820] ('Blades to kill your prey and your rivals.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C81F] ('Strong gauntlets for strong hands.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003362E] ('You wish to trade in Orc steel?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:000606F1] ('Burguk is a fine chief. He brings strength and wealth to the stronghold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C81E] ('I am the hunts-wife of this stronghold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C81D] ('You should see Gharol if you're looking for a blade or armor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0003362A] ('Murbul knows many poisons and cures if you need them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033627] ('Malacath rewards the strong and punishes the weak.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:000C503C] ('I am Burguk's mother and wise woman to our tribe, outlander.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C81C] ('If you wish to trade, wait for the sun to rise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C81B] ('I have an old cure for Rockjoint. Common in little Orc children.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:000931BC] ('Orc poisons are to be feared, if you wish to trade.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C81A] ('This stronghold respects strength, and strength alone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C819] ('Need a poison for your hunting? My mother, Murbul, knows several.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006C818] ('You need steel? Speak to my forge-wife, Gharol.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:0006A8DA] ('You speak to Burguk, chief of Dushnikh Yal.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360F])
[INFO:00033612] ('Tell me, mother, does Malacath favor our stronghold?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360E])
[INFO:00033611] ('He is pleased. Ours is the strongest tribe in all the Reach.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360D])
[INFO:00033619] ('I saw you working the forge today, wife. Your muscles have grown strong from the metal shaping!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360B])
[INFO:00033613] ('Do they, my chief? Am I now favored enough to replace Shel by your side at the feast? Back your words with action!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003360A])
[INFO:0003361C] ('No more talk of Shel. As chief, I will do what I please, so point your fiery gaze to our enemies.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033609])
[INFO:00033615] ('My chief, Gharol threatens to have me work in the mines. You won't allow my pretty hands to dirty, will you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033608])
[INFO:0003361E] ('No, my wife. You have been given other gifts to please your chief than mine work. I will talk to Gharol and all will be well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033607])
[INFO:00033617] ('Oh, thank you my chief!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033606])
[INFO:00033645] ('It is a fine day to work the mines.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033605])
[INFO:0003361A] ('This metal will serve the forge well, my brother.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033604])
[INFO:00033614] ('You could challenge Burguk, my brother. Yours is the stronger swordarm.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033603])
[INFO:0003361D] ('Serving in the Legion taught me to respect leadership. The stronghold needs Burguk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033602])
[INFO:00033616] ('The air has the smell of beasts. The hunt is good today.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033601])
[INFO:0003361F] ('Yes, mother. I'm eager to prove my skills today.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00033600])
[INFO:00033618] ('Ah, the air is good today. I welcome the smell of blood from all the kills I will make.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000335FF])
[INFO:00033610] ('Patience, my son. The hunter days not welcome the blood of his prey, he waits for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000335FE])
[INFO:000606F5] ('Mother tells me to shape metal with focus and strength.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000330D9])
[INFO:00033111] ('Even good hammers warp metal if struck without care.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000330D9])
[INFO:00033110] ('I work in the forge and the mines. Mother says it pleases her and our people.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000330D9])

column4: [INFO:000316F8] ('Divines sake, Skald. Who do think we're threatening with our old war wounds? We're not soldiers, anymore.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000316F6])

[INFO:00031296] ([G]'Stop. Turn around. And go back the way you came. Astrid is waiting for you. She's down near the entrance. You must have passed right by her.' in GRUP Topic Children of DBNazirFirstGreetBranchTopic [DIAL:000311FA])
[INFO:00031277] ('So you're the newest member of our dwindling, dysfunctional little Family. I've heard quite a bit about you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DBNazirFirstGreetBranchTopic [DIAL:000311FA])
[INFO:0003056F] ('You work hard, Daighre. Glad you have stayed with us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030557])
[INFO:00030560] ('I'm grateful, Skaggi. I'm sorry my daughter gives you so much trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030556])
[INFO:0003056E] ('Skaggi tells me that you were bothering him today. Can't you and Torom just play by yourselves?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054F])
[INFO:00030563] ('But mom, it's so boring with just me and Torom. I was just asking Skaggi some questions.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054E])
[INFO:00030572] ('You leave him alone. I don't want to hear Skaggi telling me you've been bothering him again!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054D])
[INFO:00030564] ('Yes, ma'am.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054C])
[INFO:000614F3] ([SO]'Mine's closed. Move along.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:00061352] ('There's still plenty of ore left in that mine. What a waste.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:00061351] ('I hear talk about a regiment coming to clear the crypt out. We'll see if that happens.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:00061350] ('We're keeping the mine closed until that crypt is clear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0006134F] ('Guards are useless. They just stand around waiting for a full regiment to come and help.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0006134E] ('I'm not going into the mine with draugr lurking down there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0006134D] ('We tunneled into an old crypt. We're warning strangers to keep out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0005E9B0] ('Any day now more draugr are going to come out of that crypt.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0003058F] ('This mine will be our grave yet. I just know it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0003058E] ('It's crazy to still be working here. What if there's more draugr down there?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:0005E9AE] ('We're getting back to work as best we can.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:00030589] ('Hard to believe there'd be an old crypt underneath the mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:00030588] ('Mining out this old rock is a lot quieter, now. Thank the Divines.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003054B])
[INFO:000304ED] ('This is the last hagraven between us and my mother!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304E4])
[INFO:000304E6] ('Greetings, mother.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304E2])
[INFO:000304E9] ('Daughter. Who is this you have brought me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304E0])
[INFO:000304EB] ('I found a willing subject for you. Payment has already been discussed, of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304DF])
[INFO:000304EC] ('Splendid! Please take a seat on the chair behind me, would you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304DE])
[INFO:000304E5] ([G]'I'll just prepare the subject now...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304DD])
[INFO:000304E8] ([G]'I can't let you do this, mother. You have to die now!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000304DC])
[INFO:000303DD] ('My sister keeps telling me that the farm keeps us alive, but I don't really call this living.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303DC] ('Can you imagine how wonderful it would be to set what you see on a canvas so you'd have that memory forever?' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303DB] ('One day I hope to become a painter, but at this rate it looks like it's never going to happen.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303DA] ('I wish I could head to one of the capital cities... maybe even back to Mournhold. Anywhere but here.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303D9] ('This place is boring. Nothing but the same thing every day. Sigh.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303D6] ('I don't suppose you could come back another time? I'm very busy.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303D8] ('I have a lot to do around the farm, so make it quick please. What is it you wanted?' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000E3302] ('I'm a bit busy at the moment, what did you want?' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000E3E87] ('I hope this is important... I get little sleep as it is.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:0006BBA7] ('Ah, you're back.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000E3E86] ('Any luck locating those jazbay grapes?' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000E3E85] ('Always a pleasure. What brings you back?' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000E3E84] ('I'm still busy, but I can always make time to speak with you.' in GRUP Topic Children of SarethiFarmHellos [DIAL:000303CE])
[INFO:000303DF] ('Aduri, how come the fields haven't been tilled like I asked?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303CD])
[INFO:000303E0] ('Because it's boring. The fields are going to do fine... you don't have to dote over them so much.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303CC])
[INFO:000303CF] ('Boring? That food is paying for everything. If we lose even a single crop, we could starve or be forced to beg. I won't have it!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303CB])
[INFO:000303D0] ('All right, I understand. I'll do it tomorrow, okay? Just get off my back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303CA])
[INFO:000303DE] ('Have you decided if I can head up to Solitude yet? I hear it's the best place to meet someone who may be willing to teach me to paint.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303C9])
[INFO:000303D2] ('I'm sorry, Aduri, not this year. Perhaps next year after the harvest, I don't know. There's so much to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303C8])
[INFO:000303D3] ('It's not going to be next year, nor the year after that! You just care about this farm more than you care about me!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303C7])
[INFO:000303D1] ('Painting won't put food on the table, but our crops will. Be patient Aduri... it will happen someday, I promise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000303C6])

column4: [INFO:000302AC] ('Millwork sure is boring, but at least I don't have to work in a nasty mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302AB] ('I'm not afraid of anyone. Put a sword in my hand and I could defend this place if I had to!' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000E3E8F] ('Someday I'll take over the mill... when I'm old enough.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302AA] ('My mother taught me the millwork trade... you know, which trees to cut and which ones to pass up.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302A8] ('I hope you're not here to start some trouble. I'll fight you if I have to.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302A9] ('It's just me and my mother at the mill here. My father is gone. We don't know what happened to him.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000E3E8E] ('I knew it! I knew my father was a hero and he didn't just run away.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:0006BBA6] ('I can't believe my mother's gone. Now what'll I do?' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302A5] ('If I ever catch my husband in bed with another woman, he's going to find himself homeless.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000E3E8D] ('Men are complete pigs, am I right? All they care about is one thing... and you know exactly what I mean.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000E3E8C] ('You men are utter pigs... you only care about one thing.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302A4] ('Men are utter pigs... they only care about one thing.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000E3E8B] ('Hmph. If you see my good-for-nothing husband Leifnarr on your journeys tell him he's no longer welcome here.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:0006BBA5] ('So, any luck finding my louse of a husband?' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302A3] ('Despite what you discovered it's still comforting to know my husband is at peace.' in GRUP Topic Children of HeartwoodMillHellos [DIAL:0003029D])
[INFO:000302AE] ('Gralnach! I told you not to go through your father's things!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003029C])
[INFO:000302AF] ('I'm sorry mother, I just want to know more about him. You never tell me anything!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003029B])
[INFO:000E3E7B] ('I'm sorry mother, now that he's dead, I just want to know everything I can about him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003029B])
[INFO:000302A1] ('That's because there's nothing to tell. He left us to fend for ourselves and that's all you need to know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003029A])
[INFO:000E3E6D] ('He was a wonderful man, and he loved us very much. I'm sorry I yelled at you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003029A])
[INFO:0003029E] ('I wish you didn't hate him so much... I wish the whole family could be together again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030299])
[INFO:000E3E71] ('It's okay, mother. I understand.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030299])
[INFO:000302A2] ('Mother, I finished cutting at the northern stand. Where do I move on to now?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030298])
[INFO:0003029F] ('There is a copse of elms to the east. We could really use that wood.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030297])
[INFO:000302AD] ('I was hoping to head into Riften for supplies, but I can do that after I'm done with the elms.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030296])
[INFO:000302A0] ('Just be careful, Gralnach. That copse doesn't look safe. If you see any trouble, you run right home.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030295])
[INFO:000E3E82] ('I'm afraid we have little to offer you in the way of hospitality.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:00030266] ('Someday, I hope we can get away from here... perhaps move back to Morrowind. This isn't at all what we expected.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:00030265] ('The war's been hard on the farm and hard on Dravin. We don't know what to expect from one day to the next.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:00030264] ('You'll have to forgive my husband's manners. He's not used to pleasantries.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:0006B99A] ('After we were robbed, Dravin's become more bitter than ever. He hates this place.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])

[INFO:00030262] ('Now that you've brought Dravin's bow back, he's back to his crabby old self. For better or for worse, I still thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:000E3E81] ('You even think of taking something from my house... and I'll kill you.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:000E3E80] ('It's not safe around here. There's thieves out there looking to steal everything you own.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:000E3E7F] ('You look suspicious. You better not be one of those damn thieves.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:000E3E7E] ('Who in the name of Azura are you?' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:000E3E7D] ('So, has my bow turned up yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:0006B999] ('Thanks again for getting my bow back from those thieves. Next time they come knocking I'll be ready.' in GRUP Topic Children of MerryfairFarmHellos [DIAL:00030257])
[INFO:00030268] ('Synda... you left your dagger behind again yesterday. I told you, the road isn't safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030256])
[INFO:00030267] ('Husband, you worry far too much. We are within an hour's walk of Riften.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030255])

[INFO:00030259] ('That doesn't matter. All it would take is a stray wolf or a bandit crossing your path... I can't bare to lose you after everything we've done.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030254])
[INFO:0003025D] ('If it puts your mind at ease, I'll take it with me. I'm sorry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030253])
[INFO:00030258] ('Dravin! One of the soldiers I spoke to on the way home said you threatened them. What's come over you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030252])
[INFO:0003025C] ('I can't stand them, they represent everything I hate about Skyrim. They're tearing the place apart!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030251])
[INFO:0003025A] ('All you'll accomplish by threatening them is ending up in the Riften dungeon. You're lucky they didn't take you seriously.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030250])
[INFO:00030269] ('Sorry, Marise. I just can't sit back and watch them treat us like a resource. This is our home!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003024F])
[INFO:0003025B] ('I don't care! Just stay away from the soldiers and keep to your business. It's the only way we'll make it through this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003024E])
[INFO:0003014E] ('Maybe we could invite some of those nice guards over. You know, for some supper?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030142])
[INFO:00030148] ('No. I have enough trouble without more mouths to feed! They're the Jarl's men, they can eat supper at the keep.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030141])
[INFO:00030144] ('Terrible. Only a matter of time before soldiers come and burn all my hard work into dust!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00030140])
[INFO:00030143] ('How do you think the crops are coming, dear?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003013F])
[INFO:00030145] ('Look at the sky. Be a terrible day tomorrow. I know it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003013E])
[INFO:0003014F] ('Oh, Rogatus! Maybe tomorrow will be pleasant for once, hmm? It can't be terrible every day!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003013D])
[INFO:0003014A] ('Yes it can. I haven't been wrong in 50 years, and I won't be wrong tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003013C])
[INFO:00030147] ('Are you all right, Gat?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003013B])
[INFO:00030149] ('Still shaken from all the fighting, my friend. It's been too long since I had to kill someone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0003013A])
[INFO:00030108] ('Sometimes I feel like Annekke cares more about finding new rocks than being with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030107] ('If you want some information about the area, Annekke knows it better than anyone.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030106] ('I do love my wife. Just wish she'd get her head out of the clouds.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030105] ('Annekke used to help more with the mining, but nowadays she's a bit of a bounder.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030104] ([SO]'You looking for work? We could use an extra hand in the mine. Just bring me any Corundum you dig up.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])

[INFO:00030103] ('If you head straight west from where the White River splits towards Whiterun, you can get a look at the Cradlecrush giants.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030102] ('Verner used to love exploring before we got married. Now he's become a bit of a milk drinker. Likes to stay home.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030101] ('If you're heading to Kynesgrove, stick to the road. Some pretty dangerous caves between here and there.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00030100] ('There's a gorgeous tree that grows right up through a cave to the northeast of here.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300FF] ([SO]'A traveler? I'll be you've seen some sights. We should swap tales sometime.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F9] ('The Stormcloaks are named after Ulfric. He's a bad man, but don't tell the soldiers that.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F8] ('Mom says the Empire is mean, but I don't think they're that bad.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00035042] ('Derkeethus used to take me diving way down deep in the river. I miss him.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F6] ('Sondas takes care of me when mom's not around.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F5] ([SO]'Hi! I've never seen you around here before. Are you a miner too?' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:00035041] ('I'm not proud of Hrefna's father. If she knew him, she wouldn't be either.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F3] ('It's tough to keep track of Hrefna. If her father wasn't such a snowback, he'd be around to help out.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F2] ('We keep hearing that the war could come through here. I try not to worry about it.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F1] ('What's your trouble? Dasturn telling tales again?' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300F0] ([SO]'Is there something I can help you with?' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300EA] ('I hear there's baked slaughterfish tonight.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300E9] ('I keep hearing stories about Morrowind. Sounds like a wretched place.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
[INFO:000300E8] ('I try to think of it as coaxing the ore from the rock.' in GRUP Topic Children of DarkwaterCrossingHellos [DIAL:000300E6])
