[INFO:0002EA5B] ([SO]'Don't let my appearance throw you off. I'm older than you. A lot older. Getting bitten by a vampire when you're ten will do that to a girl.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:000749BA] ('I believed in Cicero. But he's betrayed us all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:0002EA59] ([R]'Yes, yes. I'm your brother and I'm supposed to greet you respectfully. So "hello." There, satisfied?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:0002EA58] ([R]'Talk to Babette about potions. She's the creepy little girl - can't miss her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:000E0D63] ([R]'Nobody ever expects a fireball from the darkened corner.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:0002EA57] ([R]'You like creepin' around in the shadows? Magic'll work just as good there as anywhere else.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:000749B9] ([SO]'There's too much of an obsession these days with knives and arrows. You can kill someone just as easily with a well-placed spell.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:000749B8] ('Boy, did you miss all the excitement.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E7AD])
[INFO:0002E6F9] ('Why are you still here?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F8] ('You don't look so tough. I'll bet I could take you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F6] ('My pa runs this town, and you're going to be in big trouble if you mess with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F5] ([SO]'I've never seen you before. Leave me alone!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F4] ('Got some nice comfy beds at the Braidwood Inn, if you're looking to flop down somewhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F2] ('This is really quite a nice town when you get down to it. Just look at the view!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F1] ('I hope you'll stay for a bit. We could certainly use the business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6F0] ([SO]'Did you see my husband already? I'm sorry... he can come off a bit rough at times.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6EF] ('If these Nords don't let up soon, I might just make a break for it. At least Cyrodiil is warmer than this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6EE] ('I can't believe she dragged me all the way to this snowball. I'd rather be broke in Cyrodiil than broke here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6EC] ('Wouldn't even be here if it weren't for my idiot sister.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6EB] ([SO]'Oh, great, another wanderer. Slumming it on your way to Windhelm?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E8] ('But... well, they did. Sacred, they said. So we work the mines until we've worked it off. Fair enough, I guess.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E7] ('Came here to start a lumber mill. Who knew the Nords cared about a bunch of old trees?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E6] ('Seen the remnants of the grove? That... well, that was me. Me and my sister.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E5] ('I should get over to Windhelm more. See how the other Morrowind refugees are getting along.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E4] ('Most people in Skyrim don't care for Dunmer. Roggi's the only one around here even half-decent.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E3] ('Morrowind used to be a lovely place, but you couldn't pay me to live there these days.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E2] ('The mine's always on the verge of collapse. Good thing I'm around to keep it up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E1] ([SO]'An outsider? No reason to stop in Kynesgrove. Keep moving.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6E0] ('My wife is a good woman, but every man needs a little variety, you know?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6DF] ('Roggi and I do the work around here. My wife and brats just sit around on their brains wasting time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6DE] ('Kjeld speaks for Kynesgrove. Anyone who says otherwise is aching for a fight.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6DD] ('If it's malachite you're after, you've come to the right place. I'll pay for any you dig up out of Steamscorch Mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6DC] ([SO]'Welcome to Kynesgrove. If you want to do business here, you'll have to deal with me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6DB] ('You've got a fine look about you. Come have a visit at the Braidwood Inn. Better than home!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6DA] ('Working our mine is dangerous work, but Dravynea keeps it going. Well, Dravynea and the promise of more mead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6D9] ('I visited the meaderies of Riften once, as a lad. Wish I had their skill.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6D8] ('All this talk of dragons is making people antsy. Nonsense!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E6D7] ([SO]'If you bring mead, you're welcome here! Even if you don't, you're still welcome!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E6D6])
[INFO:0002E51E] ('Yamarz was a fool. Always trying to scheme his way out of responsibility.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E518])
[INFO:0002E525] ('But, you took care of him and the giants. Two problems solved at once.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E517])
[INFO:0002E524] ('Well, the giants took care of him, and you took care of the giants. Two problems solved at once.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E517])
[INFO:0002E523] ('Now, take Shagrol's hammer back to Largashbur, and we'll see about whipping the rest of them into shape.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E514])
[INFO:0002E4A2] ('Changed the linens myself. They're fresh.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E4A1] ('If you drink too much, you're out. No drunks.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E4A0] ('My mother's dead, but I won't close the inn. I've hired Leontius to run things.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E49F] ([SO]'This is the Old Hroldan Inn. Clean beds and strong drink.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:00068960] ('Skuli's father is off fighting for the Stormcloaks. I'm sure he's just fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E49D] ('Skuli's father is off fighting for the Empire. I'm sure he's just fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E49B] ('Don't underestimate my son, Skuli. He may look young, but he can handle any drunks we get.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E499] ('Old Hroldan is the stone that the Empire's history is built on.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E498] ([SO]'You'll be looking to rent Tiber Septim's room I take it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0006895F] ('I work for Eydis. She runs the inn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:000BEB6C] ('You should head on inside. Eydis or Skuli can take care of you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:000BEB6B] ('Skuli owns the inn with his mother gone, but I handle the rooms.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E493] ('The Old Hroldan Inn is still open, bless poor Eydis's memory.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E470])
[INFO:0002E34D] ('Hmm. That doesn't go anywhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E349])
[INFO:0002E34A] ('I guess we'd better try this way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E348])
[INFO:0002E34B] ('Go ahead. I'll follow your lead and watch your back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E347])
[INFO:000E7C10] ([R][RE]'Come on, you're not even trying!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C0F] ([R]'Die damnit!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C0E] ([R]'Are you trying? 'Cause I'm not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C0D] ([R]'I'm getting bored.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C0C] ([R]'I got something for you. But you'll have to come and get it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C0B] ([R]'I eat Legionnaires like you for breakfast!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C0A] ([R]'Damn you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C09] ([R]'The Emperor can kiss my ass!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C08] ([R]'Your blood is such a pretty shade of red!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C07] ([R]'Now you're just making me mad.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C06] ([R]'I'll enjoy killing you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C05] ([R]'Hahahaha!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C04] ([R][RE]'Ready to give up?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C03] ([R]'I have no problem killing you. How do you feel about dying?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C02] ([R]'I'm not impressed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C01] ([R]'I've seen fresh recruits with more skill than you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7C00] ([R]'Die, will you?!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7BFF] ([R]'Getting tired yet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7BFD] ([R][RE]'Hahahaha!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7BEB] ([R]'You want me to close my eyes? Would that even things up a little?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7BC6] ([R]'Wake me up when you're ready to fight me for real.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B92] ([R]'You call this a fight?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B65] ([R]'Where's your precious Emperor now?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B40] ([R]'Die Imperial!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B3D] ([R]'Come on, at least try to hurt me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B35] ([R]'Come on! I dare you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B20] ([R]'You're losing a lot of blood. Maybe you should sit down for a moment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B11] ([R]'Call yourself a warrior?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000E7B10] ([R]'I'm having fun, are you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A6BB0] ([R][RE]'Your death will be swift!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A6BAF] ([R]'The shadows will be your undoing!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A6B48] ([R]'I claim your soul for Nocturnal!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A6B44] ([R][RE]'Is that the best you can do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A6B3E] ([R]'I've killed legions like you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A6B3D] ([R]'I'll spit on your corpse!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A726B] ([R][RE]'You just made the last mistake of your life!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A726A] ([R]'Come on. Show me you've got what it takes!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A7269] ([R]'My blade thirsts for your blood!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A7268] ([R][RE]'Don't make me laugh!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A7267] ([R]'You're nothing but a joke!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A7266] ([R][RE]'I'll cut out your eyes and sell 'em for coin!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:0002E3EC] ([R]'Come on, show an old man what you got!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:0002E441] ([R]'My power is supreme!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:0002E3ED] ([R]'I cannot be defeated!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])
[INFO:000A7265] ([R]'You dare challenge me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E33D])

column4: [INFO:0002E2C8] ('We have to go through town and across the bridge to get to Bleak Falls Barrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E2C7])
[INFO:000D91CF] ([R]'Solitude is as glorious as they said it was. Nothing like Falkreath where I grew up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D9174] ([R]'Everything's in order.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D9169] ([R]'We couldn't have taken this city without you, ma'am.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D90ED] ([R]'We couldn't have taken this city without you, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D90CC] ([R]'Been up to the Blue Palace? It's a sight to see. Even if it is filled with fops...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA654] ([R]'Pinemoon Cave is down to the southwest, but it ain't fit for exploring. There are stories... Vampires, some say...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA653] ([R]'The road to Whiterun's not safe these days. Lots of travelers just... disappear, south of Dragon Bridge. Can't find a trace of them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA652] ([R]'If you must venture southwest, stay clear of Volskygge. It is a cursed place, a tomb where the dead still live...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA651] ([R]'You heard of Ravenscar Hollow? Cave on the island to the west. Place is a roost for those foul Hagravens.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA650] ([R]'Off the coast a ways to the east, you'll find the wreck of the Brinehammer. Never know what treasures may still be aboard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA64E] ([R]'I don't abide fancy clothes, but you look like you might. I hear Radiant Raiments has a large selection.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA64D] ([R]'The Winking Skeever's got warm beds and cold mead. You look like you could use both.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA64C] ([R]'You can sell off that junk at Bits and Pieces.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA64B] ([R]'If you need potions, head over to Angeline's Aromatics.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DA64A] ([R]'If it's arms or armor you need, see Beirand in Castle Dour. Bloody good blacksmith, that one.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF4DA] ('I hail from Cyrodiil, but after a... misunderstanding with the law, I needed a swift change of scenery.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF4D3] ('From ship's captain to lowly crewman... I suppose I deserve it after wasting all my coin on gambling and women.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF4CC] ('My shipmates scoff at my love of finery, but I know envy when I hear it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF4C1] ('I once captained a ship called the Argent Raptor. She struck an iceberg and went down, just north of Windhelm.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000E769D] ('You look a little sturdier than most of the Popinjays around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000E769C] ('Meals are served to Bards at designated times. Find an inn if you want to make requests.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000E7699] ('You've found the Bards College kitchen. Congratulations.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF4B5] ('Dorian is helping me perfect my fencing, but I don't think I'll ever be as good as he is.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF49D] ('Just yesterday, I saw a musician in the street playing a flute. It was... beautiful. I want that flute.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF49C] ('I've seen some truly wondrous sights since I took to the seas. I had no idea a man could die in so many ways...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF498] ('My father was all the family I ever had. I felt so lost when he died. But the crew of the Red Wave's my family now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF494] ('You've not seen the night sky until you've seen it on the open sea.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])

[INFO:000DD615] ('Don't misunderstand me, friend. I like my quiet, and I like to read. But you trifle with my ship, my crew, or my captain? I will kill you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF495] ('I hear Adonato Leotelli's staying up in Windhelm. I've read a few of his works. Be good to meet him someday.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF493] ('Forget wine, women and wealth - give me a calm sea and a good book, and I'm happy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000AF490] ('I've only been a part of the Red Wave's crew for a few weeks, but I've already learned to stay out of Captain Safia's way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00094181] ('Out of my way, or I'll cut you. Deep.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00094180] ('What hole did you crawl out of?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0009417F] ('Whatever you're about to say, don't bother. I don't want to hear it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0009417E] ('You reek. A little friendly advice - take a bath and get some new clothes.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0009417D] ('You must have a death wish.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0009417C] ('I'd say you're either brave or stupid, but I can already tell which one it is.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0009417B] ('It takes a brave soul to wander onto my deck. It'll take more than that to leave in one piece.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0009417A] ('You'd better have a damned good reason for being here...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302F2] ('I will thank you not to interrupt me in my tasks.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302F1] ('Do you have business with the East Empire Company?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1AB] ('Good day to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302EE] ('Father says I don't have the knack for reading, but mama says I won't need it to work the farm.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A9] ('Mama said I could help with the goats!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302ED] ('You're a guest. And father says we have to be polite to guests.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302EC] ('My brothers would have been appalled to see a man outdone by his wife, but not me. Without Katla, this farm would fall apart.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302EB] ('I was a much younger man when I married Katla. Now I can hardly keep up with her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A8] ('Oh, hello. Have a seat, will you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302EA] ('It's hard work keeping Solitude fed, but I wouldn't trust any other family to do it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E9] ('My husband handles the indoor work. Just as well - he'd only hurt himself out here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A7] ('Can I help you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E8] ('I could swear I've seen you somewhere before...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E7] ('We only want what is best for Tamriel. Surely, the rebels will accept peace when they realize this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E6] ('Talos was a heroic man, but not a god. It pains the Altmer that we must remind our younger cousins of the difference.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E5] ('The Empire, in its wisdom, has come to recognize Talos worship as a barbaric remnant of a bygone age.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A6] ('My duty is simple - oversee the Thalmor Justiciars, and make sure they perform their duties admirably.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D6D] ('Any day is a good one, long as I don't have to go into town. But with Hjorunn gone...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E4] ('Any day is a good one, long as I don't have to go into town. But some days, Hjorunn's too drunk...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E3] ('Out here at work, Hjorunn treats me like an equal. Better than most in town.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A5] ('What do you want?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E2] ('We had some trouble, while back. Stormcloak tried to set the mill on fire. But we sorted her out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E1] ('Living outside the walls is a risk, aye. But at least the guards don't come nosin' around.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302E0] ('Come in, come in! I was just about to take a break.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302DF] ('When I was a boy, there was a year we couldn't afford enough feed. So I snuck my dinner out to the stables, and gave it to the horse.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302DE] ('I grew up tending some of these horses. They're almost family.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D6C] ('Need a horse? I guess I'm the one to talk to, since my da passed...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A3] ('Looking for a horse? You'll want to talk to my father, Geimund.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302DD] ('My family's weathered its share of problems, but we don't dwell on the past.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302DC] ('I really don't mean to be rude, but I don't think there's much I can help you with.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D6B] ('Is this about the stables? With my husband gone, my son Horm handles the business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A2] ('Is this about the stables? My husband, Geimund, handles the business.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D6A] ('You wouldn't know it, but before my family got killed? I was the luckiest man in Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302DB] ('With a wife like Fridrika and a son like Horm, I'm the luckiest man in Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302DA] ('Work hard for the future and leave the past be. That's my motto.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A1] ('You got business at the stables?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D69] ('It's only a matter of time before Ahtar's blade finds my neck...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302D9] ('Don't think I don't know what's coming.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D65] ('Leave me be, Imperial. I haven't got anything to say to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E1A0] ('You here for my next interrogation? I got nothing but time...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302D1] ('Fletching suits me. It's difficult, and sometimes tedious. But a well made arrow strikes forth like the fury of a god.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302D0] ('If you're looking for any archery or fletching supplies, you should see Fihada. I'm just the apprentice.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D69F0] ('Always good to see a fellow traveler. I hope you've found the roads relatively safe. Free from dragons, at the very least...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E19D] ('Ah, yet another new face. I'm from Hammerfell, you see. I can hardly keep track of all the people I've been meeting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DC0] ('A sharp mind beats a sharp blade any day. Words to live by.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302CF] ('Your typical Solitude wench is like the city itself. Stormy exterior, but ah the charms that lie within...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000302CE] ('True, I may look the part of dashing swordsman, but I prefer the art of wit to that of warfare.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002FD42] ('Hello and welcome, my friend. How may I help you on this fine day?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F82E] ('May Arkay bless you with a long life, a proud death, and a restful grave.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E194] ('Hello, my child. Arkay watch over you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F82C] ('Got lots of things to take care of. What do you need?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E193] ('Watch your feet. We just cleaned there!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DBF] ('I made a wish in the town well that a golden knight came to take me to his castle. Oh, does it spoil the wish if I tell?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])

[INFO:000C7C84] ('Maybe you need a partner? Hmm? Just picture it. Two women, the dusty road, strapping men at every tavern, a fortune in gold to be claimed...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F82B] ('Are you my gallant hero? Have you come to whisk me away, to a life of adventure and romance?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C6A] ('Someday, I'll be a gallant heroine. You make it look so.. appealing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00036D37] ('Someday, a gallant hero will ride up and take me away. Someday...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C58] ('So exciting when new folk come into town. I bet you've had plenty of adventures.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E192] ('Oh, hello! Just tidying up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DBE] ('Most of the time, people just forget I'm even here. That's why I hear so much good gossip.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DD614] ('Somethin' just ain't right about that Sybille. You know, I've never seen her eat a thing? That can't be natural.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F829] ('Folks at court won't admit it, but Sybille Stentor scares us all to death.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F828] ('Everyone knows General Tullius wields the real power Solitude. Elisif? Ah, she's a figurehead. A puppet.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E191] ('Jarls come and jarls go, but a good cook stays for a lifetime. And I'm a very, very good cook.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DBC] ('Surely you have something better to do...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DBD] ('You're trying my patience.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F826] ('I have so very many ways to deal with people. Very few of them pleasant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E190] ('Be quick. I have little patience for mundane concerns.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D64] ('Blacksmith, at your service.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F824] ('Apprentice blacksmith, at your service.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D63] ('We've got strong swords and sturdy armor, if you're looking to buy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D62] ('Think I'll forge me a new sword, just in case things go awry here in Solitude. I'm the blacksmith's apprentice, you see.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E18F] ([SO]'Just arrive in the city? Is it true what they say, then? There are dragons about?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00036D36] ('The Jarl is not to be disturbed with common affairs of court. You direct those concerns to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E18D] ([SO]'I am the Jarl's Steward. If you have court business to tend to, you talk to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F820] ('Do you have business with the court?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DBB] ('Thanks to Ulfric's rebellion, countless innocent people can't feed or clothe their families. It's unacceptably tragic.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DBA] ('Ulfric is a fool and a coward, who naively believes he can bring about peace through warfare. It's rather sad, really.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E18C] ('With the passing of my dear husband Torygg, the weighty position of Jarl has fallen to me. Please direct questions to my Steward.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F81D] ('If you have business, please see Falk Firebeard, my steward.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00076F19] ('Ain't many visitors come to the dungeon. Every now and then Sybille Stentor will come by looking for... volunteers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E18B] ('Not much work being a jailor. Long as you can ignore the pleading and all that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F81C] ('You stay out of trouble, now. The Castle Dour dungeon can break even the strongest will.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DD613] ([SO]'Mind yourself in my city, lass. This here axe in full swing is a right terrible sight...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D69EF] ([SO]'Mind yourself in my city, friend. This here axe in full swing is a right terrible sight...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D5B] ('You get around, right? If you come across any Stormcloaks... gut one for me. They did the same to my brother in Whiterun.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F81A] ('An apple to keep you healthy? A tomato to keep you strong? Surely you need one or the other...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E18A] ('You look like you could do with a ripe apple. Or a tomato, cabbage or leek?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F811] ('Working for Erikur may be below my stature, but the compensation is... acceptable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E186] ('Speak if you must, but mind your tongue. I do not suffer fools gladly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB7] ('Quickly, if you please. I'm quite busy running errands for my bastard of a brother...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F810] ('Have you met my dear brother Erikur? The man's as trustworthy as a Khajiit goldmonger.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E185] ('Welcome to the center of the world. Or at least my brother Erikur's world...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F80F] ('Hello. I'm Gisli. But you can just call me Erikur's sister. Everyone does.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB6] ('The Jarl has advised me not to talk about which court attendants I'd like to punch in the face. More's the pity.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F80E] ('Keep your weapon out of your hands, and we'll get along just fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F80D] ('My duty is to keep the Jarl safe. Not play nursemaid to you sycophants.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E18E] ('Please address all questions to the Steward, Falk Firebeard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F80C] ('Half of the businesses in town owe me money, and I own most of the rest. I practically run Solitude already.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DD612] ('I understand what's best for Solitude... and Jarl Elisif knows it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F80B] ('Bryling's obsession with honor and tradition is quaint, but politically irrelevant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E184] ('The Imperials are good for business, and business is good for Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F80A] ('When I was a young rascal, I broke a man's arm with a single punch. Course, I had a horseshoe hidden in my glove...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D5A] ('You don't want to talk to me. I'm just a stand in for a dead Thane.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D7892] ('I think Bryling's the one you want to talk to. I'm mostly just here to scare away the riff raff.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E183] ('Unless we have specific business, I'm not interested.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB4] ('This godsforsaken war is dividing our people and destroying our land.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB3] ('Many condemn the Stormcloaks, but I refuse. There is honor in fighting for what you believe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00036D35] ('I can always find time to share a word with a warrior.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F806] ('Thane Bryling, at your service.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F805] ('You know, I don't get the impression that I'm very well liked at the College...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00036D34] ('I'm so glad you got back from Olaf's Tomb okay. They gave you a tougher task then they gave me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E181] ('Dean Inge says a bard can never have enough practice. So, would you like a tune?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F804] ('You're new here, right? Welcome to the Bards College. It's like a... musical museum.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB2] ('I can't understand why Jorn would want to join the Imperial Legion. Soldiers only appreciate one thing, and it isn't music.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F802] ('Few can resist my charms. Even fewer are worthy of them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E180] ('Lady Ateia says my voice is second only to hers. But she's selling me short.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F801] ('Lisette's a fine lass, but when I join the Legion, she's not the type to wait for my return.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DD611] ('Viarmo is too concerned with precision. What of instinct? Hmm? What of passion?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F800] ('It's an honor to have Viarmo for instruction on drum, but he's far too reserved for my tastes.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E17F] ('I wish only to graduate and enroll with the Legion. My drums will lead our troops to victory.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB0] ('If you love history, you're in the right place. Skyrim is steeped in it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DAF] ('What a fascinating time to be alive! Mark me, these days will be remembered long after we're gone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])

[INFO:0002F7FD] ('My position, "Dean of History," actually covers a wide range of subjects. I teach poetry, writing, history, and the finer points of court life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E17E] ([SO]'Hello, yes? I'm the Dean of History. And scribe work, when I can find some quiet time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DAE] ('You here to apply at the Bards College? Well don't bother - you're too damned old. Start past four, and it's all wasted effort.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7FB] ('Only reason I'm so good with a lute is because I'm old. It takes a lifetime to master.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DAD] ([SO]'It takes two things to be a good teacher. The first is patience. The second is a firm wooden stick for rapping knuckles.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7FA] ([SO]'I'm Dean of Lute at the Bards College, and no, I don't give private lessons.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F9] ('To be honest, I simply can't stand some of my students. Only Aia shows true potential for greatness. The rest are just wasting my time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F8] ('If you ask me, this damned rebellion can't end soon enough. I had to end my tour of Skyrim's courts. Too dangerous too travel.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F7] ('It's been my honor to perform at the Blue Palace on many occasions. His late lordship was quite the admirer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E17C] ([SO]'Good evening. I'm Pantea Ateia, the Master Vocalist.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C48] ('The pleasure's all mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C46] ('Anything I can do for you, I will.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C25] ('Youngest bard at the Bards College, at your service.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F6] ('Never forget, the most important job of any bard is to entertain. The day you lose your audience is the day you cut your lute strings.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DD610] ('We bards record history - we do not make it. You'd do well to remember that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F5] ('I generally don't involve myself in politics. Good tales deal with the issues of the day, but a wise bard remains a neutral observer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00036D33] ([SO]'It is my personal mission to ensure that the Bards College preserves the great deeds of the past, in both poetry and song.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E17B] ('Welcome to Solitude. Home of the arts here in Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DAC] ('Soft sheets and hard liquor. What's not to like?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DAB] ('Glad you decided to check us out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F4] ('Seems there's always more to be done...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D59] ('I'm just running some errands for the old man... Err... For myself. I'm just running some errands for myself...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E175] ('Don't mind me. I'm just running errands for the old man.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BD71D] ('You know, the Winking Skeever's not just the best inn in Solitude. It's the also the only inn in Solitude.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BD71C] ([SO]'New in town, right? If you need a place to sleep, head over to the Winking Skeever. We keep a fine inn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2D8C] ('Uh oh. A fellow bard. I best not miss my notes or forget any lyrics.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D58] ('Have a drink, rest your feet and stay a little while.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2D8B] ('There's nothing like a good song to lift the spirit in troubled times.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F2] ('Feel free to make requests.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E170] ('Traitors, civil wars, dragons. Bah. Those troubles don't cross my doorway. So sit, relax.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E16E] ('If you need a good rumor or two, I think I can oblige...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E16D] ('Welcome to the Winking Skeever, friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D57] ('I can help with purchases, but if you came to talk, see my sister. She's the one who gets on with people. It's her one virtue, really.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E169] ('Let me just drop everything to help you. I don't mind. Really.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FD1] ('So good to see you again. How can I be of service?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E168] ('Oh, what delight. Another charming customer...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E164] ('We provide clothing for all of Solitude's most... influential residents. But for you, I'll make an exception.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E163] ('Why, hello! Here to buy? If you have to ask the price, you may be in the wrong store.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C21] ('If you ever want to replace those old rags, stop by Radiant Raiment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C7C1F] ('If you're heading to the Blue Palace, you might want to rethink that outfit.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D56] ('I get to help mother with the shop. I used to help papa too... 'till I tried to use the forge...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D55] ('I bet my papa could have beat you up. He was stronger than anyone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E15A] ('I bet my papa could beat you up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D54] ('I thought adventurers were supposed to look tough?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E159] ('Hey! Wanna play tag?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D53] ([SO]'Welcome. Look around. We've got everything you could want in life. At least... that's what my Beirand always told me...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00084D6B] ([SO]'Welcome. Look around. We've got everything you could want in life. At least... that's what Beirand always tells me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])

[INFO:000C1D52] ([SO]'Hmph. You know, you've got a certain... fire in your eyes. Just like my Beirand did. Please, feel free to look around. We've got a bit of everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])

[INFO:0002E154] ([SO]'Hmph. You know, you've got a certain... fire in your eyes. Just like my Beirand. Please, feel free to look around. We've got a bit of everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D51] ('Beirand said you got here just before the execution. Must have been a lovely first sight.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0005585C] ('You look like an adventurous one. I bet we're kindred spirits, you and I.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00055873] ('I'm a little busy at the moment. I've got all sorts of errands to run.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D4D] ('If you're looking for potions, I think I can be of service.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E14E] ('If you're looking for potions you should talk to my aunt, Angeline Morrard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00055872] ('You were there for Roggvir's execution...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D4C] ('So, what are your needs? Perhaps a pinch of this, and a bit of that? Hmm?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:00034B3D] ('Need something for a potion? You're certainly in the right place.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000E8BD1] ('Ah, welcome to Angela's Aromatics. Can I help with some herbal needs?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BD71B] ('I'm in mourning. Can't you see that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FD0] ('If you want to talk about my brother, I'm not interested.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BD71A] ('I'm not looking for conversation.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7F0] ([SO]'Are you here to talk about my brother? Do you think his execution was justified?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FB0] ('Mother says I shouldn't talk to people...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E179] ('Pardon me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E17A] ('I don't have anything to say.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7ED] ('I... I don't want to talk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FAC] ('You shouldn't leave Solitude without trying our fish. Best in Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7EB] ('I've got some salmon to sell.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E178] ('Plenty of fresh fish for ya.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7EA] ('Them Imperials left me to die in Anvil, and I had to fight my way back home. Then they followed me back here!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FA7] ('I hid here in Solitude for a long time but war, war follows a man until it's done with him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7E9] ('Can you spare a septim? Lost an eye during the Great War, or I'd earn it myself...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E177] ('Spare some gold for a veteran?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1D48] ('Papa used to say I was greg-gare-ree-yus, just like him. I miss him...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7E8] ('My papa says I'm greg-gare-ree-yus, just like him! He says it means "smart," but my brother says he's wrong.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E176] ('Papa says I won't see Roggvir any more, but he wouldn't tell me why not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2D88] ([SO]'Hiya! What's your name? Are you visiting? What do you do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2FCF] ('Hey! Wanna play tag?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7E6] ('Oh, for the salt spray, the creek of the mast, and the clash of sabers. Those were the days...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7E4] ('What brings you all the way out here?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E19B] ('Oh my, old Ma'zaka has a visitor!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E19A] ('Dock work is not good work. Better than Black Marsh though. Much better.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7E1] ('You want knives? You want them in your belly? No? Then you stop talking to Deeja.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7E0] ('You have no knowledge of who you speak to. Go away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E199] ('You, talk to egg-brothers. Deeja has no words for you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7DF] ([G]'I don't like strangers...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7DE] ([G]'Go away. I have more important things on my mind right now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E198] ([G]'I have no business with you. Leave me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FA4] ('May you be saved by the Divines, as I once was.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FA3] ('May the Divines guide and keep you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7DC] ('The Divines saved me from the streets, and they can save you from your trials, as well.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E197] ('Blessings to you. The Divines are listening.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BE973] ('Feel free to take a seat, or pray at the shrines. We appreciate worship in all its forms.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7DA] ('You look troubled. Have you come seeking guidance?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FA2] ('Blessings of the Nine Divines upon you. How may I help?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E196] ('Blessings of the Eight Divines upon you. How may I help?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0FA1] ('Blessings be with you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BE96F] ('Well, now. I'm afraid you've caught me a bit out of my element. Most of my time is spent in the Temple of the Divines, you see.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BE941] ('I'm afraid I'm running errands at the moment. But please, visit me later at the Temple of the Divines.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002FD3F] ('Wander no more, for you are among friends here, and safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0F20] ('We welcome you to worship the Nine Divines, freely and openly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000BE940] ('We welcome you to worship the Eight Divines, freely and openly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C0F1F] ('As high priest of the Nine Divines, I bid you welcome.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F7D8] ('As high priest of the Eight Divines, I bid you welcome.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D7891] ('It's good to be away from the forge for a bit.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D7890] ('Need a weapon? Hmmm... By the looks of ya, yeah... Think I've got somethin' you can use.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1BC7] ('I got some fine armor, if you're lookin'.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1C44] ('Wanderer like you must have plenty of tales to tell. But I'm afraid I'm too busy to hear 'em.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000D788F] ('When the Stormcloaks took Solitude, I thought for sure things would slow down. But they keep me just as busy as the Imperials.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E160] ('Seems there's no end to the needs of the Imperials. But what can I help you with?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F814] ('If you see my father Octieve around, stay clear. He'll only ask you for money or mead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000C1B4D] ('I swear, I left another bottle right here...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F818] ('I don't have time for anyone too lazy or cowardly to make their own way in this world.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000DD60F] ('Good business for the East Empire Company means all the more gold for the Empire.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])

[INFO:0002F817] ('Some say I got my position because my cousin is the Emperor. Nonsense. The man's given me nothing. He can't even be bothered to attend my wedding.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E189] ('Hmm? Sorry, I was lost in thought. I'm planning my wedding, you see. So many details to work out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB9] ('You want to know the one truth I've learned in all my years? Life's too hard to face sober.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F816] ('You got nothin' better to do than bother an old man?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E188] ('I'm too old to work, but that don't make me too old to drink.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F815] ('Being old's not so bad. Daughter keeps me fed, and my working days are done.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F813] ('Wanderer like you needs a little fire in the veins. Some spiced wine?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002E187] ('Spiced wine for ya? It's a family recipe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000B2DB8] ('No doubt most folk in Skyrim consider the dragons terrifying. I find them... wondrous.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:0002F812] ('Sybille Stentor has a grasp of magical theory that I would never have expected from a human. Even a Breton.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E13B])
[INFO:000A9604] ([G]'I'm not going to talk to you until this mess is cleaned up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E139])
[INFO:000A9603] ([G]'Pick up your mess. Then we'll talk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E139])
[INFO:000A9600] ([G]'I have no words. Talk to Anwen.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E139])
[INFO:000A95F6] ([G]'Don't talk to me, defiler.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E139])
[INFO:00085C4C] ('Talk to me again when you've cleaned up your mess.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E136])

column4: [INFO:0002E0FF] ('Aye, I see the look you're giving me. Don't worry, I won't bite.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A15] ('Takes a lot of strength to swing a pick axe, know what I mean?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E101] ('I'd wager I could crack rock faster than anyone. Even you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E100] ('You're looking at the best miner in Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E102] ('Ha! You showed those spiders a thing or two!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0FA] ('Came all the way out here to see us, did you?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A14] ('I suppose you're used to traveling, being a stranger around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0006A705] ('Have you ever been to Darkwater Crossing? Terrible name for such a beautiful place.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A13] ('Welcome to Shor's Stone.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A12] ('Would you happen to be headed towards Darkwater Crossing?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0FE] ('I trust my parents are well?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0FD] ('Making that trip to Darkwater Crossing was a huge help. Thank you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A11] ('Mining's my life now, I wouldn't want to do anything else.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F8] ('Sure, I used to be a soldier... but that was child's play compared to cracking rock.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F6] ('The real work happens in places like this. Blood and sweat is what makes the world turn.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F5] ('You think you're tough, huh? Wandering Skyrim is a picnic compared to tunnel crawling!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0006A704] ('Everything was going great in Redbelly. Then the damn spiders showed up.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A10] ('What brings you out to Shor's Stone?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F4] ('If you're looking for supplies, I'd advise heading to Riften.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F3] ('I hate seeing a good mine go to waste like that, you know?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F2] ('Sorry, the mine's dry right now.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A0F] ('I hope you haven't arrived here looking for work in the mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:000E4A0E] ('The spiders put you through the ringer?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F0] ('Nasty little buggers, aren't they?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0002E0F1] ('The mine will be running better than ever thanks to you.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueShorsStoneHellos [DIAL:0002E0EF])
[INFO:0004437E] ('I just want to be left alone to do my job, and to enjoy what little free time I have when I have it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0DE6] ('The mill is my responsibility, and that's what I care about. That's all. Understand?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0004437D] ('We've gone from a Jarl lost in her own head to a Jarl that cares for nothing but herself. Lot of good that does us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0004437C] ([SO]'Unless it's about the mill, I don't have time to talk. Too much to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0004437B] ('I don't get many customers, but that leaves me time to try things out. Experiment, I guess.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0004437A] ('Jorgen and I both work hard, all the time. Morthal is important to both of us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00044379] ([SO]'If you need any alchemy supplies, I'll do my best to provide them. Assuming I haven't used them all up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00044378] ('I asked Falion if someday I could learn from the mages in Winterhold, but he doesn't like that idea.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00044377] ('My mother and father died years ago. Falion takes care of me now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00044376] ('Do you like magic? Falion says I'm good at learning. I like learning about magic.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ED1] ('Please remain indoors at night. It is dangerous to go outside.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ED0] ('Morthal is a troubled place, and it is my duty to see it rest in peace.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0DD6] ('My talents are much needed here, in order to keep Morthal... safe.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ECF] ('The changes in Morthal are of little consequence to me. So long as the laws are upheld, I do not care who does the upholding.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ECE] ([SO]'You are new to Morthal. We have not spoken before. This is interesting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000604F3] ('There's enough real troubles in the world without making new ones up.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ECD] ('Ignore the talk of spirits and creatures and such. It's just superstition.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ECC] ('I just try and do my job, and not to think about what's happened. Try to find what happiness I can.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042ECB] ('Alva's been good to me ever since... well, since the fire.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000DBA2F] ('I... I'm not one for talk. Try to keep to myself.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])

[INFO:00042ECA] ('Thank you for saving me from Alva. I was completely under her evil spell. I'll never forgive myself for what happened to Helgi and my wife.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042EC8] ('Gathering plants, picking mushrooms, brewing potions. It all gets so dreary after a while. This town needs something exciting to happen.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042EC7] ('These people are like cattle. All they do is work, sleep and eat.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E5E] ('The people here work so hard, and they never allow themselves a moment of fun. It's such a pity. It won't last forever though.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000DBA2E] ('Well, aren't you the pretty one. I bet all the men chase after you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000DBA2D] ('Well, aren't you the handsome one. You and I should spend some time together.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E5D] ('I know you for what you are. This town's blood is ours. Leave it! Now we must return to our roles lest the sheep suspect the wolves.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E5C] ('Who are the Stormcloaks, and why would mama want to spend time with them instead of me?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E5A] ('Papa says that I shouldn't keep waiting. Why not? Mama has to come home some time.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E59] ('Have you seen my mother? I'm still waiting for her to come home.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000604F2] ('Some say the swamp took her. Part of me wishes it were that simple.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E58] ('Hasn't been seen for a while. She just vanished without a trace.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E57] ('My boy's to grow up without a mother? What life is that? It's not right, I tell you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E56] ('This damned war has cost us... me... everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E55] ('I'm just a poor man trying to make a living. I'd leave Morthal were it in my power.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E54] ([SO]'Keep your wits about you. Morthal's hardly a safe place.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E53] ('It's Falion. He... He did it. I don't know what it was, but he did it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E52] ('My mother sees things. She doesn't know why, but she does. Only sometimes, she doesn't see me at all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E51] ('Gorm thinks I'm mad. He doesn't say it, but I know he thinks it. Is he right?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0DCB] ('I get lost sometimes. I'm not sure where I go, but I'm not... I'm not here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0DCA] ('I can't sleep here. The dreams are even worse than before.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E50] ('I don't understand. Why can't we go home?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E4F] ([SO]'You're different, aren't you? Not like anyone else. Not in Morthal, or Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000604F1] ('For now, looking after Joric is my job.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0DB0] ('I keep hoping this is another vision, that it's not real. But it is, isn't it? We really have lost our home.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E4E] ('It's difficult sometimes... To know whether what I see is real or not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E4D] ('Someday I'll be Jarl. Mother reminds me often. I hope I can help the people of Morthal the way she has.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E4C] ('I don't... I haven't mother's gift, not quite, but I've seen things.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D95] ('To be driven from our homes, to be forced here... this is the last thing that Joric needs.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E4B] ('Please don't mind Joric. He's not mad, really he's not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E49] ('I'm under a lot of pressure. If you don't leave me alone, I won't be held responsible.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E48] ('Morthal has enough problems without you bothering me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000AD89B] ('I'm just here to protect the Jarl, not to chat.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D8B] ('All that ever mattered was what was best for Morthal. Leaving it in Ulfric's hands... It's not right.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D7E] ('This wasn't what I wanted. Not at all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D76] ('Leave Idgrod and her family alone. They've been through enough.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E47] ('My mind weighs heavy enough. Leave me to my food.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E46] ([SO]'Morthal doesn't need any trouble. You keep your nose clean, understand?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E45] ('The only thing that matters to me is keeping my wife safe. I won't let anyone harm her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E44] ('Too many bother my wife with their petty problems, and then don't even understand the advice she gives them.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E43] ('I do what I can to see that Idgrod's time isn't wasted, and that she only has to deal with important matters.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D75] ('If you've business with the Jarl, I'd ask that you speak to me first.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D74] ('I fear for what this change will do to my family.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D3A] ('The Empire brought stability, assurance to the people of Morthal, even if they didn't appreciate it. Now what do they have?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E42] ('We're safe here now. But what of Morthal?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E41] ('There is too much to learn in the world, too much to know, to fight over "laws" that have no real purpose.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E40] ('All this talk of rebellion and strife. Too many are focused on what might be instead of what is. It tires me to talk about it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E3F] ('In Morthal, there is little to rule. But there is much to teach. And so, I am Jarl.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E3E] ('I speak, and others hear. It is my hope that instead they listen.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D39] ('It is my hope that I will one day return to Hjaalmarch. But the Divines have not shown this to me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D38] ('I try and take comfort in knowing that when all is lost, there is much to be gained.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0D37] ('Dark times, indeed. I fear the worst for Morthal and my people.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E3D] ('Tamriel is full of wisdom and magic, if one is willing to look for it. Few have their eyes open.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E3C] ([SO]'So, life has brought you to Morthal, and to me. What purpose this serves, we will no doubt see. Welcome.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E3B] ('You'll want to be careful travelin' at night. The marsh is a dangerous place.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000604F0] ('I've tried to explain to Lurbuk that his "singin'" is gonna get his throat cut.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E3A] ('Ignore the Orc. He pays, so I let him stay.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E39] ('I take what little business I can git. I'm grateful for anyone willin' to spend money here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000604EF] ('Falion had his work to keep him busy, and I needed somethin' to do. So, here I am.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E38] ('Runnin' an inn weren't my plan. But Falion decided to move here, so I joined him.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E37] ('There ain't much to offer, but if you wanna place dry to spend the night, I'll rent you a room.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E36] ([SO]'Welcome to the Moorside. If you need anythin', I'll be 'round. Good to have a customer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E35] ('I, Lurbuk the Great, will win the hearts of the people of Morthal one day, mark my words!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E34] ('The fair Jonna does me a great courtesy by allowing me to entertain the guests of her noble establishment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E33] ('Try as you may, they won't say "good day," but will just walk away. Worry not, Morthal! Lurbuk is here to stay!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E32] ('The good people of Morthal have yet to embrace my talent.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E31] ('Don't fret over the gloom, there's nothing to fear! Old Lurbuk will brighten your spirits -- just lend him your ear!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042E30] ([SO]'A new face! Such a welcome sight in dreary old Morthal. Welcome friend, welcome!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00042891] ('The Jarl does little to protect us these days.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0EE9] ('Been hoping they'd make me a guard, but not yet. Still, I'll help them out if I can.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:000E0EE8] ('I figure the guards could always use some help, so I keep my eyes open.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0003FE1E] ('This isn't the time or place for magic, or whatever it is Falion does.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0003FE0E] ('You ask me, we'd be better off without that wizard in town.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:0003FDBE] ('Morthal used to be a quiet place. But then, the world used to make sense.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0ED])
[INFO:00068366] ('This is not where Teeba-Ei was meant to live out the rest of his days.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1AB] ('Teeba-Ei the hatchling never imagined working a mine in this cold place. Greater things were dreamt of.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1AA] ('Stonehills' warmth is a welcome change in this cold, bleak land.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1A9] ('The mine gives us purpose. Something many of us have wished for.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1A8] ('My business is my own. Why can't others see that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1A7] ('I'm just trying to make a living. I've no interest in trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1A6] ('When you work hard enough, really get into a rhythm, everything else just fades away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1A5] ('The outside world means little to us, and we'd like it to stay that way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F1A4] ('I'm just here to work the mine. Nothing else matters anymore.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F196] ('My job is my life. Whatever happened before doesn't matter.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F195] ('Bryling owns this mine. I wouldn't have much to live for if she hadn't offered me a job.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:00068364] ('I spend every waking moment making sure the mine is put to good use.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F194] ('You get used to the cold after a while. The harder you work, the warmer you stay.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F193] ([SO]'If you're here about the mine -- it's already got an owner, and she's not selling. If not, then please stay out of my workers' way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F192] ('I hear there's been fighting in Skyrim. Rebellion, maybe. Wonder if our iron is being used for weapons.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F191] ('My parents keep a close eye on the miners. They can't be trusted too much.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D36] ('Talk to my parents if you need something.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D35] ('Guess the Empire's going to need plenty of iron what with all the fighting. That'll be good for us, I suppose.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D34] ('I figured that I would run the mine someday. I just didn't figure that would mean now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F190] ('I'm in charge now that my parents are in Morthal.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F18F] ('Don't bother the miners. They've got work to do.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F18E] ('Wouldn't ever have expected to wind up living in a place like this, but the money's good.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F18D] ('Sorli and I are just here to make sure the mine is run proper.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D33] ('We left Sirgar in charge back at Stonehills. I hope that wasn't a mistake.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D32] ('I'll see to it that Sorli is safe now that she's running Morthal.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D31] ('It's good that Sorli has finally been given some real authority.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F18B] ('Pactur and I, we make sure the miners aren't stealing, and that the ore makes it to Solitude.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F18A] ('Nothing here but the mine. Probably best you keep moving.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D30] ('Finally, my leadership is being recognized.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:000E0D2F] ('Hjaalmarch isn't much, but it's a good start. I'll make a name for myself here, then maybe work my way up to someplace like Riften.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
[INFO:0002F189] ('We've got all the miners we need, so I hope you're not here looking for work.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002E0EC])
