column4: [INFO:00094049] ([SO]'Ranmir beg a drink from you, yet? That's gold wasted, friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DFC])
[INFO:00068F3D] ([SO]'Poor Roggi. If you're feeling charitable, buy the Nord a mead. He's good for it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DFC])
[INFO:0003F05A] ([SO]'We're used to getting by on scraps, but the Shatter-Shields want everything for nothing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DFC])
[INFO:0006F7CF] ([SO]'Life's hard enough with all these men propositioning me. But that bard is the worst.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DFC])
[INFO:00026FE8] ([SO]'Take my advice. Never gamble. Damn Irnskar has me in debt up to the eyes.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DFC])
[INFO:0009408A] ([SO]'I'm the best warrior in Morthal, and that's no boast.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DF9])
[INFO:0004039B] ([SO]'You damn gray-skin. Go back to Morrowind!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DF9])
[INFO:00040399] ([SO]'You. You a Dark Elf lover? Get out of our city, you filthy piece of trash.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DF9])
[INFO:00055A01] ([SO]'Think you can go blade to blade with me? You'd be dead in six seconds.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DF9])
[INFO:00055A00] ([SO]'You a fighting girl? How about a little bet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DF9])
[INFO:00026F4C] ([SO]'You a fighting man? How about a little bet?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DF9])
[INFO:0002C6D4] ([R]'You are going to brew a new batch of ale, right? Like we talked about? What we have's been sitting in that barrel for over a month.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DEA])
[INFO:0002C6D3] ([R]'I still need you to make a batch of those fried potatoes. We can serve them with the ale.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DEA])
[INFO:00026DF3] ([R]'You promised me you'd sweep the entranceway.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DEA])
[INFO:00026DF2] ([R]'The corn stores are getting low again, Orgnar.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DEA])
[INFO:00026E21] ([R]'Yep.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE9])
[INFO:00026DED] ([R]'Wait, let me guess. You'll get to it later.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE8])
[INFO:00026DEC] ([R]'And... you'll take care of it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE8])
[INFO:00026DEF] ([R]'Don't I always?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE7])
[INFO:00026DFB] ([R]'I don't suppose I could convince you to take care of it now, could I?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE6])
[INFO:00026E28] ([R]'No.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE5])
[INFO:00026E01] ([R]'I should have guessed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE4])
[INFO:00026E00] ([R]'Well. There's something to be said for honesty, I suppose.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE4])
[INFO:00026E1C] ([R]'Sven, we need to talk...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE3])
[INFO:00026DF7] ([R]'Here we go...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE2])
[INFO:00026E0C] ([R]'It's about your singing. Well, not your singing, your songs. But you know what I'm talking about.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE1])
[INFO:00026DFE] ([R]'You do realize these simpletons wouldn't know real music if it bit them in the britches, hmm? Very well. Your wish is my command.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DE0])
[INFO:00026E36] ([R]'Wonderful. And let's not have this chat again next week. Agreed?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDF])

[INFO:00026E3D] ([R]'Lucan, I was thinking we should have a grand sale. Lower the prices by half, maybe get some jugglers. We could attract lots of new customers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDE])
[INFO:00026E3C] ([R]'We don't sell any imports from Summerset Isle, do we, Lucan?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDE])
[INFO:00026E3B] ([R]'Lucan, we don't sell silver buckles, do we? One of the customers was asking.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDE])
[INFO:00026E44] ([R]'A sale? To attract new customers? Camilla, everyone in Riverwood already shops here. There are no more customers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDD])
[INFO:00026E43] ([R]'I'm afraid not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDD])
[INFO:00026E42] ([R]'No, dear sister. We do not.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDD])
[INFO:00026E17] ([R]'Hmmm... Well, maybe we could go on a sort of trip. Take the wares on the road. Get some new customers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDC])

[INFO:00026E16] ([R]'Well, I was thinking... we should. We could stock all kinds of specialty items. You know, to cater to some of our more.... "eclectic" customers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDC])
[INFO:00026E15] ([R]'Hmm. All right. Do you think... maybe we should?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDC])
[INFO:00026E24] ([R]'Camilla, really? You don't have better things to do? Because I could certainly find quite a few tasks...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDB])
[INFO:00026E23] ([R]'Dear sister, we talked about this sort of thing before. We sell dry goods, nothing more, nothing less.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDB])
[INFO:00026E22] ([R]'That's really not at the top of my list, no. Please, Camilla, I need you to focus.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDB])
[INFO:00026E27] ([R]'I know, I know. My head's in the clouds again. Just... forget I said anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDA])
[INFO:00026E26] ([R]'Okay, okay. Just trying make this place a little less... boring.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDA])
[INFO:00026E25] ([R]'Of course, Lucan. Of course. I was just, well... Never mind.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DDA])
[INFO:00026E40] ([R]'I'm bored standing around, papa. I could take over for you...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD9])
[INFO:00026E3F] ([R]'Is it time yet? Time for me to make my sword? Or maybe... an axe?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD9])
[INFO:00026E3E] ([R]'Can I make something now, papa?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD9])

[INFO:00026E39] ([R]'Patience, Dorthe. You'll get some time at the forge, I promise you. But not right now. You need to keep watching me. That's how you'll learn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD8])
[INFO:00026E38] ([R]'He he. Not just yet, Dorthe. I need to keep forging, and you need to keep watching.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD8])
[INFO:00026E37] ([R]'Later, little one. I need to finish what I'm working on. But keep watching. Watch, and learn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD8])
[INFO:00026E1A] ([R]'Yes, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD7])
[INFO:00026E19] ([R]'All right. But I am getting a bit tired of waiting.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD7])
[INFO:00026E18] ([R]'Don't worry, I am.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD7])

[INFO:00026E0B] ([R]'You know, Dorthe, with all those vegetables I've been growing lately, I was thinkin' we could make a right lovely stew. Together. How about it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD6])

[INFO:00026E0A] ([R]'Dorthe... I was thinkin' I'd knit a couple of blankets, sell them to Lucan. Would you like to make one? Might be fun, workin' together.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD6])
[INFO:00026E09] ([R]'Dorthe, dear, I've been growin' some really lovely vegetables. Maybe tomorrow you could help me plant a new patch? What do you say?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD6])
[INFO:00026E08] ([R]'Oooh. Ahhh... Well... See, the thing is...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD5])
[INFO:00026E07] ([R]'Wow. Yeah. That sounds great, mother. Only, um... it's just that...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD5])
[INFO:00026E06] ([R]'Oh. Um. Well... You see...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD5])

[INFO:00026E11] ([R]'Dorthe, listen to me. Your father and your friend may treat you like a boy, but you're not. Do you understand? So please. Be a girl. For me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD4])
[INFO:00026E10] ([R]'Let me guess. You'd rather play "Daedra and Battlemages" with Ordnar. Or go fishing, or catch frogs...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD4])
[INFO:00026E0F] ([R]'Shor's crown! There are things ladies like us are supposed to do. We've talked about this...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD4])
[INFO:00026E05] ([R]'I'm sorry, mother. I can't help it. All that stuff you like to do, it's just so... boring.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD3])
[INFO:00026E04] ([R]'Just stop trying to change me, mother! I'm not a baby anymore! I'm almost a woman! I... I can't be who I want to be!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD3])

[INFO:00026E03] ([R]'It's just that papa promised I could make something at the forge. So maybe we could do something together, hmmm... next week? Is... that okay?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD3])
[INFO:00026DEB] ('Ho, now... Keep me out of this...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD2])
[INFO:00026E2D] ([R]'Well. I can see your father and I are going to have to talk about this. And when we do, things are going to change.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD1])
[INFO:00026E2C] ([R]'Oh, Dorthe. You're breaking your mother's heart, you know that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD1])
[INFO:00026E2B] ([R]'Fine. You play in the mud, or play with your father's forge, or get into sword fights with your little friend. But this is not over.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD1])
[INFO:00026E33] ([R]'Heard me a rumor, boy. Something about you putting bugs in the stew over at the Sleeping Giant. You do this?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD0])
[INFO:00026E32] ([R]'Tell me, son. Any truth to these stories I been hearing. About you gluing a cow's udders shut? You really do something like that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD0])
[INFO:00026E31] ([R]'Hey boy, I heard you nailed a Septim into Lucan's doorstep. Damn near drove him crazy. That true?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DD0])
[INFO:00026E30] ([R]'Ha ha ha ha! Yeah, I sure did. It was one of my best pranks yet, father.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DCF])
[INFO:00026E2F] ([R]'Yeah. So?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00026DCF])

[INFO:00023E4D] ('Might head down to the meadery later. See what they're brewing up. You can smell the honey on the wind.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E4C] ('The latest recruit! Right? Wait, is that right?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E4B] ('I haven't seen you before. Have I? Have we met? I'm sorry if I've forgotten.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCC4] ('Oh, so you're the one in charge now? Fine, fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E4A] ([R]'What's on your mind?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E49] ([R]'Oh, got more to say?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCC3] ('Good to have some fresh eyes up there at the top. I follow your lead, Harbinger.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E48] ('Oh, hey there. I killed a bear yesterday. Did you kill anything?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E47] ('I was the newest Companion, until you came along. I guess that's ok. Just means I can show you the ropes!' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E46] ('Here to be a Companion? Well, they just let me in, so there's probably no more room.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00099396] ('Fight with us and you'll have stories to tell. Come up to Jorrvaskr if you're worth anything in a fight.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E45] ([R]'Oh, it's you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E44] ([R]'What now?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCC2] ('What guidance could you offer me?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E43] ('If the Circle vouches for you, I'm sworn to respect their judgment. But that doesn't mean I like it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E42] ('I'm still trying to figure out why Skjor let you in in the first place.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E41] ('You don't belong here. What do you think you have to offer?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E40] ([R]'Look, I've got training to get to.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E3F] ([R]'To what do I owe the honor?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E3E] ('We are all Ashlanders now, brother. Good to find another family that cares where they came from, eh?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E3D] ('Are you thinking you're better than me? I crawled west out of the wasteland, so show some respect.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E3C] ('I avoid going to Eastmarch if I can. Something in the air... I think it's just too close to the border.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])

[INFO:000BFCC1] ('I never thought they would actually let me join the Companions. But now it looks like they're letting anyone in these days.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023D9C] ('Ah, fresh blood. Hope you know how to handle yourself.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023E3B] ('I always thought the new Harbinger would be taller, myself.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00099395] ('I swear, every wanderer who shows up in Whiterun looks weaker than the last.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023BC5] ([R][RE]'You're a talkative one, aren't you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A7D] ([R]'What is it now?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A7C] ([R]'I suppose you have another question?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A46] ('Did you just wander in out of the white?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A47] ('Great, another ambitious visitor. You think you can just wander in here and join us?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCC0] ('I think by now I've killed one of every living thing in Skyrim. May be time for a trip to Morrowind.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A7A] ('What brings you to me? Find some strange creature in your travels?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A6E] ('Come to me with questions. I know our history almost as well as Vignar by now. Except I can remember it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A7B] ('I wouldn't have expected someone like you to be the Harbinger, but Kodlak trusted your judgment. And so will I.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A3A] ([R][RE]'Getting tired of hanging around talking all day.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A2F] ([R]'Thinking I need to train some more.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A29] ([R]'I'm here to help.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A04] ('My brother Vilkas is a better talker than me. He should be around someplace.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A03] ('You are new here. I don't trust the new.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A14] ('Some people don't think I'm smart. Those people get my fist. But you, I like.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023A13] ('Skjor says that I have the strength of Ysgramor, and my brother has his smarts.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCBE] ('Vilkas said you are the new Kodlak. I don't know what that means, but you seem honorable, so that's good.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00099394] ('You look strong. Come to Jorrvaskr and be a Companion!' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239B3] ([R]'Blood running hot?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239AC] ([R]'Are you on the hunt?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239A8] ('Ysgramor himself wouldn't have the patience to deal with all the rabble around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239A7] ('If you wish to hunt with me, your feet need to be quick, and your eyes quicker.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239AB] ('It's good to have another quick-eyed Shield-Sister in the hall. Come to me with any troubles.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239AA] ('Don't let them intimidate you, sister. We both know how to keep our heads while the men let their hearts rule.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239A9] ('I've heard you may actually be stronger than you look. Perhaps we can hunt together someday.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCB8] ('I hope the hunting goes well, brother. We've got the cowards on their heels now.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCB9] ('I hope the hunting goes well, sister. We've got the cowards on their heels now.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCBA] ('Have you been bringing the battle to the Silver Hand, friend? I wish I could be there with you. Soon enough.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCBC] ('I've been running interference for you around here. I don't think anyone's caught on to our little campaign. Yet.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCBD] ('Do you have guidance for me, Harbinger?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00099393] ('Blood on the wind today. Good hunt ahead of us.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000239A2] ([R][RE]'I can't keep helping you with everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:0002399C] ([R]'What now?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023999] ([R]'You again?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023998] ('This had better be important.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023997] ('Are you looking for help with something? This is a busy time.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:000BFCB7] ('You might make a decent Companion yet.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023996] ('You still need to prove yourself, whelp.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023995] ('This is a place for warriors, new blood. What brings you here?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023994] ([SO]'Haven't seen your face before. I'm watching you.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:0002398F] ([R][RE]'Get a move on.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:0002398E] ([R]'Let's not waste too much time talking when there is glory to be had.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023982] ([R]'Are you still here?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023975] ('Greetings outsider. If you have some business here, speak it.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023965] ('A stranger comes to our hall.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023977] ('How goes the hunting, sister?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023976] ('How goes the hunting, brother?' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:00023978] ('When you get to be my age, you'll come to miss the smell of blood. Strange, I know.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:0002397E] ('Some nights I dream about the mists of Sovngarde.' in GRUP Topic Children of CompanionsHellos [DIAL:0002287A])
[INFO:0002291D] ('I don't think we're going to get those potatoes to come in.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022878])
[INFO:0002314A] ('Well of course, not with an attitude like that!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022877])
[INFO:00023287] ('The ground is practically frozen. We can't dig down far enough.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022876])
[INFO:00022886] ('Come on, we just need a little elbow grease.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022875])
[INFO:00022FA7] ('Now, I've been reading about the best ways to grow corn in permafrost...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022874])
[INFO:000231A0] ('I keep telling you, without a warming enchantment, it will never grow past your ankles.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022873])
[INFO:0002325A] ('Right, but if you plow the soil with fire salts...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022872])
[INFO:00023961] ('Then you've salted it and nothing will grow at all. Genius.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022871])
[INFO:00022F98] ('Oh dear, I hadn't thought of that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022870])
[INFO:0002311B] ('I'll bet this is better than trying to grow something in Morrowind, though, isn't it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002286F])
[INFO:0002324D] ('Firstly, I've never even seen Morrowind. Secondly, in volcanic soil the plants practically grow themselves.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002286E])
[INFO:0002369B] ('Oh, my, I hadn't thought of that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002286D])
[INFO:00022925] ('There are places in the world that aren't wrapped in ice, you know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022827])
[INFO:0002309F] ('I was wondering if you had ordered the shipment of that frostwheat, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022825])
[INFO:00023202] ('Yes, but that fool Endario can't get it in. I'll thrash him when I get back to the city, don't you worry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022817])
[INFO:0002328D] ('I wasn't wanting to get anyone in trouble, sir. Just wanting to get the new planting started, is all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022816])
[INFO:0002287C] ('Yes, wouldn't want to miss the lush summer we have ahead.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022815])
[INFO:0002297A] ('Make sure the back fence is repaired. I swear I saw some skeevers in nibbling the leaves yesterday.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022814])
[INFO:0002309A] ('Oh, no skeevers out here, sir. They can't stand the cold.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227BB])
[INFO:0002320C] ('Maybe, but the way you burn through all that wood to keep the cabin toasty, they might mistake this place for Elsweyr.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227BA])
[INFO:0002328E] ('Sorry, sir. These old bones do like a bit of warmth in the evening. There's no need to make fun.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227B8])
[INFO:0002287E] ('You just need to remember that there's a war on, and firewood isn't cheap these days.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227B7])
[INFO:00022F9D] ('So have you ever actually spoken to Captain Lonely-Gale?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227B6])
[INFO:00023116] ('By the gods, he's just a retired ship's captain.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227B5])
[INFO:00023259] ('Maybe to you, but he's just so... his story is...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227B4])
[INFO:0002393B] ('He's just a guard captain. And not a very good one, at that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227B2])
[INFO:00022F97] ('How have things been with you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000227AE])
[INFO:00023133] ('I got another harangue from Torsten yesterday.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022787])
[INFO:0002327F] ('Don't worry about him. I know you work hard, and I'm the one who gets you your money.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022786])
[INFO:00023931] ('Thank you, miss, I appreciate that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022785])
[INFO:00022F9C] ('And what about the dogs? How are those precious little angels?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022784])
[INFO:00023113] ('Healthy and strong. Ysgramor's coat's gotten so thick, he looks fat!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022783])
[INFO:0002324E] ('Oh, that's just adorable.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022782])
[INFO:0002393A] ('Tulvur! I've just completed inspection of the farmhouse.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022781])
[INFO:00022F95] ('Oh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022780])
[INFO:0002319F] ('It's filthy in there! Dirt everywhere, and it looks like the dogs have the run of the place.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002277F])
[INFO:00023257] ('Well, sir, it's a farmhouse. It's not going to be as clean as your house in the city.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002277E])
[INFO:00023859] ('I just know that our sailors are able to keep their ship quarters clean, and I expect the same of you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002277D])
[INFO:00022915] ('I'll do my best, sir.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002277C])
[INFO:000230F4] ('Sir, I'm going to need some better equipment if you want me plowing the frost.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022779])
[INFO:00023213] ('Like what?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022778])
[INFO:00023844] ('Well, some tools that aren't rusted through would be a start.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022776])
[INFO:00022963] ('I'll provide you wood and timber to make whatever riggings you'll need.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022775])
[INFO:000230D8] ('I'm not building a ship, sir. I'm trying to make things grow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022774])
[INFO:00022910] ('Did I tell you I got a letter from General Tullius? They've conscripted some more archers and will need...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022773])
[INFO:00023252] ('Sssssh! That's not something we want everyone to be hearing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022772])
[INFO:00022893] ('Oh, like the sleepy rebel supporters in this town are going to tell anyone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022771])
[INFO:00022FA6] ('Let's just not take the chance. We can talk about this later.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022770])
[INFO:000231C7] ('That last brigade of soldiers said there's a tall forest on the eastern edge of the White River.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002276F])
[INFO:00023258] ('Yes, but that's too close to Mixwater Mill. We don't want to get Gilfre angry at us by stealing her trees.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002276D])
[INFO:00023718] ('Well we have to harvest somewhere! This is getting absurd.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002276C])
[INFO:00022920] ('I want to make money just as much as you do, but we don't want to make the Nords angry.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002276B])
[INFO:0002302C] ('Who could tell the difference?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002276A])
[INFO:00023214] ('We've got a new order in.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022769])
[INFO:000237F7] ('Is that a joke?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022768])
[INFO:00022F92] ('No! Roggi and Kjeld need some more support timbers for the mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022765])
[INFO:00023103] ('I suppose Kjeld asked for the usual discount?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022762])
[INFO:0002323F] ('Well, he is the mayor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022761])
[INFO:00023962] ('No, it's fine. I don't mind being poor.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022760])
[INFO:00022F94] ('What about Ulfric? Did you ever hear back from him?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002275F])
[INFO:00023109] ('No, but his housecarl sent us a letter.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002275E])
[INFO:00023254] ('Why didn't you tell me? What did he say?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002275D])
[INFO:00023939] ('He... thanked us for contacting him, but said they didn't need any more lumber at the moment.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002275C])
[INFO:0002296C] ('Oh.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002275B])
[INFO:00023118] ('You see? That's why I didn't tell you!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002275A])
[INFO:0002327E] ('There is some good news though. I think the borders of the shrine may be smaller than we think.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022759])
[INFO:0002392E] ('Wait, so you think we'll be able to harvest some of the sacred trees up there?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022758])
[INFO:0002296B] ('Well that's just it. Some of them might not be sacred.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022757])
[INFO:000230FB] ('I'll let you explain that one to the Nords.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022756])
[INFO:00023223] ('They have to be reasonable about it at some point.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022755])
[INFO:00023843] ('Gemma. This town is called "Kynesgrove." That stand of trees is Kyne's Grove. You don't honestly think you can just cut some down.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022754])
[INFO:000228C7] ('Well, we have to cut down something!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022753])
[INFO:00023020] ('Maybe we should just admit that this is a horrible place for a mill.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022752])
[INFO:000231F4] ('I'll never understand why you're so bitter about everything.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022751])
[INFO:00023293] ('I'm bitter because we had lives in Cyrodiil. And we came out here to be paupers.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022750])
[INFO:0002288B] ('But we choose our own path now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002274F])
[INFO:00022FD9] ('And a whole lot of good that's gotten us.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002274E])
[INFO:000228B0] ('Mama, when can we go play in the river again?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002273A])
[INFO:00022FE1] ('Not with all those soldiers all over the hold. Their horses can't see you, you know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022739])
[INFO:000231D2] ('I know, but...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022733])
[INFO:00023298] ('And you'll be trampled to death!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000226A3])
[INFO:000E776C] ([G]'Avanchnzel. Take it to Avanchnzel. You must take it back.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022662])
[INFO:000E776B] ([G]'It's yours now. I won't take it back. I won't.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022662])
[INFO:0002266A] ('Please take the Lexicon.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00022662])
[INFO:000228CA] ('No way. I'm quick!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225F1])
[INFO:000230CD] ('Well why don't you be quick about finding my book that you lost?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225EF])
[INFO:00023205] ('You need to take better care of your sister.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225EE])
[INFO:00023695] ('But she's so stupid!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225ED])
[INFO:0002292A] ('She said you threw her into a goat pen yesterday.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225EC])
[INFO:000230EE] ('Because she was being stupid!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225EA])
[INFO:0002323D] ('Don't make me bring your father into this.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225E8])
[INFO:0002385A] ('I'm going to need your help in the kitchen tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225E7])
[INFO:0002297B] ('But papa was going to take me hunting tomorrow!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225E6])
[INFO:00023107] ('Oh, I don't think you're old enough for that yet. You can help me salt the cheese curd.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225E4])
[INFO:0002321C] ('Why can't Froa do it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225E2])
[INFO:00023875] ('Because I'm telling you to.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225DF])
[INFO:00022F93] ('Papa, mama's making me do kitchen work again.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225DE])
[INFO:00023111] ('And what did you say to that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225DC])
[INFO:0002327C] ('She can't tell me what to do!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225DB])
[INFO:0002287D] ('There you go, son. Be your own man!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225DA])
[INFO:00022FA3] ('And then I told her about the vampires and how much they would pay me for her.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225D8])
[INFO:0002318C] ('That is rich. What did she do?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225D7])
[INFO:00023284] ('She's a girl. She cried.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225D5])
[INFO:0002288A] ('It's good to toughen her up. Not an easy world out here. Keep at it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225D4])
[INFO:00022FA4] ('When do I get to go hunting?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:000225D3])

[INFO:000225B7] ('Miss Grelod is... well she's a terrible old crone. No person could be that cruel. I think she's part hagraven.' in GRUP Topic Children of DB01FrancoisGrelodBranchTopic "DB01FrancoisGrelodBranchTopic" [DIAL:000225B5])

column4: [INFO:000225BB] ('Sometimes, when she goes to her room to work or sleep, I slip out for a bit. Noontime, every day - that's when I hit the streets.' in GRUP Topic Children of DB01SamuelGrelodBranchTopic [DIAL:000225B4])

column4: [INFO:000212A4] ([R]'Those rebels better not try coming to Haafingar.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:000212A3] ([R]'Heard there were wolves on the road up north.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:000212A2] ([R]'Another quiet day... I hope.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:000212A1] ([R]'Another quiet day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])

column4: [INFO:0002129D] ('Don't start any trouble and I think we'll get along just fine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002129C] ('Mind you don't cross Tassius. He's in charge around here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002129B] ('Respect the law, and you'll have no trouble in Dragon Bridge.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021292] ('I was a barmaid at the Winking Skeever when I met my husband, rest his soul. Wasn't for him, I'd still be working there!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021291] ('I think the dragons are here to test us, and make sure we're still true Nords.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021290] ('Poor Horgeir. Everyone in town knows about his wife's affair but him. Probably better if he doesn't know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002128E] ('You met the Lylvieves? Quiet family, but they're the heart of Dragon Bridge.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002128C] ('Seen a lot of travelers lately. Mostly soldier, nowadays.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002128D] ('The meals I serve ain't what I'd call a Jarl's feast, but they'll fill your belly.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002128F] ('Something different about you, I can tell. Hope you ain't here to cause trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002128B] ('Faida's the name. I keep the inn.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021288] ('You want anything in this life, you gotta take it. Just not from me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021287] ('If you're looking for handouts, look somewhere else.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021286] ('Got nothing to spare for travelers nor refugees, here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021285] ('Keep walking, stranger.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00055B5D] ('Got nothing to say to strange folk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021282] ('Did my worthless husband send you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021280] ('You going to try and sell me something? Well, I ain't interested.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002127F] ('Where is that lazy man?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021278] ('Rest a spell! Can't work every minute of your life.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002EBEB] ('They say a strong drink, a sharp axe and a good woman are all a Nord needs to be happy. Two out of three's not bad.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002127A] ('Money's been tight since the mill burned down. My wife won't let me forget it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002127B] ('You been to Markarth? They've got a tavern called the Silver-Blood Inn. Best ale this side of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021277] ('You're a well-traveled sort, I can tell just looking at you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021279] ('Working hard gives a man reason for drinking hard! Well, that and putting up with a wife like mine.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002E144] ('First the war and now there's talk of dragons. What's next?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002E143] ('Please stop looking at me like that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00055B5C] ('Faida's teaching me the innkeeper's trade. She runs the Four Shields.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002E142] ('I'm hoping to run my own inn someday.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021274] ('Have you met Lucky? He's my pet goat, and he helps me patrol the town.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021273] ('I wish I was a soldier! They get to travel and stay up late and have fun!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021272] ('Pa says I'm too young to fight in the war, but I can still help by patrolling the town.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021271] ('Are you a soldier? One day, I'm going to be a soldier!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002126D] ('Got a loving wife, a healthy son and a patch of land to call my own. What more could a man ask for?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002126C] ('If it weren't for Michel, I'd probably be dead in a Markarth gutter by now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002126A] ('We aren't a big city like Solitude or Markarth, but we like it this way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021269] ('Welcome, traveler. Mind yourself in our town.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:0002126B] ('Seen some mean-spirited folk pass through lately. Thought I was rid of those sorts when I left Markarth.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021265] ('You hear all this talk about a war? I hope it never comes here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021264] ('This land's tough and unforgiving, but beautiful, too.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021263] ('Don't see many travelers out this way.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021262] ('It's no easy thing to make a living in the wilds of Skyrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021266] ('You look like you've seen your share of adventure.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021261] ('If you're looking for a room, you want the Four Shields.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124F])
[INFO:00021811] ([R]'I grew up hearing songs about Eyldi the Bear! She wrestled a storm out of the sky!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:0002180F] ([R]'Just my luck, stuck in the sticks with this crazy old woman.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:0002180C] ([R]'Hert keeps giving me this look. I don't know if she wants me or if she wants to eat me.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:00021808] ([R]'Is Hert his sister or his wife? Or both?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217FB] ('The patrols never seem to give us time to be alone, the nosy pests.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217FD] ('Why don't you stay a while?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217F9] ('A guest, oh my!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217FA] ('Hern and I do so adore guests! These guards are such a bore.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217F6] ('We've been looking for someone to join us in a hunt.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217F5] ('Lone travelers can find these woods a little treacherous.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217F4] ('Please, make yourself at home!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000217F3] ('Oh my, a guest!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0002124E])
[INFO:000DBB05] ('I hope life's treating you well, friend.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663D2] ('Such a fine day, smell the air! Isn't it wonderful?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663D0] ('Those bears are making Miss Temba so angry. I hope you can do something about them.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663CF] ('Miss Temba is much happier now that you took care of those bears. She may not look like she is, but I can tell.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663D1] ('Hello, my friend? What can I do for you on such a fine day?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663CE] ('I swear, if one more thing goes wrong, I'm going to burn my mill to the ground!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DBB04] ('Can you believe it? Another pile of logs ruined.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663CD] ('These damn bears are driving me crazy!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])

[INFO:000DA7FE] ('This has to be the worst place in Skyrim to run a mill. How am I supposed to do anything with all those bears running around?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663CC] ('So, have you shown those furry menaces that I mean business?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663CB] ('I'm going to put those pelts you gave me to good use.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021231] ('7,000 Steps indeed... next time they need to build it closer to the ground...' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663CA] ('I wish I could make my deliveries more often, but the road's getting dangerous.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA771] ('Passing through on your way to High Hrothgar? About to make a delivery up there myself.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA770] ('Ah, good to see you again! How did that delivery go?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002122F] ('Thanks again for delivering those supplies to the Greybeards.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021225] ('Is it absolutely necessary for you to bother me right now?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002122B] ('Hmm? What do you want?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021229] ('You don't look like a pilgrim. Why bother visiting Ivarstead?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021223] ('I miss Reyda. She was so nice to Narfi. Narfi's sad he can't be with Reyda.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021222] ('Oh Reyda! Redya! You live among the clouds now, dear Reyda!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021221] ('I can't see you, Reyda! I can't find you! Why are you hiding? Hiding, hide, hide, hide! Don't make me sad!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA768] ([G]'Narfi's sad now. Still wait for Reyda. No more sleep. No, no... no.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663C9] ([G]'Narfi's happy now. Maybe Narfi can sleep. Sleep all night. Sleep, sleep, sleep.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002121A] ('I can't imagine how exciting it must be like to journey from place to place. You're so lucky!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002121C] ('Have anything interesting to tell me?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021219] ('Oh! You're a traveler! You must have so much to tell about the world outside this boring town!' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])

[INFO:00021212] ('And to think that we've been supplying the Greybeards with our own food supplies. What have they ever done for us?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA767] ('You better not be here to stir up any trouble.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DBB03] ('Pilgrim or not, if I were you, I'd move right through our backwards little town.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021211] ('You must be another pilgrim on the way up to High Hrothgar. No other reason to pass through here.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021214] ('I hope Fastred's doing well in Riften. I miss her.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA766] ('Watch yourself on High Hrothgar, I hear wolves prowl the steps.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA74B] ('You a pilgrim or just passing through?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00064616] ('Any idea how I can get my daughter's head out of the clouds?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021209] ('If you ever settle down to have children, think twice before you do it.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DBB02] ('My daughter's driving me crazy, so forgive me if I'm a bit on edge.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002120A] ('I can't believe Fastred ran off to Riften with that... that bastard.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002120C] ('I can't believe Fastred's gone. I... I should have been nicer to her.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021202] ('If you fancy a bit of music, let me know.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DA744] ('Pardon me, milady. Would you care to hear me play my lute?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000DBB01] ('Pardon me, milord. Would you care to hear me play my lute?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:00021200] ('Anything I can help you with? A drink or a room perhaps?' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000211FA] ('Let me know if I can get you anything.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000211F9] ('Need a room? Maybe a drink? You name it.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:0002EA74] ('We don't get many visitors through here, unless their headed up to High Hrothgar of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000211F8] ('If I were you, I'd keep away from the barrow on the east side of town... it's haunted.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])
[INFO:000663C8] ('Now that our "ghost" has been unmasked, I hope we see more visitors in town than just the occasional pilgrim.' in GRUP Topic Children of DialogueIvarsteadHellos [DIAL:000211F7])

[INFO:0010A2C0] ([R]'I learned to cook from my father. Ah, but that was a long time ago. Before, you know... I killed him. But let's not talk about that now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0010A2BF] ([R]'What do you think? Some more Nirnroot, maybe?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:000E26FD] ([R]'Do you need alchemy components? Or training?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00047442] ([R]'I can't wait to see what the future brings.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0004743D] ([R]'I like it here. We should have moved to Dawnstar ages ago.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00047446] ([SO]'You know, I can still sell you some potions and such, or train you in alchemy.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0004743C] ([SO]'So... wait. Cicero is alive? And we're all friends again? I swear, I can hardly keep up...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371D8] ('I've told you everything I can. I don't know what else you could want...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371D4] ([G]'Just north of Windhelm. There's a hollowed-out rock. I have some things hidden in there. Take them! They're yours.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371C7] ([G]'I'll give you money. Treasure. I have some things hidden away. Take them all. They're yours. Just please... stop.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371C6] ([G]'I just...  can't take the pain. Not a second longer.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371BF] ([G]'I'll tell you anything. Anything! Just please stop... hurting me...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371B6] ('Damn it. I gave it away, didn't I?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:000371B5] ([G]'Ha! Well it's safely hidden away, in a hollowed-out tree stump. Just outside Riften, tucked away nice and secure. You'll never find it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371AA] ([G]'Ah, now I understand. This is about that my father's hidden cache, isn't it? The dowry for my wedding.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:000371A9] ([G]'Do you have any idea who I am? When my father hears about this, he will gut you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0003718A] ([G]'You... you can't do this to me...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00037189] ('Why don't you be a dear and let me go now. All right? I won't say a word to anyone. Our little secret. I promise.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00037164] ([G]'It's in a hollowed-out tree stump. In the marsh, south of Solitude. Now please, you'll let me go now. Right?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00037112] ([G]'This... this is about the inheritance, isn't it? All right! I'll tell you where I've hidden it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00037110] ([G]'Is it information you want?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0003710F] ([G]'Why are you people doing this?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0003708F] ('Oh gods, you've taken everything I have. Just kill me and be done with it...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0003708E] ([G]'It's... in a hollowed-out rock. In the tundra. A bit west of Whiterun. Now please... please stop.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:0003708B] ([G]'Just... just stop. And I'll tell you where I've hidden my treasure.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:0003707A] ([G]'Please...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:00037074] ([R]'Yes, Listener?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:0009BCA2] ([R]'Cicero is at your service, oh great and powerful Listener!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00068B6F] ('Ah, good to see you, sister. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])
[INFO:00068B6E] ('Ah, good to see you, brother. Gearing up to kill the Emperor? Exciting times. Exciting times, indeed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:0003BDE8] ('Speak with Nazir and see if he has any contracts available. I need time to read Motierre's letter.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:0001E63A] ([R]'So many contracts, so little time...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:0010A2BD] ([SO]'Maybe I'll make the Potage le Magnifique, hmm? You may have killed the Gourmet, but true artistry never dies.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001F6C9])

[INFO:00019F6E] ([R]'Hmm? Oh, well... To be honest, I was just thinking of Nazeem. The gap between us seems to be widening. He is just so... self-absorbed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F54])

[INFO:00019F60] ('Let those soldiers come here! You've never seen me throw incense. I could fell a giant.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F53])

[INFO:00019F5B] ([R]'Oh dearest, who cares? So your husband is a lout. The work you do here, with me, is invaluable. The people of Whiterun know your true worth.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F52])

[INFO:00019F5A] ([R]'Ahlam, let's be honest. Your husband is an arrogant, domineering buffoon. These are the words you used to describe him to me... remember?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F52])
[INFO:00019F59] ([R]'If you don't mind me saying so, Ahlam, your husband is a damn fool. Any moment spent thinking about him is a moment wasted.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F52])
[INFO:00019F70] ([R]'Maybe Nazeem's obsession has merit. This civil war seems so big, so unceasing... I'm afraid, Danica. Afraid for us all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F51])
[INFO:00019F6F] ([R]'But it's more than that. Nazeem is obsessed with this civil war, as is all of Skyrim. I swear, it will consume us all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F51])
[INFO:00019F62] ([R]'Oh, you are terrible. You do know that, right? Ha ha ha ha ha.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F50])
[INFO:00019F61] ([R]'Ha! Well, when you put it like that, it certainly puts things into perspective. But enough wallowing. And thank you, Danica.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F50])
[INFO:00019F58] ([R]'I need but a moment of your time, my lord.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F47])
[INFO:00019F57] ([R]'Balgruuf, my Jarl. A word, if I may.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F47])
[INFO:00019F56] ([R]'Sir, we really must talk.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F47])
[INFO:00019F6B] ([R]'You've got sixty seconds. Go.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F46])
[INFO:00019F6A] ([R]'What is it?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F46])
[INFO:00019F69] ([R]'Speak.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F46])
[INFO:00019F96] ([R]'I think the time might be right for another public appearance. Maybe address the patrons at the Bannered Mare? Or visit Jorrvaskr?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F45])

[INFO:00019F95] ([R]'My daughter Adrianne wants to forge a new sword for you. Now, it wouldn't be a Skyforge blade, I know, but she really is quite gifted...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F45])
[INFO:00019F94] ([R]'One of the servants had a wonderful idea. Fireproofing Dragonsreach. In case of attack by, um... air.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F45])
[INFO:00019F93] ([R]'There's been talk again in the streets. A general fear that the giants may move south, and then... Well, you understand.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F45])
[INFO:00019F92] ([R]'We really must discuss the security here in Dragonsreach. Perhaps we could limit patrols in the city, and retain more guards here?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F45])

[INFO:00019F91] ([R]'Well... It's your son. Nelkir. The boy has been acting increasingly peculiar. Moreso than normal, I mean. Something really should be done...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F45])
[INFO:00019F7A] ([R]'Hmm... All right, yes, I see your point. Make the necessary arrangements.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F44])
[INFO:00019F79] ([R]'Proventus, you're my steward. Your job is to offer me counsel. This? This is not counsel.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F44])
[INFO:00019F78] ([R]'Yes, yes. Take care of it, Proventus. Whatever it is you're talking about...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F44])
[INFO:00019F77] ([R]'Damn it, Proventus. I've got war lurking just outside my gates, and this is what you offer me? This? Begone.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00019F44])

[INFO:00018944] ([R][RE]'Mikael, son. How about something with a bit o' kick?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F2B])
[INFO:00017F2F] ([R]'So Mikael, what'll it be tonight, hmm? Something upbeat? A Breton jig maybe?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F2B])
[INFO:0001893F] ([R]'You know, Hulda, there's this lovely Argonian ballad I've been studying...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F2A])
[INFO:00017F2E] ([R]'Well, I was thinking maybe something mournful. A High Elf dirge, perhaps? These are rather trying times, after all.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F2A])
[INFO:00018954] ([R]'We've been down this road before, Mikael. Save the sap and sadness for your lady friends. My patrons need life! Cheeriness!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F29])
[INFO:00017F2C] ([R]'You trying to scare off my customers, son? Lively! Keep it lively!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F29])
[INFO:00018948] ([R]'Alright, alright... Um... How about "The Guttersnipe"?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F28])
[INFO:00017F30] ([R]'Hmm... Yes, you do raise a good point. What about the "Sweet Maidenfair from Hadleyshire"?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F28])
[INFO:0001893E] ([R]'Well, that's not bad. But I was thinking "Mogo's Mead" really gets the place moving.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F27])
[INFO:00017F31] ([R]'I think "Seven Septims for Sigurd" will do nicely. Especially when they're in their cups.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F27])
[INFO:00018953] ([R]'Ah! An excellent suggestion. I'll do that one, then.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F1F])
[INFO:00017F2D] ([R]'Well then, consider it done.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017F1F])

column4: DialogueCarriageDontKnowIfWeCanOutrun [INFO:000D2A48] ('I don't know if we can outrun 'em.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
DialogueCarriageLookOutWeHaveCompany [INFO:000D2A46] ('Look out, I think we have company.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE152] ('We're passing Fort Sungard. Unbelievable view from up there. No wonder the Empire built a fort on that hill way back when.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

[INFO:000DE151] ('Did you spot the Dwarven ruins up there? Mzinfazzle, Finchafft, Mzinchaleft? Good thing the Dwarves disappeared and stopped naming things.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE150] ('I'm not asking, but if you happen to be the type, I hear that Kilkreath Ruin is a shrine to Merdia. You know. Daedra worship.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

[INFO:000DE14F] ('Thalmor got their embassy up that way. If I had my way, the lot of those yellowback elves would wake up in a box back to Summerset tomorrow.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE14E] ('Say what you will about the dark elves, but they did a proper job with Azura's Shrine. Can see it for miles on a clear day.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE14D] ('You can see Azura's Shrine for miles on a clear day. You people did a good job with that, I'll say it to anybody.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE14C] ('What's your sign? I was born under the Steed, as luck would have it. Really ought to visit my doomstone somtime. It's fairly near here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE14B] ('Between the cliff and Snapleg Cave there, I hate this stretch of road. There's an evil air up here. Getalong, horse.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DE14A] ('There's Treva's Watch. I hear bandits moved in while the steward was off fighting the war. I wonder if he ever got that sorted out?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD75D] ('I wouldn't wander here alone at night. Folk go missing around Chillwind Depths, the cave just over those falls.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD75C] ('I used to play in the Yorgrim River when I was just a boy. It's true! I was never afraid of the stories about Forsaken Cave, of course.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD75A] ('You ever hear the one about the Breton and the bear-tamer?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD759] ('Orc town nearby. Between you and me, we should have had them out years ago.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD758] ('Got keen eyes? Might see nasty old Hajvarr up on White River Watch. Piece of work. Jarl should just run him out and have done with it.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD757] ('Hold your breath if you're superstitious. We're passing Shroud Hearth Barrow. Everyone knows spirits guard the old treasure there.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

[INFO:000DD756] ('Thieves used to hole up in Fort Snowhawk there, but they were run out. Wizards, they say. Suits me fine, so long as they mind their own by.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

[INFO:000DD755] ('See those stones peeking through the surface? Used to be an old Imperial fort on the lake. Really! Stories say it up and sunk one day, but who knows?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

[INFO:000DD754] ('Ever taken a swim in the Illinalta? Take care you don't get nipped if you do. Folk say it's teeming with slaughterfish. Who knows what else.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD753] ('Old Embershard Mine's up there. Used to produce a lot of iron, but collapsed and taken over by criminals, I hear.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])
[INFO:000DD752] ('Lots of lawless folk around here. Foreigners, mostly. No offense.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

[INFO:000DD751] ('Now, I don't want to alarm you, but there are bandits in these parts. We're safe up here, of course. Just be careful if you're ever here on foot.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EE9])

column4: [INFO:00017EAE] ('Yeah! Get her! Kill her!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EA9])
[INFO:00017EAC] ('Whoa! They killed Grelod! Ha ha ha ha ha!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EA9])
[INFO:00017EAB] ('Oh my goodness!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EA9])
[INFO:00017EAA] ('Did you see that?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017EA9])
[INFO:00017E03] ('Imedhnain, I was just comparing the ledgers from last season.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DF7])
[INFO:00017DFD] ('Not too bad, I hope?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DF6])
[INFO:00017DFA] ('Worse. The loss of shipments from Forsworn attacks are really hitting us hard.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DF5])
[INFO:00017DF8] ('Where's Cosnach, is that lazy idiot out drinking at the Silver-Blood Inn again? On my coin?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DF2])
[INFO:00017DFE] ('He's just waiting for the shipments, Lisbet. He'll be back as soon as they come in.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DF1])
[INFO:00017DF9] ('There are no shipments scheduled today. Stop covering for him!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DF0])
[INFO:00017E02] ('He's my cousin. Just give him another chance. Please.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DEF])
[INFO:00017DFB] ('Fine, I won't fire him, but I'm doing this for your sake. Not his.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017DEE])
[INFO:00017D17] (in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017D16])
[INFO:00017C7C] ('Where were you last night, Thonar? Busy with work or have you found some other woman who's willing to tolerate your lack of ambition?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C29])

[INFO:00017C2A] ('I am busy keeping this family in coin and your pretty little head adorned with jewels, so I'll thank you not to question where I go at night, wife.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C28])
[INFO:00017C30] ('Well maybe if you would finally convince Thongvor to put you in charge of the family, I wouldn't need to question you anymore.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C27])
[INFO:00017C86] ('I'll take control of the family on my own time, Betrid. Until then, my brother remains in charge and you'll keep your mouth shut.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C26])
[INFO:00017C7B] ('Oh dear, whatever is a girl to do with such fearful brutes about her?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C25])
[INFO:00017C69] ('You have worked here in the Treasury House for a long time, haven't you Ildene?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C19])
[INFO:00017C91] ('Yes, child. Nana Ildene has taken care of the Silver-Bloods for many years....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C18])
[INFO:00017C72] ('It's just... aren't you worried about the Forsworn? Maybe it's not safe here.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C17])
[INFO:00017C8C] ('Don't you worry Rhiada. If any Forsworn coming knocking on our door, Nana will let you know....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C16])
[INFO:00017C76] ('Thanks Nana. I feel better now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C15])
[INFO:00017C2C] ('You're a very pretty young woman, Rhiada.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C14])
[INFO:00017C7F] ('Why, thank you Thonar. I'm flattered.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C13])
[INFO:00017C4F] ('You're married, yes? To that young metal worker?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C12])
[INFO:00017C88] ('Eltrys, yes, just last season we were wed.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C11])
[INFO:00017C73] ('He's a lucky man to have such a beautiful young wife.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C10])
[INFO:00017C8D] ('Thank you, Thonar. That's generous of you to say.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C0F])
[INFO:00017C78] ('Ah, Nana Ildene, whatever would my family do without you?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C0E])
[INFO:00017C2D] ('Ah, Thonar, don't you worry. Nana Ildene isn't going anywhere.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C0D])
[INFO:00017C82] ('Um, good. We reward loyalty, you know.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C0C])
[INFO:00017C50] ('Oh, I know, Thonar. Only a mad woman would ever betray the Silver-Blood family.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C0B])
[INFO:00017C89] ('Uh, yes. Quite.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017C0A])

column4: [INFO:00017277] ('Hello, dear husband. Have you brought more silver jewelry for me to sell?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017259])

[INFO:0001727A] ('They are perfect. Thank you both.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017257])
[INFO:00017273] ('How are the necklaces selling, my wife? We could make more.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017256])
[INFO:0001725F] ('I'm afraid the necklaces aren't selling well. Customers are not interested in medallions engraved with the symbols of other provinces.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017255])
[INFO:00017275] ('Humph. Used to be everyone in Markarth wore a necklace showing his home province, from Elsweyr to High Rock to Hammerfell and Cyrodiil...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017254])
[INFO:00017261] ('We don't have travelers from Elsweyr or Hammerfell anymore, Endon. Only the natives and the Nords stay in Markarth now.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017253])
[INFO:0001727B] ('As they always have, along with those crazed Forsworn. They've driven off the color that used to make this city great.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017252])
[INFO:00017266] ('I need to get back to the customers. We'll talk more of this when I come home tonight.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017251])
[INFO:00017281] ('Care to try out a new ring, or perhaps my daughter could make you a necklace...' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017250])
[INFO:00017260] ('Oh, that sounds lovely.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001724F])
[INFO:0001725B] ('Kerah, do you have anything... exotic? Something no other woman in Markarth would be wearing.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001724A])
[INFO:00017262] ('I do have one set of bracelets in a style that is popular with the nobility in Sentinel.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017249])
[INFO:0001726D] ('Sentinel? That's in Hammerfell, correct? And you say these bracelets are only worn by the nobility?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017248])
[INFO:00017279] ('They are popular with the nobility there, yes. This particular bracelet is a copy of one worn by a Crown Princess.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017247])
[INFO:00017283] ('Hmm. Maybe in a few seasons I could afford such a treasure.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017246])
[INFO:0001725C] ('You there, pretty lady. You need some fresh meat for your family? Just look at the blood coming from this cut....' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017245])
[INFO:00017267] ('That's disgusting, get that rotting carcass away from me!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017244])
[INFO:00017276] ('What's wrong? You have to look at the blood closely to see the quality of the meat. How else will you know it's fresh?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017243])
[INFO:00017280] ('I don't need to know if it's fresh from this distance.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017242])
[INFO:0001726C] ('Ugh. You're the most disgusting merchant I have ever seen. The guards should take you away.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001723F])
[INFO:00017274] ('The only people I offend are cheats who don't pay me enough gold coin, or idiots who don't know good meat when I throw it at their faces.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001723E])

[INFO:0001727F] ('If you ever think of throwing meat at me, I will have you dragged off to Cidhna Mine so fast the guards will yank those filthy arms of yours off.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001723D])
[INFO:00017286] ('What do I do to deserve such hatred? You give people good food and good prices, and all they do is insult you.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001723C])
[INFO:0001725D] ('Thongvor, I have the latest reports from Cidhna Mine and the smelter. We should go over them immediately.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001723B])
[INFO:00017268] ('Reburrus, there is a war being fought across all of Skyrim, and you bother me with the usual mundane reports about silver?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:0001723A])
[INFO:00017270] ('Look at these figures, Thongvor! Ore yield is down by half, and the amount of silver bars being smelted is slipping even more than that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017239])
[INFO:0001727C] ('Oh, very well. I'll send my brother. He'll straighten this out.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017238])
[INFO:00017287] ('Very good, Thongvor. It relieves me to hear you say that.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017237])
[INFO:00017264] ('Did I hear correctly, Thonar? Is your brother really asking you to settle another dispute between Mulush and Nepos?' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017236])
[INFO:0001726A] ('Someone has to keep the silver production running, Betrid, and that means keeping Mulush and Nepos in line once in a while.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017235])
[INFO:00017272] ('Humph. Who's running the Silver-Bloods? You or your brother? You need to tell Thongvor that he should settle this himself or step down.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017234])
[INFO:0001727D] ('The only thing I need to do, dear wife, is make sure profits are up, no matter what. If Thongvor won't do the dirty work, I will.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017233])
[INFO:00017284] ('You'll never be in charge of this family with that attitude, loving husband.' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017232])
[INFO:0001725E] ('I said no! No adventures, no theatrics, no thief-chasing!' in GRUP Topic Children of [DIAL:00017231])
